From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Theorem alg_type_check_sound : forall {Γ i A M},
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}.

Theorem alg_type_check_complete : forall {Γ A M},
    user_exp M ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }}.

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Subtyping Require Export Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom nf).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive alg_type_check : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| atc_ati :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" := (alg_type_check Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with alg_type_infer : ctx -> nf -> exp -> Prop :=
| ati_typ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a Type@i ⟹ Type@(S i) }} )
| ati_nat :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a ℕ ⟹ Type@0 }} )
| ati_zero :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a zero ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a succ M ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a MZ ⟸ A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢a MS ⟸ A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ A[Id,,M] }}} B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟹ B }} )
| ati_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Π A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a M ⟹ B }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a λ A M ⟹ Π C B }} )
| ati_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M N ⟹ C }} )
| ati_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Σ A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ , A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ B[Id,,M1] }} ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ }}} {{{ A }}} A' ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ , A }}} {{{ B }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a ⟨ M1 : A ; M2 : B ⟩ ⟹ Σ A' C }} )
| ati_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a fst M ⟹ A }} )
| ati_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,fst M] }}} C ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a snd M ⟹ C }} )
| ati_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Eq A M1 M2 ⟹ Type@i }} )
| ati_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     nbe Γ M A N ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a refl A M ⟹ Eq C N N }} )
| ati_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a BR ⟸ B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟹ C }} )
| ati_vlookup :
  `( {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a #x ⟹ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" := (alg_type_infer Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Scheme alg_type_check_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_check Sort Prop
with alg_type_infer_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_infer Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme alg_type_mut_ind from
  alg_type_check_mut_ind,
  alg_type_infer_mut_ind.

1	From Coq Require Import Lia List MSets PeanoNat String FunInd.
2	
3	From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
4	
5	From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import Syntax.
6	
7	Open Scope string_scope.
8	
9	Module StrSet := Make String_as_OT.
10	
11	Module StrSProp := MSetProperties.Properties StrSet.
12	
13	Notation "s [<=] t" := (StrSet.Subset s t) (at level 70, no associativity).
14	
15	Fixpoint lookup (s : string) (ctx : list string) : option nat :=
16	  match ctx with
17	  | nil => None
18	  | c::cs =>
19	      if string_dec c s
20	      then Some 0
21	      else
22	        match lookup s cs with
23	        | Some n => Some (n + 1)%nat
24	        | None => None
25	        end
26	  end
27	.
28	
29	Fixpoint elaborate (cst : Cst.obj) (ctx : list string) : option exp :=
30	  match cst with
31	  | Cst.var s =>
32	      match lookup s ctx with
33	      | Some n => Some (a_var n)
34	      | None => None
35	      end
36	  | Cst.typ n => Some (a_typ n)
37	  | Cst.nat => Some a_nat
38	  | Cst.zero => Some a_zero
39	  | Cst.succ c =>
40	      match elaborate c ctx with
41	      | Some a => Some (a_succ a)
42	      | None => None
43	      end
44	  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sr s =>
45	      match elaborate m (mx :: ctx), elaborate z ctx, elaborate s (sr :: sx :: ctx), elaborate n ctx with
46	      | Some m, Some z, Some s, Some n => Some (a_natrec m z s n)
47	      | _, _, _, _ => None
48	      end
49	  | Cst.pi s t c =>
50	      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
51	      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_pi t a)
52	      | _, _ => None
53	      end
54	  | Cst.fn s t c =>
55	      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
56	      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_fn t a)
57	      | _, _ => None
58	      end
59	  | Cst.app c1 c2 =>
60	      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
61	      | None, _ => None
62	      | _, None => None
63	      | Some a1, Some a2 => Some (a_app a1 a2)
64	      end
65	  | Cst.sigma s t c =>
66	      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
67	      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_sigma t a)
68	      | _, _ => None
69	      end
70	  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 =>
71	      match elaborate c1 ctx,  elaborate t1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx, elaborate t2 (s::ctx) with
72	      | Some a1, Some b1, Some a2, Some b2 => Some (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2)
73	      | _, _, _, _ => None
74	      end
75	  | Cst.fst c =>
76	      match elaborate c ctx with
77	      | Some a => Some (a_fst a)
78	      | None => None
79	      end
80	  | Cst.snd c =>
81	      match elaborate c ctx with
82	      | Some a => Some (a_snd a)
83	      | None => None
84	      end
85	  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 =>
86	      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
87	      | Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eq t a1 a2)
88	      | _, _, _ => None
89	      end
90	  | Cst.refl t c =>
91	      match elaborate t ctx, elaborate c ctx with
92	      | Some t, Some a => Some (a_refl t a)
93	      | _, _ => None
94	      end
95	  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 =>
96	      match elaborate n ctx, elaborate m (mz :: my :: mx :: ctx), elaborate r (rx :: ctx), elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
97	      | Some n, Some m, Some r, Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eqrec t m r a1 a2 n)
98	      | _, _, _, _, _, _ => None
99	      end
100	  end
101	.
102	
103	Generalizable All Variables.
104	
105	Inductive user_exp : exp -> Prop :=
106	| user_exp_typ :
107	  `( user_exp (a_typ i) )
108	| user_exp_nat :
109	  `( user_exp a_nat )
110	| user_exp_zero :
111	  `( user_exp a_zero )
112	| user_exp_succ :
113	  `( user_exp M ->
114	     user_exp (a_succ M) )
115	| user_exp_natrec :
116	  `( user_exp A ->
117	     user_exp MZ ->
118	     user_exp MS ->
119	     user_exp M ->
120	     user_exp (a_natrec A MZ MS M) )
121	| user_exp_pi :
122	  `( user_exp A ->
123	     user_exp B ->
124	     user_exp (a_pi A B) )
125	| user_exp_fn :
126	  `( user_exp A ->

From Coq Require Import Lia List MSets PeanoNat String FunInd.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import Syntax.

Open Scope string_scope.

Module StrSet := Make String_as_OT.

Module StrSProp := MSetProperties.Properties StrSet.

Notation "s [<=] t" := (StrSet.Subset s t) (at level 70, no associativity).

Fixpoint lookup (s : string) (ctx : list string) : option nat :=
  match ctx with
  | nil => None
  | c::cs =>
      if string_dec c s
      then Some 0
      else
        match lookup s cs with
        | Some n => Some (n + 1)%nat
        | None => None
        end
  end
.

Fixpoint elaborate (cst : Cst.obj) (ctx : list string) : option exp :=
  match cst with
  | Cst.var s =>
      match lookup s ctx with
      | Some n => Some (a_var n)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.typ n => Some (a_typ n)
  | Cst.nat => Some a_nat
  | Cst.zero => Some a_zero
  | Cst.succ c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_succ a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sr s =>
      match elaborate m (mx :: ctx), elaborate z ctx, elaborate s (sr :: sx :: ctx), elaborate n ctx with
      | Some m, Some z, Some s, Some n => Some (a_natrec m z s n)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pi s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_pi t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fn s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_fn t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.app c1 c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | None, _ => None
      | _, None => None
      | Some a1, Some a2 => Some (a_app a1 a2)
      end
  | Cst.sigma s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_sigma t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx,  elaborate t1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx, elaborate t2 (s::ctx) with
      | Some a1, Some b1, Some a2, Some b2 => Some (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fst c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_fst a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.snd c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_snd a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eq t a1 a2)
      | _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.refl t c =>
      match elaborate t ctx, elaborate c ctx with
      | Some t, Some a => Some (a_refl t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 =>
      match elaborate n ctx, elaborate m (mz :: my :: mx :: ctx), elaborate r (rx :: ctx), elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | Some n, Some m, Some r, Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eqrec t m r a1 a2 n)
      | _, _, _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  end
.

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive user_exp : exp -> Prop :=
| user_exp_typ :
  `( user_exp (a_typ i) )
| user_exp_nat :
  `( user_exp a_nat )
| user_exp_zero :
  `( user_exp a_zero )
| user_exp_succ :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_succ M) )
| user_exp_natrec :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp MZ ->
     user_exp MS ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_natrec A MZ MS M) )
| user_exp_pi :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_pi A B) )
| user_exp_fn :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_fn A M) )
| user_exp_app :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp (a_app M N) )
| user_exp_sigma :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_sigma A B) )
| user_exp_pair :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp A ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_pair M A N B) )
| user_exp_fst :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_fst M) )
| user_exp_snd :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_snd M) )
| user_exp_eq :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M1 ->
     user_exp M2 ->
     user_exp (a_eq A M1 M2) )
| user_exp_refl :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_refl A M) )
| user_exp_eqrec :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp BR ->
     user_exp M1 ->
     user_exp M2 ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp (a_eqrec A B BR M1 M2 N) )
| user_exp_vlookup :
  `( user_exp (a_var x) ).

Fixpoint cst_variables (cst : Cst.obj) : StrSet.t :=
 match cst with
  | Cst.var s => StrSet.singleton s
  | Cst.typ n => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.nat => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.zero => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.succ c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sy s => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.remove mx (cst_variables m))) (StrSet.union (cst_variables z) (StrSet.remove sx (StrSet.remove sy (cst_variables s))))
  | Cst.pi s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.fn s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.app c1 c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables c2)
  | Cst.sigma s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables t1)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c2) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables t2)))
  | Cst.fst c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.snd c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2))
  | Cst.refl t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c)
  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove mx (StrSet.remove my (StrSet.remove mz (cst_variables m)))) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove rx (cst_variables r)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2)))))
 end
.

Inductive closed_at : exp -> nat -> Prop :=
 | ca_var : `( x < n -> closed_at (a_var x) n )
 | ca_type : `( closed_at (a_typ m) n )
 | ca_nat : `( closed_at (a_nat) n )
 | ca_zero : `( closed_at (a_zero) n )
 | ca_succ : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_succ a) n )
 | ca_natrec : `( closed_at n l -> closed_at m (1+l) -> closed_at z l -> closed_at s (2+l) -> closed_at (a_natrec m z s n) l )
 | ca_pi : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pi t b) n )
 | ca_lam : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_fn t b) n )
 | ca_app : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_app a1 a2) n )
 | ca_sigma : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_sigma t b) n )
 | ca_pair : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at b1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at b2 (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2) n )
 | ca_fst : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_fst a) n )
 | ca_snd : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_snd a) n )
 | ca_eq : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_eq t a1 a2) n )
 | ca_refl : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_refl t a) n )
 | ca_eqrec : `( closed_at a l -> closed_at m (3+l) -> closed_at r (1+l) -> closed_at m1 l -> closed_at m2 l -> closed_at n l -> closed_at (a_eqrec a m r m1 m2 n) l )
.

Import StrSProp.Dec.

From Coq Require Import List Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp).

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export SystemOpt.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢a A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, A custom exp, A' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢anf A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, A custom nf, A' custom nf).

Definition not_univ_pi_sigma (A : nf) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | nf_typ _ | nf_pi _ _ | nf_sigma _ _ => False
  | _ => True
  end.

Inductive alg_subtyping_nf : nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| asnf_refl : forall A A',
    not_univ_pi_sigma A ->
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf A ⊆ A' }}
| asnf_univ : forall i j,
    i <= j ->
    {{ ⊢anf Type@i ⊆ Type@j }}
| asnf_pi : forall A B A' B',
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf B ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ ⊢anf Π A B ⊆ Π A' B' }}
| asnf_sigma : forall A B A' B',
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf B ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ ⊢anf Σ A B ⊆ Σ A' B' }}
where "⊢anf A ⊆ A'" := (alg_subtyping_nf A A') (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Inductive alg_subtyping : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| alg_subtyp_run : forall Γ A B A' B',
    nbe_ty Γ A A' ->
    nbe_ty Γ B B' ->
    {{ ⊢anf A' ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B }}
where "Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B" := (alg_subtyping Γ A B) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'⟦' M '⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, M custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, A custom exp at level 99, MZ custom exp at level 99, MS custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₁' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₂' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, a custom domain at level 30, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, B custom exp at level 99, BR custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" (in custom judg at level 80, σ custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, ρσ custom domain at level 99).

Generalizable All Variables.

Variant eval_fst : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_fst_pair :
  `( {{ π₁ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ a }} )
| eval_fst_neut :
  `( {{ π₁ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ a (fst m) }} )
where "'π₁' n '↘' r" := (eval_fst n r) (in custom judg).

Inductive eval_exp : exp -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_exp_typ :
  `( {{ ⟦ Type@i ⟧ ρ ↘ 𝕌@i }} )
| eval_exp_var :
  `( {{ ⟦ # x ⟧ ρ ↘ ^(ρ x) }} )
| eval_exp_nat :
  `( {{ ⟦ ℕ ⟧ ρ ↘ ℕ }} )
| eval_exp_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ zero ⟧ ρ ↘ zero }} )
| eval_exp_succ :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ succ M ⟧ ρ ↘ succ m }} )
| eval_exp_natrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ rec m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_pi :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Π A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Π a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ λ A M ⟧ ρ ↘ λ ρ M }} )
| eval_exp_app :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ $| m & n |↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M N ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sigma :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Σ A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Σ a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_pair :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ b }} ->
     {{ ⟦ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ⟧ ρ ↘ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ }} )
| eval_exp_fst :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ fst M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_snd :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ snd M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_eq :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Eq A M1 M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ Eq a m1 m2 }} )
| eval_exp_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ refl A M ⟧ ρ ↘ refl m }} )
| eval_exp_eqrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ eqrec n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sub :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ' ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} )
where "'⟦' e '⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_exp e ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_natrec : exp -> exp -> exp -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_natrec_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ rec zero ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} )
| eval_natrec_succ :
  `( {{ rec b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ b ↦ r ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ rec succ b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ms }} )
| eval_natrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ b m ↘ a }} ->
     {{ rec ⇑ b m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ a (rec m under ρ return A | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end) }} )
where "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_app : domain -> domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_app_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m }} ->
     {{ $| λ ρ M & n |↘ m }} )
| eval_app_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ $| ⇑ (Π a ρ B) m & n |↘ ⇑ b (m (⇓ a n)) }} )
where "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" := (eval_app m n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_snd : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_snd_pair :
  `( {{ π₂ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ b }} )
| eval_snd_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ a (fst m) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ π₂ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ b (snd m) }} )
where "'π₂' n '↘' r" := (eval_snd n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_eqrec : domain -> exp -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_eqrec_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ br }} ->
     {{ eqrec refl n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ br }} )
| eval_eqrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m1 ↦ m2 ↦ ⇑ c n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ eqrec ⇑ c n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ b (eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end) }} )
where "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_sub : sub -> env -> env -> Prop :=
| eval_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⟦ Id ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ }} )
| eval_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⟦ Wk ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ ↯ }} )
| eval_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ,, M ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ↦ m }} )
| eval_sub_compose :
  `( {{ ⟦ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρτ ↘ ρτσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ∘ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτσ }} )
where "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" := (eval_sub σ ρ ρσ) (in custom judg)
.

Scheme eval_exp_mut_ind := Induction for eval_exp Sort Prop
with eval_natrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_natrec Sort Prop
with eval_app_mut_ind := Induction for eval_app Sort Prop
with eval_snd_mut_ind := Induction for eval_snd Sort Prop
with eval_eqrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_eqrec Sort Prop
with eval_sub_mut_ind := Induction for eval_sub Sort Prop
.

Combined Scheme eval_mut_ind from
  eval_exp_mut_ind,
  eval_natrec_mut_ind,
  eval_app_mut_ind,
  eval_snd_mut_ind,
  eval_eqrec_mut_ind,
  eval_sub_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain Evaluation Readback.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export System.

Import Domain_Notations.

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive initial_env : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| initial_env_nil : initial_env nil empty_env
| initial_env_cons :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     initial_env (A :: Γ) d{{{ ρ ↦ ⇑! a (length Γ) }}}).

Inductive nbe : ctx -> exp -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m in (length Γ) ↘ w }} ->
     nbe Γ M A w ).

Inductive nbe_ty : ctx -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_ty_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rtyp m in (length Γ) ↘ W }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ M W ).

So essentially the whole library is minimal. The task: prove soundness and completeness. The library seems to be stripped down from the real mctt project, with all lemmas removed. I need to prove these two theorems from scratch. That's a large undertaking: soundness and completeness of bidirectional type checking typically require substantial lemmas about NbE/presupposition, etc. But maybe many proof obligations can be avoided.

Let me think carefully about what's needed.

First, soundness: `alg_type_check_sound`: forall Γ i A M, alg_type_check Γ A M -> wf_ctx Γ -> wf_exp Γ (Type@i) A -> wf_exp Γ A M.

Actually the statement is: {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}.

So we have a well-formedness hypothesis on Γ and A (A is a type). We show declarative typing.

The alg_type_check inductively derived; need mutual induction with alg_type_infer: infer Γ A M -> wf_ctx Γ -> (something about A?) -> wf_exp Γ A M? Actually for infer, the inferred type A is an nf. We need `{{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}` where A : nf coerced to exp. But we need A well-formed? Presumably inferred types are well-formed types. Hmm, soundness statement only gives well-formedness for the checking judgment's A. For infer judgment, we need to show wf_exp Γ A M with A the nf (as exp). That should be provable if we also prove that A is a well-formed type... but wait, is A a well-formed type in the declarative system? For infer the type is a normal form; e.g., ati_typ infers Type@i : Type@(S i), fine.

Actually, for soundness of inference, we may need to prove `{{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}` for some i as part of the conclusion. Let's think: to prove wf_exp Γ A M via constructors, we need e.g. for ati_app: M infers Π A B; N checks A; conclusion C = nbe of B[Id,,N]. We need wf_exp Γ C (M N). But wf_app gives wf_exp Γ (B[Id,,N]) (M N), with B the syntactic type from the inferred Pi. C is the nbe_ty normal form of B[Id,,N], which is definitionally equal but not syntactically equal. So we need a lemma that nbe_ty Γ X C implies wf_exp Γ X M -> wf_exp Γ C M (or equality conversion). This is "nbe_ty soundness": nbe_ty Γ A C implies Γ ⊢ A ≈ C : Type@i (or similar), requiring presupposition lemmas.

That's a big infrastructure. Hmm, the real mctt project has these lemmas (in Presup.v, Readback/Properties.v, etc.), which are all stripped here. So I need to build them.

Wait — but maybe the intended solution is to add helper lemmas, and it may be possible to prove soundness/completeness more directly by exploiting that hypotheses are strong? Let's examine.

For soundness: hypothesis `{{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}` for the checking case. Induction on alg_type_check derivation. The atc_ati case: M infers A and A ⊆ B; we have wf_exp Γ B (Type@i) (checking type B is a type). Need show wf_exp Γ M B. From infer: wf_exp Γ A M with A : nf? Note that in the infer judgment the type is an nf. But the type as nf coerced to exp. We need relate A (nf) and B (exp) via subtyping and well-formedness.

Actually soundness of alg_subtyping: `Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B` implies declarative `Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B` under wf hypotheses. That requires nbe lemmas.

This is heavily dependent on semantic properties. Let me check if there are any other supplied lemmas anywhere in the theories (maybe .vo files precompiled?). Let me look at Makefile and check the compiled artifacts. Also perhaps there are compiled `.vo` files that contain more than sources? Let's check the theories directory tree and Makefile.

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Typing Require Import Definitions.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Frontend Require Import Elaborator.
Import Domain_Notations.

(* A cumulative, fuel-indexed semantic realizability relation on domain values.
   ST n a      : a is a semantic type at level n
   VT n a v    : v is a semantic term of type a at level n
   EQT n a b   : a and b are equal semantic types at level n
   EQV n a v w : v and w are equal semantic terms of type a at level n        *)

Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    ST n' a /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ => True
    | d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
    | d_neut _ => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    VT n' a v /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        (* inlined ST (S n') v *)
        ST n' v /\
        match v with
        | d_univ _ => True
        | d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
        | d_neut _ => True
        | _ => False
        end
    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists w, v = d_neut w)
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
        \/ (exists w, v = d_neut w)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists w, v = d_neut w)
    | d_neut _ => exists w, v = d_neut w
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQT n' a b /\
    match a, b with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
    | d_neut _, d_neut _ => True
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQV n' a v w /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        (* inlined EQT (S n') v w *)
        EQT n' v w /\
        match v, w with
        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
        | d_nat, d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
            EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
        | d_neut _, d_neut _ => True
        | _, _ => False
        end
    | d_nat =>
        (v = d_zero /\ w = d_zero) \/
        (exists m m', v = d_succ m /\ w = d_succ m' /\ EQV n' d_nat m m') \/
        (exists v' w', v = d_neut v' /\ w = d_neut w')
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        (forall v0 v0', EQV n' a0 v0 v0' ->

                             eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0') b' /\
                             eval_app v v0 r /\ eval_app w v0' r' /\ EQV n' b r r')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2, v = d_pair v1 v2) /\ (exists w1 w2, w = d_pair w1 w2)
        \/ (exists v' w', v = d_neut v' /\ w = d_neut w')
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ w = d_refl m)
        \/ (exists v' w', v = d_neut v' /\ w = d_neut w')
    | d_neut _ => exists v' w', v = d_neut v' /\ w = d_neut w'
    | _ => False
    end

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Typing Require Import Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Frontend Require Import Elaborator.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia PeanoNat.

Import Domain_Notations.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic evaluation / readback determinism                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eval_fst_det : forall m r, eval_fst m r -> forall r', eval_fst m r' -> r = r'.
Proof.
  intros m r H. induction H; intros r' H'; inversion H'; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eval_det :
  (forall e ρ d, eval_exp e ρ d -> forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d') /\
  (forall A MZ MS m ρ r, eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r -> forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m n r, eval_app m n r -> forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m r, eval_snd m r -> forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r, eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r -> forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall σ ρ ρσ, eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ').
Proof.
  apply (eval_mut_ind
    (fun e ρ d _ => forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d')
    (fun A MZ MS m ρ r _ => forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun m n r _ => forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r')
    (fun m r _ => forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r')
    (fun a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r _ => forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun σ ρ ρσ _ => forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
  all: try solve [eapply eval_fst_det; eassumption].
Qed.

Definition eval_exp_fun := proj1 eval_det.
Definition eval_natrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 eval_det).
Definition eval_app_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)).
Definition eval_snd_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det))).
Definition eval_eqrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).
Definition eval_sub_fun := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).

Lemma read_det :
  (forall s m W, read_nf s m W -> forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_ne s m W -> forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_typ s m W -> forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W').
Proof.

    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d, H2 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_exp_fun e r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d, H2 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_natrec_fun A MZ MS m r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d, H2 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_app_fun m n d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_snd ?m ?d, H2 : eval_snd ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_snd_fun m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E

Lemma wf_all_ctx :

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Subtyping Require Export Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom nf).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive alg_type_check : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| atc_ati :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" := (alg_type_check Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with alg_type_infer : ctx -> nf -> exp -> Prop :=
| ati_typ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a Type@i ⟹ Type@(S i) }} )
| ati_nat :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a ℕ ⟹ Type@0 }} )
| ati_zero :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a zero ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a succ M ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a MZ ⟸ A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢a MS ⟸ A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ A[Id,,M] }}} B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟹ B }} )
| ati_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Π A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a M ⟹ B }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a λ A M ⟹ Π C B }} )
| ati_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M N ⟹ C }} )
| ati_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Σ A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ , A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ B[Id,,M1] }} ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ }}} {{{ A }}} A' ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ , A }}} {{{ B }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a ⟨ M1 : A ; M2 : B ⟩ ⟹ Σ A' C }} )
| ati_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a fst M ⟹ A }} )
| ati_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,fst M] }}} C ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a snd M ⟹ C }} )
| ati_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Eq A M1 M2 ⟹ Type@i }} )
| ati_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     nbe Γ M A N ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a refl A M ⟹ Eq C N N }} )
| ati_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a BR ⟸ B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟹ C }} )
| ati_vlookup :
  `( {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a #x ⟹ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" := (alg_type_infer Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Scheme alg_type_check_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_check Sort Prop
with alg_type_infer_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_infer Sort Prop.

  alg_type_check_mut_ind,
  alg_type_infer_mut_ind.

content.thinking:
Evaluation relations are total for all expressions? Variables fine. Application eval_app_fn requires `⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m` where M is the function body; all expressions eval. eval_app has exactly two constructors depending on m: d_fn or d_neut. But m could be d_univ, d_nat, d_zero, etc., for ill-typed applications. So eval_app is NOT total; but for well-typed applications, m is a function or neutral, so total. Thus evaluation totality needs typing/invariant.

Regarding readback: read_ne over domain_ne is total? d_var yes; d_app m n requires read_ne m and read_nf n (domain_nf d_dom a b). read_nf on d_neut requires read_ne; on d_fn requires evaluating body with extended env and recursively reading; etc. Could be total for well-typed values. read_typ d_zero no rule, but d_zero isn't a type value.

So the semantic relation picture is inevitable.

Given the scale, maybe aim to prove the targets using a *big hammer*: the target statements might be derivable by applying supplied `syntactic_wf_mut_ind` schemes? No.

Could we exploit `wf_exp_subtyp` with a circular derivation? To prove Γ ⊢ M : A from Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A, perhaps if we can show Γ ⊢ A : Type@i and use wf_exp_subtyp with something? Need Γ ⊢ M : A0 and A0 ⊆ A. We have no typing.

Maybe algorithmic check judgment can be inverted to get enough: atc_ati gives Γ ⊢a M ⟹ A' and Γ ⊢a A' ⊆ B. If infer soundness gives Γ ⊢ M : A', and subtyping soundness gives Γ ⊢ A' ⊆ B, then wf_exp_subtyp with Γ ⊢ B : Type@i gives Γ ⊢ M : B. So soundness reduces to infer soundness + subtyping soundness + A' well-formed typing (needed as the type in declarative typing? wf_exp_subtyp needs Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i — where does that come from? infer soundness should also yield typing of the inferred type).

Infer soundness: each alg rule needs nbe equalities. Let's try to prove nbe_ty soundness and nbe term soundness. Maybe we can do it with a *syntactic logical relation* avoiding closures by proving:
`nbe_ty_sound : forall Γ M W, nbe_ty Γ M W -> forall i A, Γ ⊢ M : A -> ...` hmm M is a type expression; nbe_ty expects typ (all exp?). nbe_ty's M : typ = exp. 

Actually the needed facts are *equalities in the declarative theory*. Could we prove them by induction on the nbe_ty derivation using **eval/readback inversion at concrete syntactic type expressions**, after unfolding the environment? For algorithmic rules, the nbe_ty input expressions are built from subterms with known typings. But still arbitrary env.

Let me consider proving a general result by strong induction on the *typing derivation* of the expression being normalized:
`nbe_ty_sound_ty : Γ ⊢ M : Type@i -> forall W, nbe_ty Γ M W -> Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : Type@i` (where W coerced to exp).
Proof by induction on Γ ⊢ M : Type@i? The derivation can use wf_exp_sub and wf_exp_subtyp; nbe_ty is about M with initial env. To relate, need:

Lemma alg_subtyping_nf_refl : forall A, {{ ⊢anf A ⊆ A }}.
Proof.
  intro A. induction A.
  - apply asnf_univ. lia.
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_pi; [reflexivity|exact IHA2].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_sigma; [reflexivity|exact IHA2].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Semantic realizability on domain values (fuel-indexed, cumulative) *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    ST n' a /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ => True
    | d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
    | d_neut _ _ => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    VT n' a v /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        ST n' v /\
        match v with
        | d_univ _ => True
        | d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
        | d_neut _ _ => True
        | _ => False
        end
    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
        \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQT n' a b /\
    match a, b with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
    | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQV n' a v w /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        EQT n' v w /\
        match v, w with
        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
        | d_nat, d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
            EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
        | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
        | _, _ => False
        end
    | d_nat =>
        (v = d_zero /\ w = d_zero) \/
        (exists m m', v = d_succ m /\ w = d_succ m' /\ EQV n' d_nat m m') \/
        (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        (forall v0 v0', EQV n' a0 v0 v0' ->
           exists r r' b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\
                             eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0') b' /\
                             eval_app v v0 r /\ eval_app w v0' r' /\ EQV n' b r r')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2, v = d_pair v1 v2) /\ (exists w1 w2, w = d_pair w1 w2)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ w = d_refl m)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w'
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Lemma ST_down1 : forall n a, ST (S n) a -> ST n a.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma VT_down1 : forall n a v, VT (S n) a v -> VT n a v.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQT_down1 : forall n a b, EQT (S n) a b -> EQT n a b.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQV_down1 : forall n a v w, EQV (S n) a v w -> EQV n a v w.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.

Lemma ST_down : forall n m a, m <= n -> ST n a -> ST m a.
Proof.
  intros n m a Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply ST_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma VT_down : forall n m a v, m <= n -> VT n a v -> VT m a v.
Proof.
  intros n m a v Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply VT_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma EQT_down : forall n m a b, m <= n -> EQT n a b -> EQT m a b.
Proof. intros n m a b Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQT_down1. exact H. Qed.
Lemma EQV_down : forall n m a v w, m <= n -> EQV n a v w -> EQV m a v w.
Proof. intros n m a v w Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQV_down1. exact H. Qed.

Lemma ST_univ : forall n i, ST n (d_univ i).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_nat_ty : forall n, ST n d_nat.
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_neutral_val : forall n a w, ST n (d_neut a w).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma VT_neutral : forall n a w, ST n a -> VT n a (d_neut a w).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros a w HST.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HST as [HSTn Hcl].
    split; [exact (IH a w HSTn)|].
    destruct a as [i| | |m|a0 e B|e M|a0 e B|v1 v2|a1 m1 m2|m|ty ww]; simpl in *.
    + split; [apply ST_neutral_val|]. exact I.
    + right; right; exists d_nat, w; reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. intros v0 HV0.
      destruct (Hfam v0 HV0) as [b [Hb HSTb]].
      exists (d_neut b (d_app w (d_dom a0 v0))), b.
      split; [exact Hb|]. split.
      * eapply eval_app_neut. exact Hb.
      * apply IH. exact HSTb.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. right. exists (d_sigma a0 e B), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha Hm1 Hm2]. right. exists (d_eq a1 m1 m2), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exists (d_neut ty ww), w. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Realizing environments                                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive Renv (n : nat) : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| Renv_nil : Renv n nil empty_env
| Renv_cons : forall Γ ρ A a b,
    Renv n Γ ρ ->
    eval_exp A ρ b ->
    VT n b a ->
    Renv n (A :: Γ) (extend_env ρ a).

Lemma Renv_down : forall n Γ ρ, Renv (S n) Γ ρ -> Renv n Γ ρ.
Proof.
  intros n Γ ρ H. induction H as [| Γ ρ A a b HR IH He HVT].
  - apply Renv_nil.
  - eapply Renv_cons.
    + exact IH.
    + exact He.
    + apply VT_down1. exact HVT.
Qed.

Lemma Renv_lookup : forall Γ x A, ctx_lookup x A Γ -> forall n ρ,
  Renv n Γ ρ -> exists b, eval_exp A ρ b /\ VT n b (ρ x).
Proof.
  intros Γ x A Hlk. induction Hlk as [A0 Γ0 | n0 A0 Γ0 B Hn IH]; intros n ρ HR.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    exists b. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact H2.
    + exact H4.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    destruct (IH _ _ H1) as [b' [Hb HVT]].
    exists b'. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact Hb.
    + exact HVT.
Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Weakening (level shift) of normal forms / neutral forms      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint wk_nf (s : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
  end
with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)

(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    ST n' a /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ => True
    | d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
    | d_neut _ _ => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    VT n' a v /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        ST n' v /\
        match v with
        | d_univ _ => True
        | d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
        | d_neut _ _ => True
        | _ => False
        end
    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
        \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQT n' a b /\
    match a, b with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
    | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQV n' a v w /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        EQT n' v w /\
        match v, w with
        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
        | d_nat, d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
            EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
        | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
        | _, _ => False
        end
    | d_nat =>
        (v = d_zero /\ w = d_zero) \/
        (exists m m', v = d_succ m /\ w = d_succ m' /\ EQV n' d_nat m m') \/
        (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        (forall v0 v0', EQV n' a0 v0 v0' ->
           exists r r' b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\
                             eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0') b' /\
                             eval_app v v0 r /\ eval_app w v0' r' /\ EQV n' b r r')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2, v = d_pair v1 v2) /\ (exists w1 w2, w = d_pair w1 w2)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ w = d_refl m)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w'
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Lemma ST_down1 : forall n a, ST (S n) a -> ST n a.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma VT_down1 : forall n a v, VT (S n) a v -> VT n a v.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQT_down1 : forall n a b, EQT (S n) a b -> EQT n a b.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQV_down1 : forall n a v w, EQV (S n) a v w -> EQV n a v w.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.

Lemma ST_down : forall n m a, m <= n -> ST n a -> ST m a.
Proof.
  intros n m a Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply ST_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma VT_down : forall n m a v, m <= n -> VT n a v -> VT m a v.
Proof.
  intros n m a v Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply VT_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma EQT_down : forall n m a b, m <= n -> EQT n a b -> EQT m a b.
Proof. intros n m a b Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQT_down1. exact H. Qed.
Lemma EQV_down : forall n m a v w, m <= n -> EQV n a v w -> EQV m a v w.
Proof. intros n m a v w Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQV_down1. exact H. Qed.

Lemma ST_univ : forall n i, ST n (d_univ i).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_nat_ty : forall n, ST n d_nat.
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_neutral_val : forall n a w, ST n (d_neut a w).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma VT_neutral : forall n a w, ST n a -> VT n a (d_neut a w).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros a w HST.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HST as [HSTn Hcl].
    split; [exact (IH a w HSTn)|].
    destruct a as [i| | |m|a0 e B|e M|a0 e B|v1 v2|a1 m1 m2|m|ty ww]; simpl in *.
    + split; [apply ST_neutral_val|]. exact I.
    + right; right; exists d_nat, w; reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. intros v0 HV0.
      destruct (Hfam v0 HV0) as [b [Hb HSTb]].
      exists (d_neut b (d_app w (d_dom a0 v0))), b.
      split; [exact Hb|]. split.
      * eapply eval_app_neut. exact Hb.
      * apply IH. exact HSTb.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. right. exists (d_sigma a0 e B), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha Hm1 Hm2]. right. exists (d_eq a1 m1 m2), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exists (d_neut ty ww), w. reflexivity.
Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Realizing environments                                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive Renv (n : nat) : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| Renv_nil : Renv n nil empty_env
| Renv_cons : forall Γ ρ A a b,
    Renv n Γ ρ ->
    eval_exp A ρ b ->
    VT n b a ->
    Renv n (A :: Γ) (extend_env ρ a).

Lemma Renv_down : forall n Γ ρ, Renv (S n) Γ ρ -> Renv n Γ ρ.
Proof.
  intros n Γ ρ H. induction H as [| Γ ρ A a b HR IH He HVT].
  - apply Renv_nil.
  - eapply Renv_cons.
    + exact IH.
    + exact He.
    + apply VT_down1. exact HVT.
Qed.

Lemma Renv_lookup : forall Γ x A, ctx_lookup x A Γ -> forall n ρ,
  Renv n Γ ρ -> exists b, eval_exp A ρ b /\ VT n b (ρ x).
Proof.
  intros Γ x A Hlk. induction Hlk as [A0 Γ0 | n0 A0 Γ0 B Hn IH]; intros n ρ HR.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    exists b. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact H2.
    + exact H4.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    destruct (IH _ _ H1) as [b' [Hb HVT]].
    exists b'. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact Hb.
    + exact HVT.
Qed.

Fixpoint wk_nf (s : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
  end
with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (wk_ne s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (wk_nf (S s) A) (wk_nf s MZ) (wk_nf (S (S s)) MS) (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S (S (S s))) B) (wk_nf (S s) BR)
               (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s M') (wk_ne s N)
  end.

What if we *ignore* nbe results and use the syntactic types from declarative rules, then use subtyping reflexivity? For check soundness, the conclusion type B is given; alg check could be atc_ati with inferred A and subtyping A⊆B. If we can show Γ ⊢ M : A and Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B declaratively then done. So we need alg infer soundness yielding M : A and declaration A⊆B from alg subtyping. For variable: infer gives B (nbe of lookup A). Need #x : B. We have #x : A; need Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B. nbe_ty Γ A B, soundness of nbe gives A ≈ B, hence subtyping refl. So we still need nbe equality but here A is the lookup type, an arbitrary well-typed type expression. Completeness: At variable, user_exp #x and Γ ⊢ #x : A. Inversion of wf_exp with user_exp #x: only wf_vlookup (or wf_exp_subtyp). So lookup #x : A0, A0 ⊆ A. Alg infer #x gives nbe_ty Γ A0 B. So the central pillars:
(P1) nbe_ty sound: nbe_ty Γ A B -> Γ ⊢ A ≈ B : Type@i (when A : Type@i) and Γ ⊢ B : Type@i.
(P2) nbe sound: nbe Γ M A B -> Γ ⊢ M ≈ B : A and Γ ⊢ B : A.
(P3) alg_subtyping sound: alg_subtyping Γ A B -> Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B.

with wf_exp_eq : ctx -> typ -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_exp_eq_typ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i[σ] ≈ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_exp_eq_nat_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ[σ] ≈ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_exp_eq_zero_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero[σ] ≈ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (succ M)[σ] ≈ succ (M[σ]) : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M ≈ succ M' : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_cong :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ ≈ MZ' : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS ≈ MS' : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ rec M' return A' | zero -> MZ' | succ -> MS' end : A[Id,,M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end[σ] ≈ rec M[σ] return A[q σ] | zero -> MZ[σ] | succ -> MS[q (q σ)] end : A[σ,,M[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_zero :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec zero return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_succ :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec succ M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MS[Id,,M,,rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end] : A[Id,,succ M] }} )

| wf_exp_eq_pi_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Π A B)[σ] ≈ Π A[σ] B[q σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M ≈ M' : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : Π A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (λ A M)[σ] ≈ λ A[σ] M[q σ] : (Π A B)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N ≈ M' N' : B[Id,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : A }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_pi_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_pi_eta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_sigma_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_sigma_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B ≈ Σ A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ≈ ⟨ M' : A' ; N' : B' ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_fst_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_fst_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (fst M)[σ] ≈ fst (M[σ]) : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M ≈ snd M' : B[Id,,fst M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->

| wf_exp_eq_fst_beta :

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Typing Require Import Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Frontend Require Import Elaborator.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia PeanoNat.

Import Domain_Notations.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic evaluation / readback determinism                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eval_fst_det : forall m r, eval_fst m r -> forall r', eval_fst m r' -> r = r'.
Proof.
  intros m r H. induction H; intros r' H'; inversion H'; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eval_det :
  (forall e ρ d, eval_exp e ρ d -> forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d') /\
  (forall A MZ MS m ρ r, eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r -> forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m n r, eval_app m n r -> forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m r, eval_snd m r -> forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r, eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r -> forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall σ ρ ρσ, eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ').
Proof.
  apply (eval_mut_ind
    (fun e ρ d _ => forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d')
    (fun A MZ MS m ρ r _ => forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun m n r _ => forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r')
    (fun m r _ => forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r')
    (fun a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r _ => forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun σ ρ ρσ _ => forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
  all: try solve [eapply eval_fst_det; eassumption].
Qed.

Definition eval_exp_fun := proj1 eval_det.
Definition eval_natrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 eval_det).
Definition eval_app_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)).
Definition eval_snd_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det))).
Definition eval_eqrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).
Definition eval_sub_fun := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).

Lemma read_det :
  (forall s m W, read_nf s m W -> forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_ne s m W -> forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_typ s m W -> forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W').
Proof.
  apply (read_mut_ind
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d, H2 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_exp_fun e r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d, H2 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_natrec_fun A MZ MS m r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d, H2 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_app_fun m n d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_snd ?m ?d, H2 : eval_snd ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_snd_fun m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d, H2 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_eqrec_fun a B BR m1 m2 n r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d, H2 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_sub_fun s r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_fst ?m ?d, H2 : eval_fst ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_fst_det m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_det : forall Γ ρ1, initial_env Γ ρ1 -> forall ρ2, initial_env Γ ρ2 -> ρ1 = ρ2.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ1 H1 ρ2 H2; inversion H1; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply IH; eassumption). subst ρ0.
    assert (Ha : a = a0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst a0.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_det : forall Γ A W, nbe_ty Γ A W -> forall W', nbe_ty Γ A W' -> W = W'.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W H. intros W' H'. inversion H; inversion H'; subst.
  assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply initial_env_det; eassumption). subst ρ0.
  assert (Hm : m = m0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst m0.
  exact (proj2 (proj2 (read_det)) _ _ _ H2 _ H8).
Qed.

Lemma nbe_det : forall Γ M A W, nbe Γ M A W -> forall W', nbe Γ M A W' -> W = W'.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. intros W' H'. inversion H; inversion H'; subst.
  assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply initial_env_det; eassumption). subst ρ0.
  assert (Ha : a = a0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst a0.
  assert (Hm : m = m0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst m0.
  exact (proj1 (read_det) (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W H3 W' H11).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context/typing facts                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma wf_ctx_prefix : forall {Γ A}, {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_all_ctx :
  (forall Γ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}) /\
  (forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}).
Proof.
  apply (syntactic_wf_mut_ind'
    (fun Γ _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})
    (fun Γ A M _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})
    (fun Γ Δ σ _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})).
  - exact wf_ctx_empty.
  - intros Γ i A w IH w0 IH0. apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact IH | exact w0].
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros Γ i A MZ MS M w IH w0 IH0 w1 IH1 w2 IH2. apply wf_ctx_prefix in IH. exact IH.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_ctx : forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 wf_all_ctx) Γ A M H). Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_ctx : forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 wf_all_ctx) Γ Δ σ H). Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Algorithmic normal-form subtyping: reflexivity               *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma alg_subtyping_nf_refl : forall A, {{ ⊢anf A ⊆ A }}.
