add=r'''
(* ============================================================ *)
(* Substitution helpers for universes and general types         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma wf_subst_type : forall Γ Δ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ A i Hσ HA. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp.
  - eapply wf_exp_sub; [exact Hσ | exact HA].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_retype : forall Γ Δ σ i M M',
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : (Type@i)[σ] }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ i M M' Hσ Heq. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [exact Heq| |].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_cong_univ : forall Γ Δ σ σ' A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢s σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ σ' A i Hσ Hσ' Hseq HA.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype; [exact Hσ|].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
  - exact Hseq.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ : forall Γ Γ' Γ'' τ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s τ : Γ' }} -> {{ Γ' ⊢s σ : Γ'' }} ->
  {{ Γ'' ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[a_compose σ τ] ≈ (A[σ])[τ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Γ' Γ'' τ σ A i Hτ Hσ HA.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype; [apply wf_sub_compose; eassumption|].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose.
  - exact Hτ.
  - exact Hσ.
  - exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A[a_id] ≈ A : Type@i }}.
Proof. intros. apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id. exact H. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_conv : forall Γ A A' M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A A' M i HM Heq HA'.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [exact HM|exact HA'|].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [exact HA'|exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_extend_id_self : forall Γ A M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢s a_extend a_id M : A :: Γ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A M i HM HA. apply wf_exp_ctx in HM as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s a_id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ A[a_id] : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hid|exact HA]).
  assert (Heq : {{ Γ ⊢ A[a_id] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id; exact HA).
  assert (HM' : {{ Γ ⊢ M : A[a_id] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq | exact HAid]).
  eapply wf_sub_extend; [exact Hid|exact HA|exact HM'].
Qed.
'''

Lemma sub_double_wk_extend_approx : forall Γ A M1 M2 i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : (A[Id]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ A : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A M1 M2 i HA HM1 HM2.
  apply wf_exp_ctx in HA as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); assumption).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); assumption).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ1:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list)
      (Γ2:=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
      (σ2:=a_weaken) (σ1:=a_weaken); assumption. }
  assert (Hcomp : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[(Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)]) ≈ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ with
          (Γ:=Γ) (Γ':=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ'':=Γ)
          (τ:=a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2) (σ:=a_compose a_weaken a_weaken)
          (A:=A) (i:=i); eassumption).
  assert (Hsubeq1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ (Id ,, M1)) ≈ Id : Γ }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_eq_p_extend; [exact Hid|exact HA|exact HM1]).
  assert (Hsubeq2 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_eq_p_extend; [exact Hσ1|exact HAwk|exact HM2]).
  assert (Hsubeq2' : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }})
    by exact Hsubeq2.
  assert (Hcompose_cong : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2))) ≈ (Wk ∘ (Id ,, M1)) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_cong with
      (Γ:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ':=Γ)
      (τ:=a_compose a_weaken (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2))
      (τ':=a_extend a_id M1)
      (Γ'':=Γ) (σ:=a_weaken) (σ':=a_weaken).
    - exact Hsubeq2.
    - eapply wf_sub_eq_refl. exact HWk1. }
  assert (Hassoc : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ (Wk ∘ (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2))) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_assoc with
      (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ:=Γ) (σ:=a_weaken)
      (Γ'':=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (σ':=a_weaken)
      (Γ''':=Γ) (σ'':=a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2).
    - exact HWk1.
    - exact HWk2.
    - exact Hσ2. }
  assert (Hsubeq : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ Id : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_eq_trans; [exact Hassoc|].
    eapply wf_sub_eq_trans; [exact Hcompose_cong|exact Hsubeq1]. }
  assert (HWWσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (((a_compose a_weaken a_weaken) ∘ (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2))) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_compose with
      (Γ1:=Γ) (Γ2:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
      (σ2:=a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2)
      (σ1:=a_compose a_weaken a_weaken); assumption. }
  assert (Hcong : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[(Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)]) ≈ (A[Id]) : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong_univ with
      (Δ:=Γ) (σ:=a_compose (a_compose a_weaken a_weaken) (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2))
      (σ':=a_id).
    - exact HWWσ.
    - exact Hid.
    - exact Hsubeq.
    - exact HA. }
  assert (HId : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ A : Type@i }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HA).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hcomp|].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact Hcong|exact HId].
Qed.
'''
marker="(* ============================================================ *)\n(* Presupposition: lookup types and typing of types"
s=s.replace(marker, add+"\n"+marker)
open('Task.v','w').write(s)
EOF

Lemma eqrec_ctx_typing : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  ({{ A[Wk] :: A :: Γ ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }} /\
   {{ A[Wk] :: A :: Γ ⊢ #1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\
   {{ A[Wk] :: A :: Γ ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\
   {{ A[Wk] :: A :: Γ ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 : Type@i }}).
Proof.
  intros Γ A i HA. apply wf_exp_ctx in HA as Hwf.
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); exact HA).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); exact HAwk).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ1:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list)
      (Γ2:=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
      (σ2:=a_weaken) (σ1:=a_weaken); assumption. }
  assert (HAc : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HL : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Wk]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Happrox : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) ≈ (A[Wk])[Wk] : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ with
      (Γ:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ'':=Γ)
      (τ:=a_weaken) (σ:=a_weaken) (A:=A) (i:=i); eassumption. }
  assert (Hlk0 : {{ #0 : (A[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by apply here.
  assert (Hlk1 : {{ #1 : (A[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply there; apply here).
  assert (HM1 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : ((A[Wk])[Wk]) }})
    by (apply wf_vlookup; assumption).
  assert (HM0 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : ((A[Wk])[Wk]) }})
    by (apply wf_vlookup; assumption).
  assert (HM1' : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM1|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Happrox|exact HAc]).
  assert (HM0' : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM0|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Happrox|exact HAc]).
  assert (HC : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_eq; assumption).
  repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).

From Coq Require Import Lia List MSets PeanoNat String FunInd.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import Syntax.

Open Scope string_scope.

Module StrSet := Make String_as_OT.

Module StrSProp := MSetProperties.Properties StrSet.

Notation "s [<=] t" := (StrSet.Subset s t) (at level 70, no associativity).

Fixpoint lookup (s : string) (ctx : list string) : option nat :=
  match ctx with
  | nil => None
  | c::cs =>
      if string_dec c s
      then Some 0
      else
        match lookup s cs with
        | Some n => Some (n + 1)%nat
        | None => None
        end
  end
.

Fixpoint elaborate (cst : Cst.obj) (ctx : list string) : option exp :=
  match cst with
  | Cst.var s =>
      match lookup s ctx with
      | Some n => Some (a_var n)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.typ n => Some (a_typ n)
  | Cst.nat => Some a_nat
  | Cst.zero => Some a_zero
  | Cst.succ c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_succ a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sr s =>
      match elaborate m (mx :: ctx), elaborate z ctx, elaborate s (sr :: sx :: ctx), elaborate n ctx with
      | Some m, Some z, Some s, Some n => Some (a_natrec m z s n)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pi s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_pi t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fn s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_fn t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.app c1 c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | None, _ => None
      | _, None => None
      | Some a1, Some a2 => Some (a_app a1 a2)
      end
  | Cst.sigma s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_sigma t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx,  elaborate t1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx, elaborate t2 (s::ctx) with
      | Some a1, Some b1, Some a2, Some b2 => Some (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fst c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_fst a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.snd c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_snd a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eq t a1 a2)
      | _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.refl t c =>
 match cst with
  | Cst.var s => StrSet.singleton s
  | Cst.typ n => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.nat => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.zero => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.succ c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sy s => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.remove mx (cst_variables m))) (StrSet.union (cst_variables z) (StrSet.remove sx (StrSet.remove sy (cst_variables s))))
  | Cst.pi s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.fn s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.app c1 c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables c2)
  | Cst.sigma s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables t1)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c2) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables t2)))
  | Cst.fst c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.snd c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2))
  | Cst.refl t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c)
  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove mx (StrSet.remove my (StrSet.remove mz (cst_variables m)))) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove rx (cst_variables r)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2)))))
 end
.

Inductive closed_at : exp -> nat -> Prop :=
 | ca_var : `( x < n -> closed_at (a_var x) n )
 | ca_type : `( closed_at (a_typ m) n )
 | ca_nat : `( closed_at (a_nat) n )
 | ca_zero : `( closed_at (a_zero) n )
 | ca_succ : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_succ a) n )
 | ca_natrec : `( closed_at n l -> closed_at m (1+l) -> closed_at z l -> closed_at s (2+l) -> closed_at (a_natrec m z s n) l )
 | ca_pi : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pi t b) n )
 | ca_lam : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_fn t b) n )
 | ca_app : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_app a1 a2) n )
 | ca_sigma : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_sigma t b) n )
 | ca_pair : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at b1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at b2 (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2) n )
 | ca_fst : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_fst a) n )
 | ca_snd : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_snd a) n )
 | ca_eq : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_eq t a1 a2) n )
 | ca_refl : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_refl t a) n )
 | ca_eqrec : `( closed_at a l -> closed_at m (3+l) -> closed_at r (1+l) -> closed_at m1 l -> closed_at m2 l -> closed_at n l -> closed_at (a_eqrec a m r m1 m2 n) l )
.

Import StrSProp.Dec.

367	Lemma sub_double_wk_extend_approx : forall Γ A M1 M2 i,
368	  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
369	  {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : (A[Id]) }} ->
370	  {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }} ->
371	  {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ A : Type@i }}.
372	Proof.
373	  intros Γ A M1 M2 i HA HM1 HM2.
374	  apply wf_exp_ctx in HA as Hwf.
375	  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
376	  assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
377	  assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
378	  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); assumption).
379	  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
380	  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
381	  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); assumption).
382	  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
383	  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})
384	    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
385	  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }}).
386	  { eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ1:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list)
387	      (Γ2:=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
388	      (σ2:=a_weaken) (σ1:=a_weaken); assumption. }
389	  assert (Hcomp : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[(Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)]) ≈ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }})

391	          (Γ:=Γ) (Γ':=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ'':=Γ)
392	          (τ:=a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2) (σ:=a_compose a_weaken a_weaken)
393	          (A:=A) (i:=i); eassumption).
394	  assert (Hsubeq1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ (Id ,, M1)) ≈ Id : Γ }})
395	    by (eapply wf_sub_eq_p_extend; [exact Hid|exact HA|exact HM1]).
396	  assert (Hsubeq2 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }})
397	    by (eapply wf_sub_eq_p_extend; [exact Hσ1|exact HAwk|exact HM2]).
398	  assert (Hcompose_cong : {{ Γ ⊢s (Wk ∘ (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2))) ≈ (Wk ∘ (Id ,, M1)) : Γ }}).
399	  { eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_cong with
400	      (Γ:=Γ) (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list)
401	      (τ:=a_compose a_weaken (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2))
402	      (τ':=a_extend a_id M1)
403	      (Γ'':=Γ) (σ:=a_weaken) (σ':=a_weaken).
404	    - exact Hsubeq2.
405	    - eapply wf_sub_eq_refl. exact HWk1. }
406	  assert (Hassoc : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ (Wk ∘ (Wk ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2))) : Γ }}).
407	  { eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_assoc with
408	      (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ:=Γ) (σ:=a_weaken)
409	      (Γ'':=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (σ':=a_weaken)
410	      (Γ''':=Γ) (σ'':=a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2).
411	    - exact HWk1.
412	    - exact HWk2.
413	    - exact Hσ2. }
414	  assert (Hsubeq : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)) ≈ Id : Γ }}).
415	  { eapply wf_sub_eq_trans; [exact Hassoc|].
416	    eapply wf_sub_eq_trans; [exact Hcompose_cong|exact Hsubeq1]. }
417	  assert (HWWσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (((Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2))) : Γ }}).
418	  { eapply wf_sub_compose with
419	      (Γ1:=Γ) (Γ2:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)

421	      (σ1:=a_compose a_weaken a_weaken); assumption. }
422	  assert (Hcong : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[(Wk ∘ Wk) ∘ ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2)]) ≈ (A[Id]) : Type@i }}).
423	  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong_univ with
424	      (Δ:=Γ) (σ:=a_compose (a_compose a_weaken a_weaken) (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2))

427	    - exact Hid.
428	    - exact Hsubeq.
429	    - exact HA. }
430	  assert (HId : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ A : Type@i }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HA).
431	  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hcomp|].
432	  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact Hcong|exact HId].
433	Qed.

436	  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
437	  ({{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }} /\
438	   {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\
439	   {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\

442	  intros Γ A i HA. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
443	  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
444	  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
445	  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
446	  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hctx1|exact HAwk]).
447	  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
448	  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }}).
449	  { eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ1:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list)
450	      (Γ2:=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
451	      (σ2:=a_weaken) (σ1:=a_weaken); assumption. }
452	  assert (HAc : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }})
453	    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
454	  assert (HL : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Wk]) : Type@i }})
455	    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
456	  assert (Happrox : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) ≈ (A[Wk])[Wk] : Type@i }}).
457	  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ with
458	      (Γ:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ'':=Γ)
459	      (τ:=a_weaken) (σ:=a_weaken) (A:=A) (i:=i); eassumption. }

461	  assert (Hlk1 : {{ #1 : (A[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply there; apply here).

468	  assert (HM0' : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }})

470	  assert (HC : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 : Type@i }})

534	Lemma wf_eqrec_subst : forall Γ A M1 M2 N B i j,
535	  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
536	  {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : (A[Id]) }} ->
537	  {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }} ->
538	  {{ Γ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
539	  {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
540	  {{ Γ ⊢ B[((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) ,, N] : Type@j }}.
541	Proof.
542	  intros Γ A M1 M2 N B i j HA HM1 HM2 HN HB.
543	  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
544	  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
545	  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
546	  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
547	  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
548	  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hctx1|exact HAwk]).
549	  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
550	  assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
551	  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})
552	    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
553	  destruct (eqrec_ctx_typing Γ A i HA) as [HAc [HMc [HNc HC]]].
554	  assert (Hsub : {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }})
555	    by (eapply eqrec_ctx_sub_approx; eassumption).
556	  assert (Hsub_ty : {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }})
557	    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
558	  assert (HN' : {{ Γ ⊢ N : (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] }})
559	    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HN|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hsub|exact Hsub_ty]).
560	  assert (Hσ3 : {{ Γ ⊢s (((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) ,, N) : Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 }})
561	    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; [exact Hσ2|exact HC|exact HN']).
562	  eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hσ3|exact HB].
563	Qed.

616	(* ============================================================ *)
617	
618	Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
619	  match n with
620	  | O => True
621	  | S n' =>
622	    ST n' a /\
623	    match a with
624	    | d_univ _ => True
625	    | d_nat => True
626	    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
627	        ST n' a0 /\
628	        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
629	    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
630	        ST n' a0 /\
631	        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
632	    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
633	    | d_neut _ _ => True
634	    | _ => False
635	    end
636	  end
637	with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
638	  match n with
639	  | O => True
640	  | S n' =>
641	    VT n' a v /\
642	    match a with
643	    | d_univ _ =>
644	        ST n' v /\
645	        match v with
646	        | d_univ _ => True
647	        | d_nat => True
648	        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
649	            ST n' a0 /\
650	            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
651	        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
652	            ST n' a0 /\
653	            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
654	        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
655	        | d_neut _ _ => True
656	        | _ => False
657	        end
658	    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
659	    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
660	        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
661	          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
662	    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
663	        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
664	                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
665	        \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
666	    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
667	        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
668	    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w
669	    | _ => False
670	    end
671	  end
672	with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
673	  match n with
674	  | O => True
675	  | S n' =>
676	    EQT n' a b /\
677	    match a, b with
678	    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
679	    | d_nat, d_nat => True
680	    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
681	        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
682	        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
683	           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
684	                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
685	    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
686	        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
687	        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
688	           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
689	                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
690	    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
691	        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
692	    | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
693	    | _, _ => False
694	    end
695	  end
696	with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
697	  match n with
698	  | O => True
699	  | S n' =>
700	    EQV n' a v w /\
701	    match a with
702	    | d_univ _ =>
703	        EQT n' v w /\
704	        match v, w with
705	        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
706	        | d_nat, d_nat => True
707	        | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
708	            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
709	            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
710	               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
711	                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
712	        | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
713	            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
714	            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
715	               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
716	                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
717	        | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
718	            EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
719	        | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
720	        | _, _ => False
721	        end
722	    | d_nat =>
723	        (v = d_zero /\ w = d_zero) \/
724	        (exists m m', v = d_succ m /\ w = d_succ m' /\ EQV n' d_nat m m') \/
725	        (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
726	    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
727	        (forall v0 v0', EQV n' a0 v0 v0' ->
728	           exists r r' b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\
729	                             eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0') b' /\
730	                             eval_app v v0 r /\ eval_app w v0' r' /\ EQV n' b r r')
731	    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
732	        (exists v1 v2, v = d_pair v1 v2) /\ (exists w1 w2, w = d_pair w1 w2)
733	        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
734	    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
735	        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ w = d_refl m)
736	        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
737	    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w'
738	    | _ => False
739	    end
740	  end.

777	Lemma VT_neutral : forall n a w, ST n a -> VT n a (d_neut a w).
778	Proof.
779	  induction n as [| n IH]; intros a w HST.
780	  - exact I.
781	  - destruct HST as [HSTn Hcl].
782	    split; [exact (IH a w HSTn)|].
783	    destruct a as [i| | |m|a0 e B|e M|a0 e B|v1 v2|a1 m1 m2|m|ty ww]; simpl in *.
784	    + split; [apply ST_neutral_val|]. exact I.
785	    + right; right; exists d_nat, w; reflexivity.
786	    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
787	    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
788	    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. intros v0 HV0.
789	      destruct (Hfam v0 HV0) as [b [Hb HSTb]].
790	      exists (d_neut b (d_app w (d_dom a0 v0))), b.
791	      split; [exact Hb|]. split.
792	      * eapply eval_app_neut. exact Hb.
793	      * apply IH. exact HSTb.
794	    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
795	    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. right. exists (d_sigma a0 e B), w. reflexivity.
796	    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
797	    + destruct Hcl as [Ha Hm1 Hm2]. right. exists (d_eq a1 m1 m2), w. reflexivity.
798	    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
799	    + exists (d_neut ty ww), w. reflexivity.
800	Qed.

848	
849	Fixpoint wk_nf (s : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
850	  match W with
851	  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
852	  | nf_nat => nf_nat
853	  | nf_zero => nf_zero
854	  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
855	  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
856	  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
857	  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
858	  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
859	  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
860	  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
861	  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
862	  end
863	with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
864	  match N with
865	  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)
866	  | ne_app M N => ne_app (wk_ne s M) (wk_nf s N)
867	  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (wk_ne s M)
868	  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (wk_ne s M)
869	  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
870	      ne_natrec (wk_nf (S s) A) (wk_nf s MZ) (wk_nf (S (S s)) MS) (wk_ne s M)
871	  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
872	      ne_eqrec (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S (S (S s))) B) (wk_nf (S s) BR)
873	               (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s M') (wk_ne s N)
874	  end.

881	Lemma nbe_ty_typ : forall Γ i W, nbe_ty Γ (a_typ i) W -> W = nf_typ i.
882	Proof.
883	  intros Γ i W H. inversion H; subst.
884	  match goal with Hm : eval_exp (a_typ i) ?ρ ?m |- _ =>

895	    let E := fresh in

906	  inversion H1; subst.
907	  inversion H2; subst.
908	  match goal with
909	  | Ha : read_typ (length Γ) a ?A |- _ =>
910	    match goal with
911	    | Hb : eval_exp A1 (extend_env ρ (d_neut a (d_var (length Γ)))) ?b |- _ =>
912	      match goal with
913	      | HB : read_typ (S (length Γ)) b ?B' |- _ =>
914	          exists A, B'; split; [reflexivity|]; split;
915	          [ eapply nbe_ty_run; [exact H0 | exact H7 | exact Ha]
916	          | eapply nbe_ty_run;
917	            [ eapply initial_env_cons; [exact H0 | exact H7]
918	            | exact Hb | exact HB ] ]

953	  inversion H2; subst.

969	        eapply nbe_run;
970	        [ exact H0
971	        | constructor
972	        | exact He
973	        | eapply read_nf_type; exact Hr ]
974	      end

987	  intros A B C H1 H2. revert C H2. induction H1; intros C' H2.
988	  all: inversion H2; subst.
989	  all: try (eapply asnf_refl; [eassumption|reflexivity]).

992	  all: try (eapply asnf_sigma; [reflexivity| ]).
993	  all: try (match goal with IH : forall X, alg_subtyping_nf ?B' X -> alg_subtyping_nf ?B X |- _ =>
994	               eapply IH; eassumption end).

1003	  assert (B' = A'0) by (eapply nbe_ty_det; [exact H0 | exact H4]). subst A'0.

1014	  forall x, length Γ <= x -> ρ x = d_zero.
1015	Proof.
1016	  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
1017	  - simpl in *. reflexivity.
1018	  - destruct x as [| x]; [simpl in Hx; lia|].
1019	    cbn. apply (IH ρ0 H2 x). simpl in Hx. lia.
1020	Qed.

1022	Lemma initial_env_lookup : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->
1023	  forall x, x < length Γ ->
1024	  exists b, ρ x = d_neut b (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)).
1025	Proof.
1026	  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
1027	  - simpl in Hx; lia.
1028	  - destruct x as [| x].
1029	    + exists a. cbn. replace (length Γ - 0) with (length Γ) by lia. reflexivity.
1030	    + assert (Hx' : x < length Γ) by (simpl in Hx; lia).
1031	      destruct (IH ρ0 H2 x Hx') as [b Hb].
1032	      exists b. cbn. rewrite Hb.
1033	      replace (S (length Γ) - S x - 1) with (length Γ - x - 1) by lia.
1034	      reflexivity.
1035	Qed.
1036	
1037	
1038	Lemma nbe_ty_var : forall Γ x W, nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) W -> W = nf_neut (ne_var x).
1039	Proof.
1040	  intros Γ x W H. inversion H; subst.
1041	  match goal with H : initial_env Γ _ |- _ => rename H into Hie end.
1042	  match goal with H : eval_exp (a_var x) _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hev end.
1043	  match goal with H : read_typ (length Γ) _ W |- _ => rename H into Hrt end.
1044	  inversion Hev; subst.
1045	  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases x (length Γ)) as [Hlt|Hge].
1046	  - destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hie x Hlt) as [b Hb].
1047	    rewrite Hb in Hrt. inversion Hrt; subst.
1048	    match goal with Hn : read_ne (length Γ) (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)) ?B |- _ =>
1049	      rename Hn into Hn0
1050	    end.
1051	    inversion Hn0; subst.
1052	    replace (length Γ - (length Γ - x - 1) - 1) with x by lia. reflexivity.
1053	  - rewrite (initial_env_beyond Γ ρ Hie x Hge) in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
1054	Qed.

1062	    {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
1063	    {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
1064	    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}.
1065	Admitted.

1068	    user_exp M ->
1069	    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
1070	    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }}.

45	| ati_app :

47	     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ A }} ->
48	     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,N] }}} C ->
49	     {{ Γ ⊢a M N ⟹ C }} )
50	| ati_sigma :
51	  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
52	     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
53	     {{ Γ ⊢a Σ A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
54	| ati_pair :
55	  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
56	     {{ Γ , A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
57	     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
58	     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ B[Id,,M1] }} ->
59	     nbe_ty {{{ Γ }}} {{{ A }}} A' ->
60	     nbe_ty {{{ Γ , A }}} {{{ B }}} C ->
61	     {{ Γ ⊢a ⟨ M1 : A ; M2 : B ⟩ ⟹ Σ A' C }} )
62	| ati_fst :

64	      {{ Γ ⊢a fst M ⟹ A }} )
65	| ati_snd :
66	  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
67	      nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,fst M] }}} C ->
68	      {{ Γ ⊢a snd M ⟹ C }} )
69	| ati_eq :
70	  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
71	     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
72	     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
73	     {{ Γ ⊢a Eq A M1 M2 ⟹ Type@i }} )
74	| ati_refl :

76	     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
77	     nbe_ty Γ A C ->

Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    ST n' a /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ => True
    | d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
    | d_neut _ _ => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    VT n' a v /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        ST n' v /\
        match v with
        | d_univ _ => True
        | d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
        | d_neut _ _ => True
        | _ => False
        end
    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
        \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQT n' a b /\
    match a, b with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
    | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQV n' a v w /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        EQT n' v w /\
        match v, w with
        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j

Fixpoint wk_nf (s : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
  end
with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (wk_ne s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (wk_nf (S s) A) (wk_nf s MZ) (wk_nf (S (S s)) MS) (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S (S (S s))) B) (wk_nf (S s) BR)
               (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s M') (wk_ne s N)
  end.

(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma initial_env_beyond : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->
  forall x, length Γ <= x -> ρ x = d_zero.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
  - simpl in *. reflexivity.
  - destruct x as [| x]; [simpl in Hx; lia|].
    cbn. apply (IH ρ0 H2 x). simpl in Hx. lia.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_lookup : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->
  forall x, x < length Γ ->
  exists b, ρ x = d_neut b (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
  - simpl in Hx; lia.
  - destruct x as [| x].
    + exists a. cbn. replace (length Γ - 0) with (length Γ) by lia. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hx' : x < length Γ) by (simpl in Hx; lia).
      destruct (IH ρ0 H2 x Hx') as [b Hb].
      exists b. cbn. rewrite Hb.
      replace (S (length Γ) - S x - 1) with (length Γ - x - 1) by lia.
      reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma nbe_ty_var : forall Γ x W, nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) W -> W = nf_neut (ne_var x).
Proof.
  intros Γ x W H. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with H : initial_env Γ _ |- _ => rename H into Hie end.
  match goal with H : eval_exp (a_var x) _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hev end.
  match goal with H : read_typ (length Γ) _ W |- _ => rename H into Hrt end.
  inversion Hev; subst.
  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases x (length Γ)) as [Hlt|Hge].
  - destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hie x Hlt) as [b Hb].
    rewrite Hb in Hrt. inversion Hrt; subst.
    match goal with Hn : read_ne (length Γ) (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)) ?B |- _ =>
      rename Hn into Hn0
    end.
    inversion Hn0; subst.
    replace (length Γ - (length Γ - x - 1) - 1) with x by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (initial_env_beyond Γ ρ Hie x Hge) in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_var_run : forall Γ x, x < length Γ ->
  forall ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->
  nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) (nf_neut (ne_var x)).
Proof.
  intros Γ x Hx ρ Hρ.
  destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hρ x Hx) as [b Hb].
  assert (Hrt : read_typ (length Γ) (d_neut b (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)))

    replace (ne_var x) with (ne_var (length Γ - (length Γ - x - 1) - 1))

  eapply nbe_ty_run.
  - exact Hρ.
  - apply eval_exp_var.
  - rewrite Hb. exact Hrt.
Qed.

Definition Rsub (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρ : env) : Prop :=
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Hypothesis NTmS : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Hypothesis CtxConvTy : forall Γ A C i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ C : Type@i }} ->
  forall B j, {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@j }} -> {{ Γ, C ⊢ B : Type@j }}.
Hypothesis BranchTy : forall Γ A i j B,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
  {{ Γ, A ⊢ B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] : Type@j }}.

(* The substitution-realizing environment relation used by the intended
   adequacy proof.  It is only a Definition: no axiom is introduced. *)
Definition Rsub (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρ : env) : Prop :=
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

Lemma check_complete_from_infer :
  (forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
       exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}) ->
  (forall Γ A B, {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B }} -> alg_subtyping Γ A B) ->
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> alg_type_check Γ A M.
Proof.
  intros HInfer HSub M Hu Γ A HM.
  destruct (HInfer M Hu Γ A HM) as [B [Hinf Hsub]].
  eapply atc_ati.
  - exact Hinf.
  - eapply HSub. exact Hsub.
Qed.

Definition RsubFundamentalStmt : Prop :=
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A i, {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
        exists a WA, eval_exp A ρ a /\ read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }})
  /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
        exists a m W, eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
          read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }})
  /\
  (forall Δ ρ, {{ ⊢ Δ }} -> initial_env Δ ρ -> Rsub Δ Δ a_id ρ).

Definition InferCompleteUserStmt : Prop :=
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
    forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}.

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Typing Require Import Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Frontend Require Import Elaborator.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia PeanoNat.

Import Domain_Notations.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic evaluation / readback determinism                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eval_fst_det : forall m r, eval_fst m r -> forall r', eval_fst m r' -> r = r'.
Proof.
  intros m r H. induction H; intros r' H'; inversion H'; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eval_det :
  (forall e ρ d, eval_exp e ρ d -> forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d') /\
  (forall A MZ MS m ρ r, eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r -> forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m n r, eval_app m n r -> forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m r, eval_snd m r -> forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r, eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r -> forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall σ ρ ρσ, eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ').
Proof.
  apply (eval_mut_ind
    (fun e ρ d _ => forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d')
    (fun A MZ MS m ρ r _ => forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun m n r _ => forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r')
    (fun m r _ => forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r')
    (fun a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r _ => forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun σ ρ ρσ _ => forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
  all: try solve [eapply eval_fst_det; eassumption].
Qed.

Definition eval_exp_fun := proj1 eval_det.
Definition eval_natrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 eval_det).
Definition eval_app_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)).
Definition eval_snd_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det))).
Definition eval_eqrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).
Definition eval_sub_fun := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).

Lemma read_det :
  (forall s m W, read_nf s m W -> forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_ne s m W -> forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_typ s m W -> forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W').
Proof.
  apply (read_mut_ind
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d, H2 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_exp_fun e r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d, H2 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_natrec_fun A MZ MS m r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d, H2 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_app_fun m n d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_snd ?m ?d, H2 : eval_snd ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_snd_fun m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d, H2 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_eqrec_fun a B BR m1 m2 n r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d, H2 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_sub_fun s r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_fst ?m ?d, H2 : eval_fst ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_fst_det m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_det : forall Γ ρ1, initial_env Γ ρ1 -> forall ρ2, initial_env Γ ρ2 -> ρ1 = ρ2.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ1 H1 ρ2 H2; inversion H1; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply IH; eassumption). subst ρ0.
    assert (Ha : a = a0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst a0.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_det : forall Γ A W, nbe_ty Γ A W -> forall W', nbe_ty Γ A W' -> W = W'.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W H. intros W' H'. inversion H; inversion H'; subst.
  assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply initial_env_det; eassumption). subst ρ0.
  assert (Hm : m = m0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst m0.
  exact (proj2 (proj2 (read_det)) _ _ _ H2 _ H8).
Qed.

Lemma nbe_det : forall Γ M A W, nbe Γ M A W -> forall W', nbe Γ M A W' -> W = W'.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. intros W' H'. inversion H; inversion H'; subst.
  assert (Hρ : ρ = ρ0) by (eapply initial_env_det; eassumption). subst ρ0.
  assert (Ha : a = a0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst a0.
  assert (Hm : m = m0) by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption). subst m0.
  exact (proj1 (read_det) (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W H3 W' H11).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context/typing facts                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma wf_ctx_prefix : forall {Γ A}, {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_all_ctx :
  (forall Γ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}) /\
  (forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}).
Proof.
  apply (syntactic_wf_mut_ind'
    (fun Γ _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})
    (fun Γ A M _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})
    (fun Γ Δ σ _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }})).
  - exact wf_ctx_empty.
  - intros Γ i A w IH w0 IH0. apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact IH | exact w0].
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros Γ i A MZ MS M w IH w0 IH0 w1 IH1 w2 IH2. apply wf_ctx_prefix in IH. exact IH.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
  - intros; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_ctx : forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 wf_all_ctx) Γ A M H). Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_ctx : forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }}.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 wf_all_ctx) Γ Δ σ H). Qed.





(* ============================================================ *)
(* Reflexivity of expression and substitution equality          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma wf_eq_refl_all :
  (forall Γ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> True) /\
  (forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }} -> True) /\
  (forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M : A }}) /\
  (forall Γ A M M', {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} -> True) /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ : Δ }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ σ', {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ }} -> True) /\
  (forall Γ A A', {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} -> True).
Proof.
  apply (syntactic_wf_mut_ind
    (fun _ _ => True)
    (fun _ _ _ => True)

Fixpoint ST (n : nat) (a : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    ST n' a /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ => True
    | d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        ST n' a0 /\
        (forall v, VT n' a0 v -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\ ST n' b)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
    | d_neut _ _ => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with VT (n : nat) (a v : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    VT n' a v /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        ST n' v /\
        match v with
        | d_univ _ => True
        | d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
            ST n' a0 /\
            (forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 -> exists b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ ST n' b)
        | d_eq a m1 m2 => ST n' a /\ VT n' a m1 /\ VT n' a m2
        | d_neut _ _ => True
        | _ => False
        end
    | d_nat => v = d_zero \/ (exists m, v = d_succ m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        forall v0, VT n' a0 v0 ->
          exists r b, eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\ eval_app v v0 r /\ VT n' b r
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2 b, v = d_pair v1 v2 /\ VT n' a0 v1 /\
                         eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v1) b /\ VT n' b v2)
        \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ VT n' a m) \/ (exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w)
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty w, v = d_neut ty w
    | _ => False
    end
  end
with EQT (n : nat) (a b : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQT n' a b /\
    match a, b with
    | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
    | d_nat, d_nat => True
    | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
        EQT n' a0 a0' /\
        (forall v v', EQV n' a0 v v' ->
           exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v) b /\
                        eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' v') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
    | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
        EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
    | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
    | _, _ => False
    end
  end
with EQV (n : nat) (a v w : domain) {struct n} : Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => True
  | S n' =>
    EQV n' a v w /\
    match a with
    | d_univ _ =>
        EQT n' v w /\
        match v, w with
        | d_univ i, d_univ j => i = j
        | d_nat, d_nat => True
        | d_pi a0 ρ B, d_pi a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_sigma a0 ρ B, d_sigma a0' ρ' B' =>
            EQT n' a0 a0' /\
            (forall u u', EQV n' a0 u u' ->
               exists b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ u) b /\
                            eval_exp B' (extend_env ρ' u') b' /\ EQT n' b b')
        | d_eq a m1 m2, d_eq a' m1' m2' =>
            EQT n' a a' /\ EQV n' a m1 m1' /\ EQV n' a m2 m2'
        | d_neut _ _, d_neut _ _ => True
        | _, _ => False
        end
    | d_nat =>
        (v = d_zero /\ w = d_zero) \/
        (exists m m', v = d_succ m /\ w = d_succ m' /\ EQV n' d_nat m m') \/
        (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_pi a0 ρ B =>
        (forall v0 v0', EQV n' a0 v0 v0' ->
           exists r r' b b', eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0) b /\
                             eval_exp B (extend_env ρ v0') b' /\
                             eval_app v v0 r /\ eval_app w v0' r' /\ EQV n' b r r')
    | d_sigma a0 ρ B =>
        (exists v1 v2, v = d_pair v1 v2) /\ (exists w1 w2, w = d_pair w1 w2)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_eq a m1 m2 =>
        (exists m, v = d_refl m /\ w = d_refl m)
        \/ (exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w')
    | d_neut _ _ => exists ty1 ty2 v' w', v = d_neut ty1 v' /\ w = d_neut ty2 w'
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Lemma ST_down1 : forall n a, ST (S n) a -> ST n a.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma VT_down1 : forall n a v, VT (S n) a v -> VT n a v.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQT_down1 : forall n a b, EQT (S n) a b -> EQT n a b.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.
Lemma EQV_down1 : forall n a v w, EQV (S n) a v w -> EQV n a v w.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 H). Qed.

Lemma ST_down : forall n m a, m <= n -> ST n a -> ST m a.
Proof.
  intros n m a Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply ST_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma VT_down : forall n m a v, m <= n -> VT n a v -> VT m a v.
Proof.
  intros n m a v Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. apply VT_down1. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma EQT_down : forall n m a b, m <= n -> EQT n a b -> EQT m a b.
Proof. intros n m a b Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQT_down1. exact H. Qed.
Lemma EQV_down : forall n m a v w, m <= n -> EQV n a v w -> EQV m a v w.
Proof. intros n m a v w Hle. induction Hle as [| n Hle IH]; intros H.
  - exact H. - apply IH. apply EQV_down1. exact H. Qed.

Lemma ST_univ : forall n i, ST n (d_univ i).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_nat_ty : forall n, ST n d_nat.
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma ST_neutral_val : forall n a w, ST n (d_neut a w).
Proof. induction n; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma VT_neutral : forall n a w, ST n a -> VT n a (d_neut a w).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros a w HST.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HST as [HSTn Hcl].
    split; [exact (IH a w HSTn)|].
    destruct a as [i| | |m|a0 e B|e M|a0 e B|v1 v2|a1 m1 m2|m|ty ww]; simpl in *.
    + split; [apply ST_neutral_val|]. exact I.
    + right; right; exists d_nat, w; reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. intros v0 HV0.
      destruct (Hfam v0 HV0) as [b [Hb HSTb]].
      exists (d_neut b (d_app w (d_dom a0 v0))), b.
      split; [exact Hb|]. split.
      * eapply eval_app_neut. exact Hb.
      * apply IH. exact HSTb.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha0 Hfam]. right. exists (d_sigma a0 e B), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + destruct Hcl as [Ha Hm1 Hm2]. right. exists (d_eq a1 m1 m2), w. reflexivity.
    + exfalso; exact Hcl.
    + exists (d_neut ty ww), w. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Renv_down : forall n Γ ρ, Renv (S n) Γ ρ -> Renv n Γ ρ.
Proof.

Lemma Renv_lookup : forall Γ x A, ctx_lookup x A Γ -> forall n ρ,

    exists b. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact H2.
    + exact H4.
  - inversion HR; subst.

    + eapply eval_exp_sub.

      * exact Hb.
    + exact HVT.
Qed.

Fixpoint wk_nf (s : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
  end
with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (wk_ne s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (wk_nf (S s) A) (wk_nf s MZ) (wk_nf (S (S s)) MS) (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S (S (S s))) B) (wk_nf (S s) BR)
               (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s M') (wk_ne s N)
  end.

Lemma initial_env_beyond : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->

Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
  - simpl in *. reflexivity.
  - destruct x as [| x]; [simpl in Hx; lia|].
    cbn. apply (IH ρ0 H2 x). simpl in Hx. lia.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_lookup : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ ->
  forall x, x < length Γ ->
  exists b, ρ x = d_neut b (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ H x Hx; inversion H; subst.
  - simpl in Hx; lia.
  - destruct x as [| x].
    + exists a. cbn. replace (length Γ - 0) with (length Γ) by lia. reflexivity.
    + assert (Hx' : x < length Γ) by (simpl in Hx; lia).
      destruct (IH ρ0 H2 x Hx') as [b Hb].
      exists b. cbn. rewrite Hb.
      replace (S (length Γ) - S x - 1) with (length Γ - x - 1) by lia.
      reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma nbe_ty_var : forall Γ x W, nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) W -> W = nf_neut (ne_var x).
Proof.

  match goal with H : initial_env Γ _ |- _ => rename H into Hie end.
  match goal with H : eval_exp (a_var x) _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hev end.
  match goal with H : read_typ (length Γ) _ W |- _ => rename H into Hrt end.
  inversion Hev; subst.
  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases x (length Γ)) as [Hlt|Hge].
  - destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hie x Hlt) as [b Hb].
    rewrite Hb in Hrt. inversion Hrt; subst.
    match goal with Hn : read_ne (length Γ) (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)) ?B |- _ =>
      rename Hn into Hn0
    end.
    inversion Hn0; subst.
    replace (length Γ - (length Γ - x - 1) - 1) with x by lia. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (initial_env_beyond Γ ρ Hie x Hge) in Hrt. inversion Hrt.
Qed.

  nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) (nf_neut (ne_var x)).
Proof.
  intros Γ x Hx ρ Hρ.
  destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hρ x Hx) as [b Hb].
  assert (Hrt : read_typ (length Γ) (d_neut b (d_var (length Γ - x - 1)))
                  (nf_neut (ne_var x))).
  { eapply read_typ_neut.
    replace (ne_var x) with (ne_var (length Γ - (length Γ - x - 1) - 1))
      by (f_equal; lia).
    apply read_ne_var. }
  eapply nbe_ty_run.
  - exact Hρ.
  - apply eval_exp_var.
  - rewrite Hb. exact Hrt.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros Γ A B T H. remember (a_pi A B) as M eqn:E. revert A B E.
  induction H; intros A0 B0 E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - inversion E; subst. exists i, i. split; assumption.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - discriminate E.
  - exact (IHwf_exp1 A0 B0 E).
Qed.

Lemma asnf_sound : forall A B,
  {{ ⊢anf A ⊆ B }} ->
  forall Γ,
  (exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}) ->
  (exists j, {{ Γ ⊢ B : Type@j }}) ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B }}.
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H as [A A' Hn Heq | i j Hle | A B A' B' Heq Hsub IH | A B A' B' Heq Hsub IH];
    intros Γ [iu Hu] [ju Hv].
  - subst A'. apply wf_subtyp_refl' with (i := iu). exact Hu.
  - pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ Hu) as Hwf.
    destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases i j) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + apply wf_subtyp_univ; assumption.
    + assert (i = j) by lia. subst j.
      apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
      * apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
      * apply wf_exp_eq_refl. apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - subst A'.
    destruct (wf_pi_typing_inv Γ A B (a_typ iu) Hu) as [i1 [i2 [HA1 HB1]]].
    destruct (wf_pi_typing_inv Γ A B' (a_typ ju) Hv) as [j1 [j2 [HA2 HB2]]].
    set (u := Nat.max (Nat.max i1 i2) (Nat.max j1 j2)).
    set (ΓA := cons (A : exp) Γ).
    assert (Hi1 : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA1]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hj1 : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA2]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hi2 : {{ ΓA ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB1]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hj2 : {{ ΓA ⊢ B' : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB2]; unfold u; lia).
    eapply wf_subtyp_pi.
    + exact Hi1.
    + exact Hj1.
    + apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact Hi1.
    + exact Hi2.
    + exact Hj2.
    + apply IH with (Γ := ΓA). exists u. exact Hi2. exists u. exact Hj2.
  - subst A'.
    destruct (wf_sigma_typing_inv Γ A B (a_typ iu) Hu) as [i1 [i2 [HA1 HB1]]].
    destruct (wf_sigma_typing_inv Γ A B' (a_typ ju) Hv) as [j1 [j2 [HA2 HB2]]].
    set (u := Nat.max (Nat.max i1 i2) (Nat.max j1 j2)).
    set (ΓA := cons (A : exp) Γ).
    assert (Hi1 : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA1]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hj1 : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA2]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hi2 : {{ ΓA ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB1]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hj2 : {{ ΓA ⊢ B' : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB2]; unfold u; lia).
    eapply wf_subtyp_sigma.
    + exact Hi1.
    + exact Hj1.
    + apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact Hi1.
    + exact Hi2.
    + exact Hj2.
    + apply IH with (Γ := ΓA). exists u. exact Hi2. exists u. exact Hj2.
Qed.

Lemma alg_subtyping_sound :
  (forall Γ A W i,
      nbe_ty Γ A W ->
      {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
      {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}) ->
  forall Γ A B,
    alg_subtyping Γ A B ->
    (exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}) ->
    (exists j, {{ Γ ⊢ B : Type@j }}) ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B }}.
Proof.
  intros S Γ A B H [i HA] [j HB].
  inversion H as [Γ0 A0 B0 A' B' Hnba Hnbb Hnf]; subst.
  destruct (S Γ A A' i Hnba HA) as [HA' HeqA].
  destruct (S Γ B B' j Hnbb HB) as [HB' HeqB].
  assert (Hsub : {{ Γ ⊢ A' ⊆ B' }}).
  { eapply asnf_sound; [exact Hnf | exists i; exact HA' | exists j; exact HB']. }
  assert (HAA' : {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }}).
  { apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := i); assumption. }
  assert (HB'B : {{ Γ ⊢ B' ⊆ B }}).
  { apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := j); [exact HB | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact HeqB]. }
  eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [exact HAA'|].
  eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [exact Hsub|exact HB'B].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_prefix : forall Γ A Δ A',
  {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A' }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A Δ A' H. inversion H; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_ctx : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ }} /\ {{ ⊢ Δ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ H. induction H as [| Γ Δ i A A' Hctx IH HA HA' HA0 HA0' Heq Heq'] using wf_ctx_eq_ind.
  - split; apply wf_ctx_empty.
  - destruct IH as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
    split.
    + eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_extend_same : forall Γ Δ A i,
  {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ A i Hctx HA HA'.
  eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend; try exact Hctx; try exact HA; try exact HA'.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA'.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_lookup : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
  exists A', {{ #x : A' ∈ Δ }} /\
    (exists i, {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\ {{ Δ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} /\
               {{ Δ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }}).
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ Hctx. induction Hctx as [| Γ0 Δ0 i A0 A0' Hpre IH HA0 HA0' HB0 HB0' HeqΓ HeqΔ] using wf_ctx_eq_ind;
    intros x A Hlk.
  - inversion Hlk.
  - destruct x as [| x].
    + (* here *) inversion Hlk; subst.
      exists (a_sub A0' a_weaken).
      split.
      * apply here.
      * (* Δ0,A0' well formed *)
        assert (HwfΔA : {{ ⊢ Δ0, A0' }}).
        { eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ | exact HB0'].
          eapply wf_exp_ctx. exact HB0'. }
        assert (HWk : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢s Wk : Δ0 }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact HwfΔA).
        assert (HtyA : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢ A0[Wk] : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
        assert (HtyA' : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢ A0'[Wk] : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
        exists i. split; [exact HtyA|]. split; [exact HtyA'|].
        eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype with (σ := a_weaken) (Δ := Δ0);
          [ exact HWk
          | eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong; [exact HeqΔ | apply wf_sub_eq_refl; exact HWk] ].
    + (* there *) inversion Hlk; subst.
      destruct (IH x A1 H2) as [A' [Hlk' [j [Hty [Hty' Heq]]]]].
      exists (a_sub A' a_weaken).
      split.
      * apply there. exact Hlk'.
      * assert (HwfΔB : {{ ⊢ Δ0, A0' }}).
        { eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ | exact HB0'].
          eapply wf_exp_ctx. exact HB0'. }
        assert (HWk : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢s Wk : Δ0 }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact HwfΔB).
        assert (HtyW : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢ A1[Wk] : Type@j }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
        assert (HtyW' : {{ Δ0, A0' ⊢ A'[Wk] : Type@j }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
        exists j. split; [exact HtyW|]. split; [exact HtyW'|].
        eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype with (σ := a_weaken) (Δ := Δ0);
          [ exact HWk
          | eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong; [exact Heq | apply wf_sub_eq_refl; exact HWk] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_raise_univ : forall Γ A A' i u,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} -> i <= u ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@u }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A A' i u HA Heq Hle.
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp.
  - exact Heq.
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_univ_le; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_natrec_zero_ty : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id,,zero] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A i HA. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.

  assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, zero) : Γ, ℕ }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; eassumption).

Qed.

Lemma wf_natrec_step_ty : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A i HA. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as HwfN.
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ }}) by assumption.
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ, ℕ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ2 := (a_nat :: Γ)%list); eassumption).
  (* variable #1 has (ℕ[Wk])[Wk], convert to ℕ *)
  assert (HwfΓ : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_prefix; eassumption).
  assert (Hnat : {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}) by (apply wf_nat; exact HwfΓ).
  assert (Hlk1 : {{ #1 : (ℕ[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, ℕ, A }}) by (apply there; apply here).
  assert (Hv1 : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ #1 : (ℕ[Wk])[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_vlookup; eassumption).
  assert (Hcomp0 : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ ℕ[Wk∘Wk] ≈ ℕ[Wk][Wk] : (Type@0)[Wk∘Wk] }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose; eassumption. }
  assert (HcompT : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ ℕ[Wk∘Wk] ≈ ℕ[Wk][Wk] : Type@0 }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype; [exact HWW|exact Hcomp0]. }
  assert (HnatSub : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ ℕ[Wk∘Wk] ≈ ℕ : Type@0 }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_nat_sub; exact HWW).
  assert (Heq1 : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ ℕ[Wk][Wk] ≈ ℕ : Type@0 }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact HcompT|exact HnatSub]. }
  assert (Hsucc : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ succ #1 : ℕ }}).
  { apply wf_succ. eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hv1|exact Heq1|apply wf_nat; exact Hctx2]. }
  assert (Hσ : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk ,, succ #1) : Γ, ℕ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_extend; [exact HWW|exact Hnat|].
    eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hsucc|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; eapply wf_exp_eq_nat_sub; exact HWW|eapply wf_subst_type; [exact HWW|exact Hnat]]. }
  eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption.
