  assert (T1T2 : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk])[Id] ≈ (A[Wk∘Wk])[Id,,#0] : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact e5|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Acomp]).
  assert (M1comp : {{ Γ, A ⊢ #1[Id,,#0] ≈ #0 : (A[Wk∘Wk])[Id,,#0] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_conv; [exact H1raw|exact T1T2|exact HT2]).
  assert (H0sub : {{ Γ, A ⊢ #0[Id,,#0] ≈ #0 : (A[Wk])[Id] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_var_0_sub; [exact HId1|exact HWk1_ty|exact Hv0']).
  assert (M2comp : {{ Γ, A ⊢ #0[Id,,#0] ≈ #0 : (A[Wk∘Wk])[Id,,#0] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_conv; [exact H0sub|exact T1T2|exact HT2]).
  assert (Heqsub : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0)[Id,,#0]
        ≈ Eq ((A[Wk∘Wk])[Id,,#0]) (#1[Id,,#0]) (#0[Id,,#0]) : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_eq_sub; [exact Hσ1|exact HWWty|exact HMc|exact HNc]. }
  assert (Heqcong : {{ Γ, A ⊢ Eq ((A[Wk∘Wk])[Id,,#0]) (#1[Id,,#0]) (#0[Id,,#0])
        ≈ Eq (A[Wk]) #0 #0 : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_eq_cong; [exact Acomp|exact M1comp|exact M2comp]. }
  assert (EQeq : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0)[Id,,#0] ≈ Eq (A[Wk]) #0 #0 : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact Heqsub|exact Heqcong]).
  assert (HreflQ : {{ Γ, A ⊢ refl A[Wk] #0 : (Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0)[Id,,#0] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hrefl|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact EQeq|exact HQty]).
  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s ((Id ,, #0) ,, refl A[Wk] #0)
                     : Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0 }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_extend; [exact Hσ1|exact HEqty|exact HreflQ]. }
  eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hσ2|exact HB].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_vlookup : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
  exists A', {{ #x : A' ∈ Δ }} /\ {{ Δ ⊢ #x : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ Hctx x A Hlk.
  destruct (wf_ctx_eq_lookup Γ Δ Hctx x A Hlk) as [A' [Hlk' [i [HA [HA' Heq]]]]].
  exists A'. split; [exact Hlk'|].
  destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ Hctx) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
  assert (Hv : {{ Δ ⊢ #x : A' }}) by (apply wf_vlookup; assumption).
  eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hv|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq|exact HA].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_wf_typ : forall Γ Δ i, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ Type@i : Type@(S i) }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ i Hctx H. destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ Hctx) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
  apply wf_typ. exact HwfΔ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_wf_nat : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ Hctx H. destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ Hctx) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
  apply wf_nat. exact HwfΔ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_wf_zero : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ zero : ℕ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ zero : ℕ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ Hctx H. destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ Hctx) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
  apply wf_zero. exact HwfΔ.
Qed.

Section Reduction.
Hypothesis NTS : forall Γ A W i,
  nbe_ty Γ A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Hypothesis NTmS : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Hypothesis CtxConvTy : forall Γ A C i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ C : Type@i }} ->
  forall B j, {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@j }} -> {{ Γ, C ⊢ B : Type@j }}.
Lemma infer_check_sound :
  (forall Γ A M, alg_type_check Γ A M ->
     forall i, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}) /\
  (forall Γ A M, alg_type_infer Γ A M ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}).
Proof.
  apply (alg_type_mut_ind
    (fun Γ A M _ => forall i, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }})
    (fun Γ A M _ => {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }})).
  - (* atc_ati *) intros Γ A M B0 a IH a0 i Hwf HB.
    destruct (IH Hwf) as [j [HM HA]].
    assert (Hsub : {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B0 }}).
    { eapply alg_subtyping_sound; [exact NTS | exact a0 | exists j; exact HA | exists i; exact HB]. }
    eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [exact HM | exact HB | exact Hsub].
  - (* ati_typ *) intros Γ i Hwf. exists (S (S i)). split.
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_nat *) intros Γ Hwf. exists 1. split.
    + apply wf_nat. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_zero *) intros Γ Hwf. exists 0. split.
    + apply wf_zero. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_nat. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_succ *) intros Γ M a IH Hwf.
    pose proof (IH 0 Hwf (@wf_nat Γ Hwf)) as HM.
    exists 0. split.
    + apply wf_succ. exact HM.
    + apply wf_nat. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_natrec *) intros Γ i A MZ MS M B a IHA a0 IHMZ a1 IHMS a2 IHM n Hwf.
    assert (Hnat : {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}) by (apply wf_nat; exact Hwf).
    assert (HctxN : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption).
    destruct (IHA HctxN) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    assert (HMZty : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id,,zero] : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_natrec_zero_ty; exact HA).
    pose proof (IHMZ i Hwf HMZty) as HMZ.
    assert (HMSty : {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] : Type@i }})
      by (eapply wf_natrec_step_ty; exact HA).
    assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact HctxN|exact HA]).
    pose proof (IHMS i Hctx2 HMSty) as HMS.
    pose proof (IHM 0 Hwf Hnat) as HM.
    assert (Hrec : {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end : A[Id,,M] }})
      by (eapply wf_natrec; eassumption).
    assert (HAscrut : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id,,M] : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_natrec_scrut_ty; eassumption).
    destruct (NTS Γ (a_sub A (a_extend a_id M)) B i n HAscrut) as [HB HBeq].
    exists i. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hrec|exact HBeq|exact HB].
    + exact HB.
  - (* ati_pi *) intros Γ i A j B a IHA a0 IHB Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
    destruct (IHB HctxA) as [iB [HB HBTy]].
    set (u := Nat.max i j).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    exists (S u). split.
    + apply wf_pi with (i := u); assumption.
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_fn *) intros Γ i A B M C a IHA a0 IHM n Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    destruct (NTS Γ A C i n HA) as [HC HeqAC].
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
    destruct (IHM HctxA) as [j [HM HBTy]].
    set (ΓC := cons (C : exp) Γ).
    assert (HBC : {{ ΓC ⊢ B : Type@j }}) by (exact (CtxConvTy Γ A C i HeqAC (B : exp) j HBTy)).
    set (u := Nat.max i j).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HCu : {{ Γ ⊢ C : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HC]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBuA : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HBTy]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBuC : {{ ΓC ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HBC]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hty : {{ Γ ⊢ Π C B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_pi; eassumption).
    assert (Hlam : {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M : Π A B }}) by (eapply wf_fn; [exact HA|exact HM]).
    assert (HeqACu : {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ C : Type@u }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_raise_univ; [exact HA|exact HeqAC|unfold u; lia]).
    assert (HeqPi : {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π C B : Type@u }}).
    { eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong; [exact HAu|exact HeqACu|apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HBuA]. }
    exists u. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hlam|exact HeqPi|exact Hty].
    + exact Hty.
  - (* ati_app *) intros Γ A B M N C a IHM a0 IHN n Hwf.
    destruct (IHM Hwf) as [j [HM HPiTy]].
    destruct (wf_pi_typing_inv Γ A B (a_typ j) HPiTy) as [iA [iB [HA HB]]].
    pose proof (IHN iA Hwf HA) as HN.
    set (u := Nat.max iA iB).
    set (ΓA := cons (A : exp) Γ).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ ΓA ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Happ : {{ Γ ⊢ M N : B[Id,,N] }}) by (eapply wf_app; eassumption).
    assert (Hcod : {{ Γ ⊢ B[Id,,N] : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_app_cod_ty; eassumption).
    destruct (NTS Γ (a_sub B (a_extend a_id N)) C u n Hcod) as [HC HCe].
    exists u. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Happ|exact HCe|exact HC].
    + exact HC.
  - (* ati_sigma *) intros Γ i A j B a IHA a0 IHB Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
    destruct (IHB HctxA) as [iB [HB HBTy]].
    set (u := Nat.max i j).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    exists (S u). split.
    + apply wf_sigma with (i := u); assumption.
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - (* ati_pair *) intros Γ i A j B M1 M2 A' C a IHA a0 IHB a1 IHM1 a2 IHM2 n n0 Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
    destruct (IHB HctxA) as [jB [HB HBTy]].
    set (u := Nat.max i j).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    pose proof (IHM1 u Hwf HAu) as HM1.
    assert (HBsub : {{ Γ ⊢ B[Id,,M1] : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_app_cod_ty; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHM2 u Hwf HBsub) as HM2.
    destruct (NTS Γ A A' i n HA) as [HA' HeqAA'].
    destruct (NTS _ B C j n0 HB) as [HC HeqBC].
    assert (Hpair : {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M1 : A ; M2 : B ⟩ : Σ A B }}) by (eapply wf_pair; eassumption).
    assert (HA'u : {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA']; unfold u; lia).
    set (ΓA' := cons (A' : exp) Γ).
    assert (HC_A' : {{ ΓA' ⊢ C : Type@j }}) by (exact (CtxConvTy Γ A (A' : exp) i HeqAA' (C : exp) j HC)).
    assert (HCu : {{ ΓA' ⊢ C : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HC_A']; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hty : {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A' C : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_sigma; eassumption).
    assert (HeqAA'u : {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@u }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_raise_univ; [exact HA|exact HeqAA'|unfold u; lia]).
    assert (HeqBCu : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ C : Type@u }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_raise_univ; [exact HB|exact HeqBC|unfold u; lia]).
    assert (HeqSig : {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B ≈ Σ A' C : Type@u }}).
    { eapply wf_exp_eq_sigma_cong; [exact HAu|exact HeqAA'u|exact HeqBCu]. }
    exists u. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hpair|exact HeqSig|exact Hty].
    + exact Hty.
  - (* ati_fst *) intros Γ A B M a IHM Hwf.
    destruct (IHM Hwf) as [j [HM HSigTy]].
    destruct (wf_sigma_typing_inv Γ A B (a_typ j) HSigTy) as [iA [iB [HA HB]]].
    set (u := Nat.max iA iB).
    set (ΓA := cons (A : exp) Γ).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ ΓA ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hfst : {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }}) by (eapply wf_fst; eassumption).
    exists iA. split; [exact Hfst|exact HA].
  - (* ati_snd *) intros Γ A B M C a IHM n Hwf.
    destruct (IHM Hwf) as [j [HM HSigTy]].
    destruct (wf_sigma_typing_inv Γ A B (a_typ j) HSigTy) as [iA [iB [HA HB]]].
    set (u := Nat.max iA iB).
    set (ΓA := cons (A : exp) Γ).
    assert (HAu : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (HBu : {{ ΓA ⊢ B : Type@u }}) by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; unfold u; lia).
    assert (Hfst : {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }}) by (eapply wf_fst; eassumption).
    assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, fst M) : ΓA }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; eassumption).
    assert (Hcod : {{ Γ ⊢ B[Id,,fst M] : Type@iB }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
    destruct (NTS Γ (a_sub B (a_extend a_id (a_fst M))) C iB n Hcod) as [HC HCe].
    assert (Hsnd : {{ Γ ⊢ snd M : B[Id,,fst M] }}) by (eapply wf_snd with (i:=u); [exact HAu|exact HBu|exact HM]).
    exists iB. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hsnd|exact HCe|exact HC].
    + exact HC.
  - (* ati_eq *) intros Γ i A M1 M2 a IHA a0 IHM1 a1 IHM2 Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    pose proof (IHM1 i Hwf HA) as HM1.
    pose proof (IHM2 i Hwf HA) as HM2.
    assert (Heq : {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_eq; eassumption).
    exists iA. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + exact HATy.
  - (* ati_refl *) intros Γ i A M C N a IHA a0 IHM n n0 Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    pose proof (IHM i Hwf HA) as HM.
    destruct (NTS Γ A C i n HA) as [HC HeqAC].
    destruct (NTmS Γ M A N n0 HM) as [HN HeqMN].
    assert (HNC : {{ Γ ⊢ N : C }}) by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HN|exact HeqAC|exact HC]).
    assert (HeqTy : {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M M ≈ Eq C N N : Type@i }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_eq_cong; eassumption).
    assert (Hty : {{ Γ ⊢ Eq C N N : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_eq; eassumption).
    assert (Hrefl : {{ Γ ⊢ refl A M : Eq A M M }}) by (eapply wf_refl; eassumption).
    exists i. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hrefl|exact HeqTy|exact Hty].
    + exact Hty.
  - (* ati_eqrec *) intros Γ i A M1 M2 j B BR N C a IHA a0 IHM1 a1 IHM2 a2 IHB a3 IHBR a4 IHN n Hwf.
    destruct (IHA Hwf) as [iA [HA HATy]].
    pose proof (IHM1 i Hwf HA) as HM1.
    pose proof (IHM2 i Hwf HA) as HM2.
    assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
    destruct (eqrec_ctx_typing Γ A i HA) as [HWWty [HMc [HNc HEqty]]].
    assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (eapply wf_exp_ctx; exact HWWty).
    assert (HctxE : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk∘Wk]) #1 #0 }})
      by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [exact Hctx2|exact HEqty]).
    destruct (IHB HctxE) as [jB [HB HBTy]].
    assert (HBRty : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] : Type@j }})
      by (eapply BranchTy_proved; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHBR j Hctx1 HBRty) as HBR.
    assert (HNty : {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_eq; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHN i Hwf HNty) as HN.
    assert (Hterm : {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end
                        : B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }}) by (eapply wf_eqrec; eassumption).
    (* type of the result via wf_eqrec_subst *)
    assert (HM1' : {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : A[Id] }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM1|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HA|eapply wf_subst_type; [apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf|exact HA]]).
    assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ A[Wk] : Type@i }})
      by (eapply wf_subst_type; [apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1|exact HA]).
    assert (HAwk_sub_ty : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk])[Id,,M1] : Type@i }}).
    { eapply wf_subst_type.
      - eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; [exact HM1|exact HA].
      - exact HAwk. }
    assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id] ≈ A : Type@i }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HA).
    assert (Hwk : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk])[Id,,M1] ≈ A[Id] : Type@i }})
      by (eapply sub_wk_extend_approx; [apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf|exact HA|exact HM1']).
    assert (Heq2 : {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ (A[Wk])[Id,,M1] : Type@i }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact HAid|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hwk]).
    assert (HM2' : {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id,,M1]) }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM2|exact Heq2|exact HAwk_sub_ty]).
    assert (Hresty : {{ Γ ⊢ B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] : Type@j }})
      by (eapply wf_eqrec_subst with (A:=A) (M1:=M1) (M2:=M2) (N:=N) (B:=B) (i:=i) (j:=j); eassumption).
    destruct (NTS Γ (a_sub B (a_extend (a_extend (a_extend a_id M1) M2) N)) C j n Hresty) as [HC HCe].
    exists j. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact Hterm|exact HCe|exact HC].
    + exact HC.
  - (* ati_vlookup *) intros x A Γ B c n Hwf.
    destruct (ctx_lookup_type Γ x A c Hwf) as [i HA].
    destruct (NTS Γ A B i n HA) as [HB Heq].
    exists i. split.
    + eapply wf_exp_conv; [eapply wf_vlookup; eassumption|exact Heq|exact HB].
    + exact HB.
Qed.
End Reduction.

(* The substitution-realizing environment relation used by the intended
   adequacy proof.  It is only a Definition: no axiom is introduced. *)
Definition Rsub (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρ : env) : Prop :=
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

Lemma check_complete_from_infer :
  (forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
       exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}) ->
  (forall Γ A B, {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B }} -> alg_subtyping Γ A B) ->
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> alg_type_check Γ A M.
Proof.
  intros HInfer HSub M Hu Γ A HM.
  destruct (HInfer M Hu Γ A HM) as [B [Hinf Hsub]].
  eapply atc_ati.
  - exact Hinf.
  - eapply HSub. exact Hsub.
Qed.

Definition RsubFundamentalStmt : Prop :=
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A i, {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
        exists a WA, eval_exp A ρ a /\ read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }})
  /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
        exists a m W, eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
          read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }})
  /\
  (forall Δ ρ, {{ ⊢ Δ }} -> initial_env Δ ρ -> Rsub Δ Δ a_id ρ).

Definition InferCompleteUserStmt : Prop :=
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
    forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Targets                                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Theorem alg_type_check_sound : forall {Γ i A M},
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}.
Admitted.

Theorem alg_type_check_complete : forall {Γ A M},
    user_exp M ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }}.
Admitted.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain Evaluation Readback.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export System.

Import Domain_Notations.

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive initial_env : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| initial_env_nil : initial_env nil empty_env
| initial_env_cons :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     initial_env (A :: Γ) d{{{ ρ ↦ ⇑! a (length Γ) }}}).

Inductive nbe : ctx -> exp -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m in (length Γ) ↘ w }} ->
     nbe Γ M A w ).

Inductive nbe_ty : ctx -> typ -> nf -> Prop :=
| nbe_ty_run :
  `( initial_env Γ ρ ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ Rtyp m in (length Γ) ↘ W }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ M W ).
=====DOMAIN=====
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Reserved Notation "'env'".

Inductive domain : Set :=
| d_univ : nat -> domain
| d_nat : domain
| d_zero : domain
| d_succ : domain -> domain
| d_pi : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_fn : env -> exp -> domain
| d_sigma : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_pair : domain -> domain -> domain
| d_eq : domain -> domain -> domain -> domain
| d_refl : domain -> domain
| d_neut : domain -> domain_ne -> domain
with domain_ne : Set :=




| d_var : forall (x : nat), domain_ne
| d_app : domain_ne -> domain_nf -> domain_ne
| d_fst : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_snd : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_natrec : env -> typ -> domain -> exp -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_eqrec : env -> domain -> typ -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
with domain_nf : Set :=
| d_dom : domain -> domain -> domain_nf
where "'env'" := (nat -> domain).

Definition empty_env : env := fun x => d_zero.

Arguments empty_env _ /.

Definition extend_env (ρ : env) (d : domain) : env :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => d
    | S n' => ρ n'
    end.

Arguments extend_env _ _ _ /.

Definition drop_env (ρ : env) : env := fun n => ρ (S n).

Arguments drop_env _ _ /.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry domain.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with domain.

Module Domain_Notations.

Export Syntax_Notations.

Notation "'d{{{' x '}}}'" := x (at level 0, x custom domain at level 99, format "'d{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'𝕌' @ n" := (d_univ n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := d_nat (in custom domain) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := d_zero (in custom domain at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' m" := (d_succ m) (in custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' m 'under' ρ 'return' P | 'zero' -> mz | 'succ' -> MS 'end'" := (d_natrec ρ P mz MS m) (in custom domain at level 0, P custom exp at level 60, mz custom domain at level 60, MS custom exp at level 60, ρ custom domain at level 60, m custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' a ρ B" := (d_pi a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' ρ M" := (d_fn ρ M) (in custom domain at level 0, ρ custom domain at level 30, M custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (d_app .. (d_app f x) .. y) (in custom domain at level 40, f custom domain, x custom domain at next level, y custom domain at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' a ρ B" := (d_sigma a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ a ; b ⟩ " := (d_pair a b) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, b custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' e" := (d_fst e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' e" := (d_snd e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' a m n" := (d_eq a m n) (in custom domain at level 1, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 35, n custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' m" := (d_refl m) (in custom domain at level 1, m custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' n 'under' ρ 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 n) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, n custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'!' n" := (d_var n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑' a m" := (d_neut a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇓' a m" := (d_dom a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑!' a n" := (d_neut a (d_var n)) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ ↦ m" := (extend_env ρ m) (in custom domain at level 20, left associativity) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ '↯'" := (drop_env ρ) (in custom domain at level 10, ρ custom domain) : mctt_scope.

End Domain_Notations.

Import Domain_Notations.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'⟦' M '⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, M custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, A custom exp at level 99, MZ custom exp at level 99, MS custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₁' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₂' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, a custom domain at level 30, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, B custom exp at level 99, BR custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" (in custom judg at level 80, σ custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, ρσ custom domain at level 99).

Generalizable All Variables.

Variant eval_fst : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_fst_pair :
  `( {{ π₁ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ a }} )
| eval_fst_neut :
  `( {{ π₁ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ a (fst m) }} )
where "'π₁' n '↘' r" := (eval_fst n r) (in custom judg).

Inductive eval_exp : exp -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_exp_typ :
  `( {{ ⟦ Type@i ⟧ ρ ↘ 𝕌@i }} )
| eval_exp_var :
  `( {{ ⟦ # x ⟧ ρ ↘ ^(ρ x) }} )
| eval_exp_nat :
  `( {{ ⟦ ℕ ⟧ ρ ↘ ℕ }} )
| eval_exp_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ zero ⟧ ρ ↘ zero }} )
| eval_exp_succ :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ succ M ⟧ ρ ↘ succ m }} )
| eval_exp_natrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ rec m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_pi :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Π A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Π a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ λ A M ⟧ ρ ↘ λ ρ M }} )
| eval_exp_app :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ $| m & n |↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M N ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sigma :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Σ A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Σ a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_pair :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ b }} ->
     {{ ⟦ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ⟧ ρ ↘ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ }} )
| eval_exp_fst :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ fst M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_snd :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ snd M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_eq :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Eq A M1 M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ Eq a m1 m2 }} )
| eval_exp_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ refl A M ⟧ ρ ↘ refl m }} )
| eval_exp_eqrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ eqrec n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sub :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ' ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} )
where "'⟦' e '⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_exp e ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_natrec : exp -> exp -> exp -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_natrec_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ rec zero ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} )
| eval_natrec_succ :
  `( {{ rec b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ b ↦ r ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ rec succ b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ms }} )
| eval_natrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ b m ↘ a }} ->
     {{ rec ⇑ b m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ a (rec m under ρ return A | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end) }} )
where "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_app : domain -> domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_app_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m }} ->
     {{ $| λ ρ M & n |↘ m }} )
| eval_app_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ $| ⇑ (Π a ρ B) m & n |↘ ⇑ b (m (⇓ a n)) }} )
where "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" := (eval_app m n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_snd : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_snd_pair :
  `( {{ π₂ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ b }} )
| eval_snd_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ a (fst m) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ π₂ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ b (snd m) }} )
where "'π₂' n '↘' r" := (eval_snd n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_eqrec : domain -> exp -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_eqrec_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ br }} ->
     {{ eqrec refl n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ br }} )
| eval_eqrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m1 ↦ m2 ↦ ⇑ c n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ eqrec ⇑ c n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ b (eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end) }} )
where "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_sub : sub -> env -> env -> Prop :=
| eval_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⟦ Id ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ }} )
| eval_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⟦ Wk ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ ↯ }} )
| eval_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ,, M ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ↦ m }} )
| eval_sub_compose :
  `( {{ ⟦ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρτ ↘ ρτσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ∘ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτσ }} )
where "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" := (eval_sub σ ρ ρσ) (in custom judg)
.

Scheme eval_exp_mut_ind := Induction for eval_exp Sort Prop
with eval_natrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_natrec Sort Prop
with eval_app_mut_ind := Induction for eval_app Sort Prop
with eval_snd_mut_ind := Induction for eval_snd Sort Prop
with eval_eqrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_eqrec Sort Prop
with eval_sub_mut_ind := Induction for eval_sub Sort Prop
.

Combined Scheme eval_mut_ind from
  eval_exp_mut_ind,
  eval_natrec_mut_ind,
  eval_app_mut_ind,
  eval_snd_mut_ind,
  eval_eqrec_mut_ind,
  eval_sub_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Coq Require Import List Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ≈ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, M' custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, σ' custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, A custom exp, A' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, x constr at level 0, A custom exp, Γ custom exp at level 50).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive ctx_lookup : nat -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
  | here : `({{ #0 : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, A }})
  | there : `({{ #n : A ∈ Γ }} -> {{ #(S n) : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, B }})
where "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" := (ctx_lookup x A Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Inductive wf_ctx : ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} )
where "⊢ Γ" := (wf_ctx Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_ctx_sub : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_sub_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ ⊆ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A ⊆ Δ, A' }} )
where "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" := (wf_ctx_sub Γ Γ') (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_exp : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_typ :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_nat :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_zero :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M : ℕ }} )
| wf_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end : A[Id,,M] }} )

| wf_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M : Π A B }} )
| wf_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N : B[Id,,N] }} )

| wf_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }} )
| wf_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M : B[Id,,fst M] }} )

| wf_vlookup :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #x : A }} )

| wf_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M N : Type@i }})
| wf_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ refl A M : Eq A M M }})
| wf_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ BR : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end : B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }} )

| wf_exp_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_subtyp :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->









     {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }} )
where "Γ ⊢ M : A" := (wf_exp Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_sub : ctx -> ctx -> sub -> Prop :=
| wf_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }} )
| wf_sub_weaken :

Lemma wf_subst_type : forall Γ Δ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ A i Hσ HA. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp.
  - eapply wf_exp_sub; [exact Hσ | exact HA].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_retype : forall Γ Δ σ i M M',
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : (Type@i)[σ] }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ i M M' Hσ Heq. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [exact Heq| |].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_cong_univ : forall Γ Δ σ σ' A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢s σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ σ' A i Hσ Hσ' Hseq HA.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype; [exact Hσ|].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
  - exact Hseq.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ : forall Γ Γ' Γ'' τ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s τ : Γ' }} -> {{ Γ' ⊢s σ : Γ'' }} ->

Proof.

Lemma wf_eqrec_subst : forall Γ A M1 M2 N B i j,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : (A[Id]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
  {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ B[((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) ,, N] : Type@j }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A M1 M2 N B i j HA HM1 HM2 HN HB.
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hctx1|exact HAwk]).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  destruct (eqrec_ctx_typing Γ A i HA) as [HAc [HMc [HNc HC]]].
  assert (Hsub : {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }})
    by (eapply eqrec_ctx_sub_approx; eassumption).
  assert (Hsub_ty : {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HN' : {{ Γ ⊢ N : (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HN|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hsub|exact Hsub_ty]).
  assert (Hσ3 : {{ Γ ⊢s (((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) ,, N) : Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 }})

Lemma drop_env_extend : forall (ρ : env) v, drop_env (extend_env ρ v) = ρ.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma extend_env_zero : forall (ρ : env) v, extend_env ρ v 0 = v.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma extend_env_succ : forall (ρ : env) v n, extend_env ρ v (S n) = ρ n.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma initial_env_drop : forall A Γ ρ, initial_env (A :: Γ) ρ ->
  initial_env Γ (drop_env ρ).
Proof.
  intros A Γ ρ H. inversion H; subst.
  rewrite drop_env_extend. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_head : forall A Γ ρ, initial_env (A :: Γ) ρ ->
  exists a, ρ 0 = d_neut a (d_var (length Γ)) /\ eval_exp A (drop_env ρ) a.
Proof.
  intros A Γ ρ H. inversion H; subst.
  exists a. split.
  - rewrite extend_env_zero. reflexivity.
  - rewrite drop_env_extend. exact H4.
Qed.

Lemma initial_env_extend : forall Γ ρ a, initial_env Γ ρ ->
  forall A, eval_exp A ρ a ->
  initial_env (A :: Γ) (extend_env ρ (d_neut a (d_var (length Γ)))).
Proof.
  intros. apply initial_env_cons; assumption.
Qed.


Lemma eval_exp_subst : forall M σ ρ ρσ m,
  eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> eval_exp M ρσ m -> eval_exp (a_sub M σ) ρ m.
Proof. intros. eapply eval_exp_sub; eassumption. Qed.

Lemma eval_exp_sub_inv : forall M σ ρ m,
  eval_exp (a_sub M σ) ρ m -> exists ρσ, eval_sub σ ρ ρσ /\ eval_exp M ρσ m.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_id_env : forall ρ, eval_sub a_id ρ ρ.
Proof. apply eval_sub_id. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_weaken_env : forall ρ, eval_sub a_weaken ρ (drop_env ρ).
Proof. intros. apply eval_sub_weaken. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_extend_env : forall σ ρ ρσ M m,
  eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> eval_exp M ρ m ->
  eval_sub (a_extend σ M) ρ (extend_env ρσ m).
Proof. intros. eapply eval_sub_extend; eassumption. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_compose_env : forall σ τ ρ ρτ ρτσ,
  eval_sub τ ρ ρτ -> eval_sub σ ρτ ρτσ ->
  eval_sub (a_compose σ τ) ρ ρτσ.
Proof. intros. eapply eval_sub_compose; eassumption. Qed.


Lemma wf_exp_cumul : forall Γ A i j, i <= j -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@j }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A i j Hle HA.
  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases i j) as [Hlt|Hge].
  - pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
    eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [exact HA| |].
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_subtyp_univ; [exact Hwf|exact Hlt].
  - assert (i = j) by lia. subst. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_lookup_type : forall Γ x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
  {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ x A Hlk. induction Hlk as [A0 Γ0 | n0 A0 Γ0 B Hn IH]; intros Hwf.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    exists i.
    eapply wf_exp_subtyp.
    + eapply wf_exp_sub; [apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hwf | exact H2].
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
      * apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. apply wf_sub_weaken. exact Hwf.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    destruct (IH H1) as [j Hj].
    exists j.
    eapply wf_exp_subtyp.
    + eapply wf_exp_sub; [apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hwf | exact Hj].
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S j).
      * apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
      * eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. apply wf_sub_weaken. exact Hwf.
Qed.


Lemma wf_exp_type : forall Γ A M, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> exists i, {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }}.
Proof.

  - intros Γ i Hwf. eexists. apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - intros Γ Hwf. eexists. apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - intros Γ Hwf. eexists. apply wf_nat. exact Hwf.
  - intros Γ M HM IHM. exact IHM.
  - intros Γ i A MZ MS M HA IHA HMZ IHMZ HMS IHMS HM IHM.
    pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HM) as Hwf.
    assert (Hnat : {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}) by (apply wf_nat; exact Hwf).
    assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M) : Γ, ℕ }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; eassumption).
    exists i. eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hσ|exact HA].
  - intros Γ i A B HA IHA HB IHB.
    eexists. apply wf_typ. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA). exact H.
  - intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HM IHM.
    destruct IHM as [j HB].
    assert (HcumA : {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@(S (max i j)) }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HA]; lia).
    assert (HcumB : {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@(S (max i j)) }})
      by (eapply wf_exp_cumul; [|exact HB]; lia).
    exists (S (max i j)). apply wf_pi with (i:=S (max i j)); assumption.
  - intros Γ i A B M N HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM HN IHN.
    assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, N) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; eassumption).
    exists i. eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hσ|exact HB].
  - intros Γ i A B HA IHA HB IHB.
    eexists. apply wf_typ. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA). exact H.
  - intros Γ i A B M N HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM HN IHN.
    exists i. apply wf_sigma with (i:=i); assumption.
  - intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM.
    exists i. exact HA.
  - intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM.
    assert (HMf : {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }}) by (eapply wf_fst; eassumption).
    assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, fst M) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend_id_self; eassumption).
    exists i. eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hσ|exact HB].
  - intros Γ x A Hwf Hlk. eapply ctx_lookup_type; eassumption.
  - intros Γ i A M N HA IHA HM IHM HN IHN.
    eexists. apply wf_typ. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA). exact H.

    exists i. apply wf_eq; assumption.

    pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.

    assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
    assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
    assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
    assert (HL1_ty : {{ Γ ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).

  - intros Γ A M i A' HM IHM HA' IHA' Hsub.
    exists i. exact HA'.
Qed.



Lemma wf_subtyp_refl' : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A }}.
Proof.
  intros. apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i:=i); [exact H|apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact H].
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_of_eq : forall Γ A A' i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }}.
Proof.
  intros. apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i:=i); assumption.
Qed.


Lemma eval_sub_id_initial : forall Γ ρ, initial_env Γ ρ -> eval_sub a_id ρ ρ.
Proof. intros. apply eval_sub_id. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_extend_initial : forall Γ ρ M m,
  initial_env Γ ρ -> eval_exp M ρ m ->
  eval_sub (a_extend a_id M) ρ (extend_env ρ m).
Proof. intros. eapply eval_sub_extend; [apply eval_sub_id|exact H0]. Qed.

Lemma eval_sub_weaken_initial : forall A Γ ρ,
  initial_env (A :: Γ) ρ -> eval_sub a_weaken ρ (drop_env ρ).
Proof. intros. apply eval_sub_weaken. Qed.





Lemma wf_sub_tgt : forall Γ Δ σ, {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Δ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ H. induction H.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_ctx_prefix in H. exact H.
  - assumption.
  - eapply wf_ctx_extend; eassumption.
  - exact H0.
Qed.


Lemma wf_ctx_eq_refl : forall Γ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Γ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ H. induction H as [| Γ i A Hwf HA IH].
  - apply wf_ctx_eq_empty.
  - eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend; try eassumption.
    all: apply wf_exp_eq_refl; assumption.
Qed.


Lemma wf_ctx_eq_sym : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Δ ≈ Γ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ H.
  induction H as [| Γ0 Δ0 i A0 A0' Heq IH HA HA' HAΔ HAΔ' HeqΓ HeqΔ].
  - apply wf_ctx_eq_empty.
  - eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend with (Γ:=Δ0) (Δ:=Γ0) (i:=i) (A:=A0') (A':=A0).
    + exact IH.
    + exact HAΔ'.
    + exact HAΔ.
    + exact HA'.
    + exact HA.
    + apply wf_exp_eq_sym. exact HeqΔ.
    + apply wf_exp_eq_sym. exact HeqΓ.
Qed.


Lemma wf_subtyp_univ_le : forall Γ i j,
  {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> i <= j -> {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i ⊆ Type@j }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ i j Hwf Hle.
  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases i j) as [Hlt|Hge].
  - apply wf_subtyp_univ; assumption.
  - assert (i = j) by lia. subst.
    apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i:=S j).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_exp_eq_refl. apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
Qed.

Proof.

  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].
  - apply asnf_refl; [simpl; auto|reflexivity].

From Mctt.Algorithmic.Subtyping Require Export Definitions.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom nf).

Reserved Notation "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive alg_type_check : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| atc_ati :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟸ A" := (alg_type_check Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with alg_type_infer : ctx -> nf -> exp -> Prop :=
| ati_typ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a Type@i ⟹ Type@(S i) }} )
| ati_nat :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a ℕ ⟹ Type@0 }} )
| ati_zero :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a zero ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a succ M ⟹ ℕ }} )
| ati_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a MZ ⟸ A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢a MS ⟸ A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ ℕ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ A[Id,,M] }}} B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟹ B }} )
| ati_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Π A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a M ⟹ B }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a λ A M ⟹ Π C B }} )
| ati_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M N ⟹ C }} )
| ati_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Σ A B ⟹ Type@(max i j) }} )
| ati_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ , A ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ B[Id,,M1] }} ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ }}} {{{ A }}} A' ->
     nbe_ty {{{ Γ , A }}} {{{ B }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a ⟨ M1 : A ; M2 : B ⟩ ⟹ Σ A' C }} )
| ati_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a fst M ⟹ A }} )
| ati_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟹ Σ A B }} ->
      nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,fst M] }}} C ->
      {{ Γ ⊢a snd M ⟹ C }} )
| ati_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a Eq A M1 M2 ⟹ Type@i }} )
| ati_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A C ->
     nbe Γ M A N ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a refl A M ⟹ Eq C N N }} )
| ati_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢a A ⟹ Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M1 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a M2 ⟸ A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢a B ⟹ Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢a BR ⟸ B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a N ⟸ Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ {{{ B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }}} C ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟹ C }} )
| ati_vlookup :
  `( {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     nbe_ty Γ A B ->
     {{ Γ ⊢a #x ⟹ B }} )
where "Γ '⊢a' M ⟹ A" := (alg_type_infer Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Scheme alg_type_check_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_check Sort Prop
with alg_type_infer_mut_ind := Induction for alg_type_infer Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme alg_type_mut_ind from
  alg_type_check_mut_ind,
  alg_type_infer_mut_ind.
---
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export NbE.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export SystemOpt.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢a A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, A custom exp, A' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢anf A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, A custom nf, A' custom nf).

Definition not_univ_pi_sigma (A : nf) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | nf_typ _ | nf_pi _ _ | nf_sigma _ _ => False
  | _ => True
  end.

Inductive alg_subtyping_nf : nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| asnf_refl : forall A A',
    not_univ_pi_sigma A ->
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf A ⊆ A' }}
| asnf_univ : forall i j,
    i <= j ->
    {{ ⊢anf Type@i ⊆ Type@j }}
| asnf_pi : forall A B A' B',
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf B ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ ⊢anf Π A B ⊆ Π A' B' }}
| asnf_sigma : forall A B A' B',
    A = A' ->
    {{ ⊢anf B ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ ⊢anf Σ A B ⊆ Σ A' B' }}
where "⊢anf A ⊆ A'" := (alg_subtyping_nf A A') (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Inductive alg_subtyping : ctx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| alg_subtyp_run : forall Γ A B A' B',
    nbe_ty Γ A A' ->
    nbe_ty Γ B B' ->
    {{ ⊢anf A' ⊆ B' }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B }}
where "Γ ⊢a A ⊆ B" := (alg_subtyping Γ A B) (in custom judg) : type_scope.
---
From Coq Require Import Lia List MSets PeanoNat String FunInd.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Import Syntax.

Open Scope string_scope.

Module StrSet := Make String_as_OT.

Module StrSProp := MSetProperties.Properties StrSet.

Notation "s [<=] t" := (StrSet.Subset s t) (at level 70, no associativity).

Fixpoint lookup (s : string) (ctx : list string) : option nat :=
  match ctx with
  | nil => None
  | c::cs =>
      if string_dec c s
      then Some 0
      else
        match lookup s cs with
        | Some n => Some (n + 1)%nat
        | None => None
        end
  end
.

Fixpoint elaborate (cst : Cst.obj) (ctx : list string) : option exp :=
  match cst with
  | Cst.var s =>
      match lookup s ctx with
      | Some n => Some (a_var n)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.typ n => Some (a_typ n)
  | Cst.nat => Some a_nat
  | Cst.zero => Some a_zero
  | Cst.succ c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_succ a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sr s =>
      match elaborate m (mx :: ctx), elaborate z ctx, elaborate s (sr :: sx :: ctx), elaborate n ctx with
      | Some m, Some z, Some s, Some n => Some (a_natrec m z s n)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pi s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_pi t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fn s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_fn t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.app c1 c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | None, _ => None
      | _, None => None
      | Some a1, Some a2 => Some (a_app a1 a2)
      end
  | Cst.sigma s t c =>
      match elaborate c (s :: ctx), elaborate t ctx with
      | Some a, Some t => Some (a_sigma t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx,  elaborate t1 ctx, elaborate c2 ctx, elaborate t2 (s::ctx) with
      | Some a1, Some b1, Some a2, Some b2 => Some (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2)
      | _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.fst c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_fst a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.snd c =>
      match elaborate c ctx with
      | Some a => Some (a_snd a)
      | None => None
      end
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 =>
      match elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eq t a1 a2)
      | _, _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.refl t c =>
      match elaborate t ctx, elaborate c ctx with
      | Some t, Some a => Some (a_refl t a)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 =>
      match elaborate n ctx, elaborate m (mz :: my :: mx :: ctx), elaborate r (rx :: ctx), elaborate c1 ctx, elaborate t ctx, elaborate c2 ctx with
      | Some n, Some m, Some r, Some a1, Some t, Some a2 => Some (a_eqrec t m r a1 a2 n)
      | _, _, _, _, _, _ => None
      end
  end
.

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive user_exp : exp -> Prop :=
| user_exp_typ :
  `( user_exp (a_typ i) )
| user_exp_nat :
  `( user_exp a_nat )
| user_exp_zero :
  `( user_exp a_zero )
| user_exp_succ :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_succ M) )
| user_exp_natrec :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp MZ ->
     user_exp MS ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_natrec A MZ MS M) )
| user_exp_pi :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_pi A B) )
| user_exp_fn :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_fn A M) )
| user_exp_app :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp (a_app M N) )
| user_exp_sigma :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_sigma A B) )
| user_exp_pair :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp A ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp (a_pair M A N B) )
| user_exp_fst :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_fst M) )
| user_exp_snd :
  `( user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_snd M) )
| user_exp_eq :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M1 ->
     user_exp M2 ->
     user_exp (a_eq A M1 M2) )
| user_exp_refl :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp M ->
     user_exp (a_refl A M) )
| user_exp_eqrec :
  `( user_exp A ->
     user_exp B ->
     user_exp BR ->
     user_exp M1 ->
     user_exp M2 ->
     user_exp N ->
     user_exp (a_eqrec A B BR M1 M2 N) )
| user_exp_vlookup :
  `( user_exp (a_var x) ).

Fixpoint cst_variables (cst : Cst.obj) : StrSet.t :=
 match cst with
  | Cst.var s => StrSet.singleton s
  | Cst.typ n => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.nat => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.zero => StrSet.empty
  | Cst.succ c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.natrec n mx m z sx sy s => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.remove mx (cst_variables m))) (StrSet.union (cst_variables z) (StrSet.remove sx (StrSet.remove sy (cst_variables s))))
  | Cst.pi s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.fn s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.app c1 c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables c2)
  | Cst.sigma s t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables c))
  | Cst.pair c1 t1 c2 s t2 => StrSet.union (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (cst_variables t1)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c2) (StrSet.remove s (cst_variables t2)))
  | Cst.fst c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.snd c => cst_variables c
  | Cst.prop_eq c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2))
  | Cst.refl t c => StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c)
  | Cst.eqrec n mx my mz m rx r c1 t c2 => StrSet.union (cst_variables n) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove mx (StrSet.remove my (StrSet.remove mz (cst_variables m)))) (StrSet.union (StrSet.remove rx (cst_variables r)) (StrSet.union (cst_variables c1) (StrSet.union (cst_variables t) (cst_variables c2)))))
 end

Inductive closed_at : exp -> nat -> Prop :=
 | ca_var : `( x < n -> closed_at (a_var x) n )
 | ca_type : `( closed_at (a_typ m) n )
 | ca_nat : `( closed_at (a_nat) n )
 | ca_zero : `( closed_at (a_zero) n )
 | ca_succ : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_succ a) n )
 | ca_natrec : `( closed_at n l -> closed_at m (1+l) -> closed_at z l -> closed_at s (2+l) -> closed_at (a_natrec m z s n) l )
 | ca_pi : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pi t b) n )
 | ca_lam : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_fn t b) n )
 | ca_app : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_app a1 a2) n )
 | ca_sigma : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at b (1+n) -> closed_at (a_sigma t b) n )
 | ca_pair : `( closed_at a1 n -> closed_at b1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at b2 (1+n) -> closed_at (a_pair a1 b1 a2 b2) n )
 | ca_fst : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_fst a) n )
 | ca_snd : `( closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_snd a) n )
 | ca_eq : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a1 n -> closed_at a2 n -> closed_at (a_eq t a1 a2) n )
 | ca_refl : `( closed_at t n -> closed_at a n -> closed_at (a_refl t a) n )
 | ca_eqrec : `( closed_at a l -> closed_at m (3+l) -> closed_at r (1+l) -> closed_at m1 l -> closed_at m2 l -> closed_at n l -> closed_at (a_eqrec a m r m1 m2 n) l )

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Adequacy reduction (scratch additions)                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* A corrected substitution-realising environment relation.  It uses a
   separate environment for the source and target contexts, and records
   the readback data for every variable of the target context. *)
Definition RsubA (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρΓ ρΔ : env) : Prop :=
  eval_sub σ ρΓ ρΔ /\
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρΔ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρΔ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

(* The term-level fundamental theorem for NbE.  This is the precise
   remaining adequacy/normalisation gap: it says that the readback of the
   evaluation of a well-typed term at a substitution-realising environment
   is syntactically well typed and equal to the substituted term. *)
Theorem NbE_fundamental :
  forall Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ,
    {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> RsubA Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ ->
    forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists a m W,
        eval_exp A ρΔ a /\ eval_exp M ρΔ m /\
        read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.
Admitted.

(* The initial environment realises the identity substitution.  The empty
   case is proved below; the extension case is the level-shift/readback
   weakening step and is stated separately. *)
Lemma RsubA_initial_cons :
  forall A Γ ρ ρΔ i,
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ ->
    initial_env (A :: Γ) ρΔ ->
    RsubA (A :: Γ) (A :: Γ) a_id ρΔ ρΔ.
Admitted.

Lemma RsubA_initial_nil :
  RsubA nil nil a_id empty_env empty_env.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply eval_sub_id.
  - intros x A Hlk. inversion Hlk.
Qed.

Lemma RsubA_initial :
  forall Γ ρ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> initial_env Γ ρ -> RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ Hwf Hinit.
  - inversion Hwf; subst. inversion Hinit; subst. exact RsubA_initial_nil.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    inversion Hinit; subst.
    eapply RsubA_initial_cons; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of nbe into its evaluation/readback components. *)
Lemma nbe_inv : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W ->
  exists ρ a m,
    initial_env Γ ρ /\ eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
    read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. inversion H; subst.
  repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem NTmS_proved : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HM) as Hwf.
  destruct (RsubA_initial Γ ρ Hwf Hinit) as [Hsub HR].
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  destruct (NbE_fundamental Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ Hid (conj Hsub HR)
              A M HM) as [a' [m' [W' [Ha' [Hm' [Hr' [HW' Heq]]]]]]].
  assert (Ha_eq : a = a') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  assert (Hm_eq : m = m') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  subst a' m'.
  assert (HW_eq : W = W')
      by (eapply (proj1 read_det (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W Hr); eassumption).
  subst W'.
  destruct (wf_exp_type Γ A M HM) as [i HAty].
  assert (HAid_eq : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HAty).
  assert (HW : {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HW' | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  split; [exact HW|].
  (* Heq : M[Id] ≈ W : A[Id]; retype to A *)
  assert (HeqA : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_conv with (A := a_sub A a_id) (i := i);
      [exact Heq | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  assert (Hmid : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ M : A }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id; exact HM).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hmid | exact HeqA].
Qed.

Theorem NTS_proved : forall Γ A W i,
  nbe_ty Γ A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W i Hnbe HA.
  apply NTmS_proved with (M := A) (A := a_typ i).
  - apply (proj1 (nbe_ty_nbe Γ A i W)); exact Hnbe.
  - exact HA.
Qed.

(* The two easy closed term-adequacy instances. *)

Lemma read_typ_univ_inv : forall s i W,
  read_typ s (d_univ i) W -> W = nf_typ i.
Proof. intros. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma read_nf_univ_univ_inv : forall s i j W,
  read_nf s (d_dom (d_univ i) (d_univ j)) W -> W = nf_typ j.
Proof.
  intros s i j W H. inversion H; subst.
  eapply read_typ_univ_inv; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma read_typ_nat_inv : forall s W,
  read_typ s d_nat W -> W = nf_nat.
Proof. intros. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma read_nf_univ_nat_inv : forall s i W,
  read_nf s (d_dom (d_univ i) d_nat) W -> W = nf_nat.
Proof.
  intros s i W H. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with
  | Hr : read_typ _ d_nat _ |- _ =>
      let E := fresh "E" in
      assert (E : _ = nf_nat) by (eapply read_typ_nat_inv; exact Hr);
      subst; reflexivity
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ntms_typ_closed : forall Γ i j W,
  nbe Γ (a_typ j) (a_typ i) W ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ i j W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  inversion Ha; subst a.
  inversion Hm; subst m.
  assert (HW : W = nf_typ j) by (eapply read_nf_univ_univ_inv; exact Hr).
  subst W.
  split.
  - exact HM.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HM.
Qed.

Lemma ntms_nat_closed : forall Γ i W,
  nbe Γ a_nat (a_typ i) W ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ i W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  inversion Ha; subst a.
  inversion Hm; subst m.
  assert (HW : W = nf_nat) by (eapply read_nf_univ_nat_inv; exact Hr).
  subst W.
  split.
  - exact HM.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HM.
Qed.


(* A few genuinely unconditional instances of NTS.  In these cases the
   readback is syntactically the same expression as the input type, so no
   logical relation is needed. *)

Lemma NTS_typ_closed : forall Γ j W i,
  nbe_ty Γ (a_typ j) W -> {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ j W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_typ j) by (eapply nbe_ty_typ; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma NTS_nat_closed : forall Γ W i,
  nbe_ty Γ a_nat W -> {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_nat) by (eapply nbe_ty_nat; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma NTS_var_closed : forall Γ x W i,
  nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) W -> {{ Γ ⊢ #x : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ #x ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ x W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_neut (ne_var x)) by (eapply nbe_ty_var; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Adequacy reduction (scratch additions)                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* A corrected substitution-realising environment relation.  It uses a
   separate environment for the source and target contexts, and records
   the readback data for every variable of the target context. *)
Definition RsubA (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρΓ ρΔ : env) : Prop :=
  eval_sub σ ρΓ ρΔ /\
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρΔ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρΔ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

(* The term-level fundamental theorem for NbE.  This is the precise
   remaining adequacy/normalisation gap: it says that the readback of the
   evaluation of a well-typed term at a substitution-realising environment
   is syntactically well typed and equal to the substituted term. *)
Theorem NbE_fundamental :
  forall Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ,
    {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> RsubA Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ ->
    forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists a m W,
        eval_exp A ρΔ a /\ eval_exp M ρΔ m /\
        read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.
Admitted.

(* The initial environment realises the identity substitution.  The empty
   case is proved below; the extension case is the level-shift/readback
   weakening step and is stated separately. *)
Lemma RsubA_initial_cons :
  forall A Γ ρ ρΔ i,
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ ->
    initial_env (A :: Γ) ρΔ ->
    RsubA (A :: Γ) (A :: Γ) a_id ρΔ ρΔ.
Admitted.

Lemma RsubA_initial_nil :
  RsubA nil nil a_id empty_env empty_env.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply eval_sub_id.
  - intros x A Hlk. inversion Hlk.
Qed.

Lemma RsubA_initial :
  forall Γ ρ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> initial_env Γ ρ -> RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ Hwf Hinit.
  - inversion Hwf; subst. inversion Hinit; subst. exact RsubA_initial_nil.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    inversion Hinit; subst.
    eapply RsubA_initial_cons; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of nbe into its evaluation/readback components. *)
Lemma nbe_inv : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W ->
  exists ρ a m,
    initial_env Γ ρ /\ eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
    read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. inversion H; subst.
  repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem NTmS_proved : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HM) as Hwf.
  destruct (RsubA_initial Γ ρ Hwf Hinit) as [Hsub HR].
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  destruct (NbE_fundamental Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ Hid (conj Hsub HR)
              A M HM) as [a' [m' [W' [Ha' [Hm' [Hr' [HW' Heq]]]]]]].
  assert (Ha_eq : a = a') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  assert (Hm_eq : m = m') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  subst a' m'.
  assert (HW_eq : W = W')
      by (eapply (proj1 read_det (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W Hr); eassumption).
  subst W'.
  destruct (wf_exp_type Γ A M HM) as [i HAty].
  assert (HAid_eq : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HAty).
  assert (HW : {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HW' | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  split; [exact HW|].
  (* Heq : M[Id] ≈ W : A[Id]; retype to A *)
  assert (HeqA : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_conv with (A := a_sub A a_id) (i := i);
      [exact Heq | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  assert (Hmid : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ M : A }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id; exact HM).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hmid | exact HeqA].
Qed.

Theorem NTS_proved : forall Γ A W i,
  nbe_ty Γ A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W i Hnbe HA.
  apply NTmS_proved with (M := A) (A := a_typ i).
  - apply (proj1 (nbe_ty_nbe Γ A i W)); exact Hnbe.
  - exact HA.
Qed.

(* The two easy closed term-adequacy instances. *)

Lemma read_typ_univ_inv : forall s i W,
  read_typ s (d_univ i) W -> W = nf_typ i.
Proof. intros. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma read_nf_univ_univ_inv : forall s i j W,
  read_nf s (d_dom (d_univ i) (d_univ j)) W -> W = nf_typ j.
Proof.
  intros s i j W H. inversion H; subst.
  eapply read_typ_univ_inv; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma read_typ_nat_inv : forall s W,
  read_typ s d_nat W -> W = nf_nat.
Proof. intros. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma read_nf_univ_nat_inv : forall s i W,
  read_nf s (d_dom (d_univ i) d_nat) W -> W = nf_nat.
Proof.
  intros s i W H. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with
  | Hr : read_typ _ d_nat _ |- _ =>
      let E := fresh "E" in
      assert (E : _ = nf_nat) by (eapply read_typ_nat_inv; exact Hr);
      subst; reflexivity
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ntms_typ_closed : forall Γ i j W,
  nbe Γ (a_typ j) (a_typ i) W ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ i j W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  inversion Ha; subst a.
  inversion Hm; subst m.
  assert (HW : W = nf_typ j) by (eapply read_nf_univ_univ_inv; exact Hr).
  subst W.
  split.
  - exact HM.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HM.
Qed.

Lemma ntms_nat_closed : forall Γ i W,
  nbe Γ a_nat (a_typ i) W ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ i W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  inversion Ha; subst a.
  inversion Hm; subst m.
  assert (HW : W = nf_nat) by (eapply read_nf_univ_nat_inv; exact Hr).
  subst W.
  split.
  - exact HM.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HM.
Qed.


(* A few genuinely unconditional instances of NTS.  In these cases the
   readback is syntactically the same expression as the input type, so no
   logical relation is needed. *)

Lemma NTS_typ_closed : forall Γ j W i,
  nbe_ty Γ (a_typ j) W -> {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ Type@j ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ j W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_typ j) by (eapply nbe_ty_typ; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma NbE_var_lookup :
  forall Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ x A,
    RsubA Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ -> {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->

  - split; [exact Hread|]. split; assumption.

   expression, term adequacy is immediate.  This covers the universe, nat,

Lemma NTmS_of_readback_refl : forall Γ M A W,

Proof.
