(* A corrected variable shift for normal/neutral forms.  The supplied
   wk_ne maps [ne_var x] to [S s - x - 1], which does not shift free
   variables (it confuses the level with the shift).  The operation below
   is the standard "insert s dummy variables at the front of the ambient
   context": variables below the depth d of enclosing binders are left
   alone, and all free variables are shifted by s. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (s d : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B =>
      nf_pair (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d N)
              (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (shift_ne s d N)
  end
with shift_ne (s d : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x =>
      if Nat.leb (S x) d then ne_var x else ne_var (x + s)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (shift_ne s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (shift_nf s (S d) A) (shift_nf s d MZ)
                (shift_nf s (S (S d)) MS) (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S (S (S d))) B)
               (shift_nf s (S d) BR) (shift_nf s d M)
               (shift_nf s d M') (shift_ne s d N)
  end.

Scheme nf_mut_ind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with ne_mut_ind := Induction for ne Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme nf_ne_mut_ind from nf_mut_ind, ne_mut_ind.

Lemma shift_zero_mut :
  (forall W d, shift_nf 0 d W = W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne 0 d N = N).
Proof.
  apply (nf_ne_mut_ind
    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf 0 d W = W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne 0 d N = N)).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb x d') eqn:E; simpl; rewrite E.
      * reflexivity.
      * rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_zero : forall s W, shift_nf 0 s W = W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 shift_zero_mut W s). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_zero : forall s N, shift_ne 0 s N = N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 shift_zero_mut N s). Qed.


Lemma shift_ne_var_true : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = true -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var x.
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_var_false : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = false -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var (x + s).
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Composition of the corrected shift. *)
Lemma shift_add_mut : forall s t,
  (forall W d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N).
Proof.
  intros s t.
  apply (nf_ne_mut_ind
    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N)).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t 0 x) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s 0 (x + t)) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) 0 x) by reflexivity.
      replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
    + remember (Nat.leb (S x) (S d')) as b eqn:E.
      destruct b.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true t (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true s (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
        reflexivity.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t (S d') x) by exact E.
        remember (Nat.leb (S (x + t)) (S d')) as b2 eqn:E2.
        destruct b2.
        -- symmetry in E2. exfalso.
           apply Nat.leb_le in E2. apply Nat.leb_gt in E. lia.
        -- symmetry in E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s (S d') (x + t)) by exact E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
           replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_add : forall s t W d,
  shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (shift_add_mut s t) W d). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_add : forall s t N d,
  shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (shift_add_mut s t) N d). Qed.

(* A corrected substitution-realising environment relation.  It uses a
   separate environment for the source and target contexts, and records
   the readback data for every variable of the target context. *)
Definition RsubA (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρΓ ρΔ : env) : Prop :=
  eval_sub σ ρΓ ρΔ /\
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρΔ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρΔ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

(* The term-level fundamental theorem for NbE.  This is the precise
   remaining adequacy/normalisation gap: it says that the readback of the
   evaluation of a well-typed term at a substitution-realising environment
   is syntactically well typed and equal to the substituted term. *)
Theorem NbE_fundamental :
  forall Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ,
    {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> RsubA Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ ->
    forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists a m W,
        eval_exp A ρΔ a /\ eval_exp M ρΔ m /\
        read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.
Admitted.

(* The initial environment realises the identity substitution.  The empty
   case is proved below; the extension case is the level-shift/readback
   weakening step and is stated separately. *)
Lemma RsubA_initial_cons :
  forall A Γ ρ ρΔ i,
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ ->
    initial_env (A :: Γ) ρΔ ->
    RsubA (A :: Γ) (A :: Γ) a_id ρΔ ρΔ.
Admitted.

Lemma RsubA_initial_nil :
  RsubA nil nil a_id empty_env empty_env.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply eval_sub_id.
  - intros x A Hlk. inversion Hlk.
Qed.

Lemma RsubA_initial :
  forall Γ ρ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> initial_env Γ ρ -> RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ Hwf Hinit.
  - inversion Hwf; subst. inversion Hinit; subst. exact RsubA_initial_nil.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    inversion Hinit; subst.
    eapply RsubA_initial_cons; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of nbe into its evaluation/readback components. *)
Lemma nbe_inv : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W ->
  exists ρ a m,
    initial_env Γ ρ /\ eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
    read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. inversion H; subst.
  repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem NTmS_proved : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HM) as Hwf.
  destruct (RsubA_initial Γ ρ Hwf Hinit) as [Hsub HR].
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  destruct (NbE_fundamental Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ Hid (conj Hsub HR)
              A M HM) as [a' [m' [W' [Ha' [Hm' [Hr' [HW' Heq]]]]]]].
  assert (Ha_eq : a = a') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  assert (Hm_eq : m = m') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  subst a' m'.
  assert (HW_eq : W = W')
      by (eapply (proj1 read_det (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W Hr); eassumption).
  subst W'.
  destruct (wf_exp_type Γ A M HM) as [i HAty].
  assert (HAid_eq : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HAty).
  assert (HW : {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HW' | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  split; [exact HW|].
  (* Heq : M[Id] ≈ W : A[Id]; retype to A *)
  assert (HeqA : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ W : A }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_conv with (A := a_sub A a_id) (i := i);
      [exact Heq | exact HAid_eq | exact HAty]. }
  assert (Hmid : {{ Γ ⊢ M[Id] ≈ M : A }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id; exact HM).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hmid | exact HeqA].
Qed.

Theorem NTS_proved : forall Γ A W i,
  nbe_ty Γ A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W i Hnbe HA.
  apply NTmS_proved with (M := A) (A := a_typ i).
  - apply (proj1 (nbe_ty_nbe Γ A i W)); exact Hnbe.
  - exact HA.

   is the standard "insert s dummy variables at the front of the ambient

   alone, and all free variables are shifted by s. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (s d : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B =>
      nf_pair (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d N)
              (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (shift_ne s d N)
  end
with shift_ne (s d : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x =>
      if Nat.leb (S x) d then ne_var x else ne_var (x + s)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (shift_ne s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (shift_nf s (S d) A) (shift_nf s d MZ)
                (shift_nf s (S (S d)) MS) (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S (S (S d))) B)
               (shift_nf s (S d) BR) (shift_nf s d M)
               (shift_nf s d M') (shift_ne s d N)
  end.

Scheme nf_mut_ind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with ne_mut_ind := Induction for ne Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme nf_ne_mut_ind from nf_mut_ind, ne_mut_ind.

Lemma shift_zero_mut :
  (forall W d, shift_nf 0 d W = W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne 0 d N = N).
Proof.
  apply (nf_ne_mut_ind
    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf 0 d W = W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne 0 d N = N)).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb x d') eqn:E; simpl; rewrite E.
      * reflexivity.
      * rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_zero : forall s W, shift_nf 0 s W = W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 shift_zero_mut W s). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_zero : forall s N, shift_ne 0 s N = N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 shift_zero_mut N s). Qed.


Lemma shift_ne_var_true : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = true -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var x.
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_var_false : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = false -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var (x + s).
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Composition of the corrected shift. *)
Lemma shift_add_mut : forall s t,
  (forall W d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N).
Proof.
  intros s t.
  apply (nf_ne_mut_ind
    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N)).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t 0 x) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s 0 (x + t)) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) 0 x) by reflexivity.
      replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
    + remember (Nat.leb (S x) (S d')) as b eqn:E.
      destruct b.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true t (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true s (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
        reflexivity.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t (S d') x) by exact E.
        remember (Nat.leb (S (x + t)) (S d')) as b2 eqn:E2.
        destruct b2.
        -- symmetry in E2. exfalso.
           apply Nat.leb_le in E2. apply Nat.leb_gt in E. lia.
        -- symmetry in E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s (S d') (x + t)) by exact E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
           replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_add : forall s t W d,
  shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (shift_add_mut s t) W d). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_add : forall s t N d,
  shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (shift_add_mut s t) N d). Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_wf_zero : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ zero : ℕ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ zero : ℕ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ Hctx H. destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ Hctx) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
  apply wf_zero. exact HwfΔ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_ctx_sub_l : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ H. induction H as [| Γ Δ i A A' Hpre IH HA HA' HA0 HA0' Heq Heq'] using wf_ctx_eq_ind.
  - apply wf_ctx_sub_empty.
  - eapply wf_ctx_sub_extend; [exact IH|exact HA|exact HA0'|].
    eapply wf_subtyp_of_eq; [exact Heq|exact HA'].
Qed.

Lemma wf_ctx_eq_ctx_sub_r : forall Γ Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Δ ⊆ Γ }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ H. apply wf_ctx_eq_ctx_sub_l. apply wf_ctx_eq_sym. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_eq_transport_all :
  (forall Γ (H : {{ ⊢ Γ }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Δ }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ (H : {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }}), True) /\
  (forall Γ A M (H : {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }}) /\
  (forall Γ A M M' (H : {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ' σ (H : {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ' }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢s σ : Δ' }}) /\
  (forall Γ Δ' σ σ' (H : {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ' }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ' }}) /\
  (forall Γ A A' (H : {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }}), forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }}).
Proof.
  apply (syntactic_wf_mut_ind
    (fun Γ (_ : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ ⊢ Δ }})
    (fun Γ Δ (H : {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }}) => True)
    (fun Γ A M (_ : {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }})
    (fun Γ A M M' (_ : {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }})
    (fun Γ Δ' σ (_ : {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ' }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢s σ : Δ' }})
    (fun Γ Δ' σ σ' (_ : {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ' }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ' }})
    (fun Γ A A' (_ : {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }}) => forall Δ, {{ ⊢ Γ ≈ Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }})).
  - (* ctx empty *) intros Δ HΔ. inversion HΔ. apply wf_ctx_empty.
  - (* ctx extend *) intros Γ i A Hwf IH HA IHA Δ HΔ. inversion HΔ; subst.
    eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ eapply IH; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - (* ctx_sub empty *) intros. exact I.
  - (* ctx_sub extend *) intros. exact I.
  - (* typ *) intros Γ i Hwf IH Δ HΔ. apply wf_typ. eapply IH; eassumption.
  - (* nat *) intros Γ Hwf IH Δ HΔ. apply wf_nat. eapply IH; eassumption.
  - (* zero *) intros Γ Hwf IH Δ HΔ. apply wf_zero. eapply IH; eassumption.
  - (* succ *) intros Γ M HM IHM Δ HΔ. apply wf_succ. eapply IHM; eassumption.
  - (* natrec *) intros Γ i A MZ MS M HA IHA HMZ IHMZ HMS IHMS HM IHM Δ HΔ.
    destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ HΔ) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
    assert (HnatΓ : {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}) by (apply wf_nat; exact HwfΓ).
    assert (HnatΔ : {{ Δ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }}) by (apply wf_nat; exact HwfΔ).
    assert (HctxN : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ ≈ Δ, ℕ }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHA _ HctxN) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxNA : {{ ⊢ Γ, ℕ, A ≈ Δ, ℕ, A }})
      by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; [exact HctxN|exact HA|exact HAΔ]).
    pose proof (IHMZ _ HΔ) as HMZΔ.
    pose proof (IHMS _ HctxNA) as HMSΔ.
    pose proof (IHM _ HΔ) as HMΔ.
    eapply wf_natrec; eassumption.
  - (* pi *) intros Γ i A B HA IHA HB IHB Δ HΔ.
    destruct (wf_ctx_eq_ctx Γ Δ HΔ) as [HwfΓ HwfΔ].
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    eapply wf_pi; eassumption.
  - (* fn *) intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HM IHM Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHM _ HctxA) as HMΔ.
    eapply wf_fn; eassumption.
  - (* app *) intros Γ i A B M N HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM HN IHN Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    pose proof (IHM _ HΔ) as HMΔ.
    pose proof (IHN _ HΔ) as HNΔ.
    eapply wf_app; eassumption.
  - (* sigma *) intros Γ i A B HA IHA HB IHB Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    eapply wf_sigma; eassumption.
  - (* pair *) intros Γ i A B M N HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM HN IHN Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    pose proof (IHM _ HΔ) as HMΔ.
    pose proof (IHN _ HΔ) as HNΔ.
    eapply wf_pair; eassumption.
  - (* fst *) intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    pose proof (IHM _ HΔ) as HMΔ.
    eapply wf_fst; eassumption.
  - (* snd *) intros Γ i A B M HA IHA HB IHB HM IHM Δ HΔ.
    pose proof (IHA _ HΔ) as HAΔ.
    assert (HctxA : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Δ, A }}) by (eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend_same; eassumption).
    pose proof (IHB _ HctxA) as HBΔ.
    pose proof (IHM _ HΔ) as HMΔ.
    eapply wf_snd; eassumption.
  - (* vlookup *) intros Γ x A Hwf IH Hlk Δ HΔ.
    destruct (wf_ctx_eq_vlookup Γ Δ HΔ x A Hlk) as [A' [Hlk' Htyp]].

Definition Rsub (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρ : env) : Prop :=
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

Lemma check_complete_from_infer :
  (forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
       exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}) ->
  (forall Γ A B, {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B }} -> alg_subtyping Γ A B) ->
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
     forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> alg_type_check Γ A M.
Proof.
  intros HInfer HSub M Hu Γ A HM.
  destruct (HInfer M Hu Γ A HM) as [B [Hinf Hsub]].
  eapply atc_ati.
  - exact Hinf.
  - eapply HSub. exact Hsub.
Qed.

Definition RsubFundamentalStmt : Prop :=
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A i, {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
        exists a WA, eval_exp A ρ a /\ read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }})
  /\
  (forall Γ Δ σ ρ,
      {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> Rsub Γ Δ σ ρ ->
      forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
        exists a m W, eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
          read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
          {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }})
  /\
  (forall Δ ρ, {{ ⊢ Δ }} -> initial_env Δ ρ -> Rsub Δ Δ a_id ρ).

Definition InferCompleteUserStmt : Prop :=
  forall (M : exp), user_exp M ->
    forall Γ A, {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists B : nf, alg_type_infer Γ B M /\ {{ Γ ⊢ B ⊆ A }}.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Targets                                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Theorem alg_type_check_sound : forall {Γ i A M},
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }} ->
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }}.
Admitted.

Theorem alg_type_check_complete : forall {Γ A M},
    user_exp M ->
    {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
    {{ Γ ⊢a M ⟸ A }}.
Admitted.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Adequacy reduction (scratch additions)                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* A corrected substitution-realising environment relation.  It uses a
   separate environment for the source and target contexts, and records
   the readback data for every variable of the target context. *)
Definition RsubA (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) (ρΓ ρΔ : env) : Prop :=
  eval_sub σ ρΓ ρΔ /\
  forall x A, {{ #x : A ∈ Δ }} ->
    exists i a WA W,
      {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }} /\
      eval_exp A ρΔ a /\
      read_typ (length Γ) a WA /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ WA : Type@i }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ WA : Type@i }} /\
      read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a (ρΔ x)) W /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
      {{ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.

(* The term-level fundamental theorem for NbE.  This is the precise
   remaining adequacy/normalisation gap: it says that the readback of the
   evaluation of a well-typed term at a substitution-realising environment
   is syntactically well typed and equal to the substituted term. *)
Theorem NbE_fundamental :
  forall Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ,
    {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> RsubA Γ Δ σ ρΓ ρΔ ->
    forall A M, {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
      exists a m W,
        eval_exp A ρΔ a /\ eval_exp M ρΔ m /\
        read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ W : A[σ] }} /\
        {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ W : A[σ] }}.
Admitted.

(* The initial environment realises the identity substitution.  The empty
   case is proved below; the extension case is the level-shift/readback
   weakening step and is stated separately. *)
Lemma RsubA_initial_cons :
  forall A Γ ρ ρΔ i,
    {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
    RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ ->
    initial_env (A :: Γ) ρΔ ->
    RsubA (A :: Γ) (A :: Γ) a_id ρΔ ρΔ.
Admitted.

Lemma RsubA_initial_nil :
  RsubA nil nil a_id empty_env empty_env.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply eval_sub_id.
  - intros x A Hlk. inversion Hlk.
Qed.

Lemma RsubA_initial :
  forall Γ ρ, {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> initial_env Γ ρ -> RsubA Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| A Γ IH]; intros ρ Hwf Hinit.
  - inversion Hwf; subst. inversion Hinit; subst. exact RsubA_initial_nil.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    inversion Hinit; subst.
    eapply RsubA_initial_cons; eauto.
Qed.

(* Inversion of nbe into its evaluation/readback components. *)
Lemma nbe_inv : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W ->
  exists ρ a m,
    initial_env Γ ρ /\ eval_exp A ρ a /\ eval_exp M ρ m /\
    read_nf (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W H. inversion H; subst.
  repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem NTmS_proved : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W Hnbe HM.
  destruct (nbe_inv _ _ _ _ Hnbe) as [ρ [a [m [Hinit [Ha [Hm Hr]]]]]].
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HM) as Hwf.
  destruct (RsubA_initial Γ ρ Hwf Hinit) as [Hsub HR].
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  destruct (NbE_fundamental Γ Γ a_id ρ ρ Hid (conj Hsub HR)
              A M HM) as [a' [m' [W' [Ha' [Hm' [Hr' [HW' Heq]]]]]]].
  assert (Ha_eq : a = a') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  assert (Hm_eq : m = m') by (eapply eval_exp_fun; eassumption).
  subst a' m'.
  assert (HW_eq : W = W')
      by (eapply (proj1 read_det (length Γ) (d_dom a m) W Hr); eassumption).
  subst W'.
  destruct (wf_exp_type Γ A M HM) as [i HAty].
  assert (HAid_eq : {{ Γ ⊢ A[Id] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HAty).

Lemma eval_fst_det : forall m r, eval_fst m r -> forall r', eval_fst m r' -> r = r'.
Proof.
  intros m r H. induction H; intros r' H'; inversion H'; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eval_det :
  (forall e ρ d, eval_exp e ρ d -> forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d') /\
  (forall A MZ MS m ρ r, eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r -> forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m n r, eval_app m n r -> forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall m r, eval_snd m r -> forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r, eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r -> forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r') /\
  (forall σ ρ ρσ, eval_sub σ ρ ρσ -> forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ').
Proof.
  apply (eval_mut_ind
    (fun e ρ d _ => forall d', eval_exp e ρ d' -> d = d')
    (fun A MZ MS m ρ r _ => forall r', eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun m n r _ => forall r', eval_app m n r' -> r = r')
    (fun m r _ => forall r', eval_snd m r' -> r = r')
    (fun a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r _ => forall r', eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r' -> r = r')
    (fun σ ρ ρσ _ => forall ρσ', eval_sub σ ρ ρσ' -> ρσ = ρσ')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; rewrite E in *; clear E
        end; subst; try reflexivity; try assumption; try congruence
    end.
  all: try solve [eapply eval_fst_det; eassumption].
Qed.

Definition eval_exp_fun := proj1 eval_det.
Definition eval_natrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 eval_det).
Definition eval_app_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)).
Definition eval_snd_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det))).
Definition eval_eqrec_fun := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).
Definition eval_sub_fun := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 eval_det)))).

Lemma read_det :
  (forall s m W, read_nf s m W -> forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_ne s m W -> forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W') /\
  (forall s m W, read_typ s m W -> forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W').
Proof.
  apply (read_mut_ind
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_nf s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_ne s m W' -> W = W')
    (fun s m W _ => forall W', read_typ s m W' -> W = W')).
  all: intros; try match goal with
    | H : ?R ?c |- ?lhs = ?c =>
        inversion H; subst;
        repeat match goal with
          | IH2 : forall y, ?R2 y -> ?a2 = ?b2, H2 : ?R2 ?c2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (IH2 c2 H2) as E; clear IH2; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d, H2 : eval_exp ?e ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_exp_fun e r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d, H2 : eval_natrec ?A ?MZ ?MS ?m ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_natrec_fun A MZ MS m r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d, H2 : eval_app ?m ?n ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_app_fun m n d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_snd ?m ?d, H2 : eval_snd ?m ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_snd_fun m d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d, H2 : eval_eqrec ?a ?B ?BR ?m1 ?m2 ?n ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_eqrec_fun a B BR m1 m2 n r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d, H2 : eval_sub ?s ?r ?d2 |- _ =>
              let E := fresh in pose proof (eval_sub_fun s r d H1 d2 H2) as E; clear H1; clear H2; rewrite E in *; clear E
          | H1 : eval_fst ?m ?d, H2 : eval_fst ?m ?d2 |- _ =>

Lemma initial_env_det : forall Γ ρ1, initial_env Γ ρ1 -> forall ρ2, initial_env Γ ρ2 -> ρ1 = ρ2.

From Coq Require Import List String.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Module Cst.

Inductive obj : Set :=
| typ : nat -> obj
| nat : obj
| zero : obj
| succ : obj -> obj
| natrec : obj -> string -> obj -> obj -> string -> string -> obj -> obj
| pi : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| fn : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| app : obj -> obj -> obj
| sigma : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| pair : obj -> obj -> obj -> string -> obj -> obj
| fst : obj -> obj
| snd : obj -> obj
| prop_eq : obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| refl : obj -> obj -> obj
| eqrec : obj ->
          string -> string -> string -> obj ->
          string -> obj ->
          obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| var : string -> obj.

End Cst.

Reserved Notation "'typ'".

Inductive exp : Set :=

| a_typ : nat -> typ

| a_nat : typ
| a_zero : exp
| a_succ : exp -> exp
| a_natrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> exp

| a_pi : typ -> typ -> exp
| a_fn : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_app : exp -> exp -> exp

| a_sigma : exp -> exp -> exp
| a_pair : exp -> typ -> exp -> typ -> exp
| a_fst : exp -> exp
| a_snd : exp -> exp

| a_eq : typ -> exp -> exp -> exp
| a_refl : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_eqrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> typ -> exp -> exp

| a_var : nat -> exp

| a_sub : exp -> sub -> exp
with sub : Set :=
| a_id : sub
| a_weaken : sub
| a_compose : sub -> sub -> sub
| a_extend : sub -> exp -> sub
where "'typ'" := exp.

Notation ctx := (list exp).

Fixpoint nat_to_exp n : exp :=
  match n with
  | 0 => a_zero
  | S m => a_succ (nat_to_exp m)
  end.

Definition num_to_exp n := nat_to_exp (Nat.of_num_uint n).

Fixpoint exp_to_nat e : option nat :=
  match e with
  | a_zero => Some 0
  | a_succ e' =>
      match exp_to_nat e' with
      | Some n => Some (S n)
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition exp_to_num e :=
  match exp_to_nat e with
  | Some n => Some (Nat.to_num_uint n)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive nf : Set :=
| nf_typ : nat -> nf
| nf_nat : nf
| nf_zero : nf
| nf_succ : nf -> nf
| nf_pi : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_fn : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_sigma : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_pair : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_eq : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_refl : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_neut : ne -> nf
with ne : Set :=
| ne_natrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
| ne_app : ne -> nf -> ne
| ne_fst : ne -> ne
| ne_snd : ne -> ne
| ne_var : nat -> ne
| ne_eqrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
.

Fixpoint nf_to_exp (M : nf) : exp :=
  match M with
  | nf_typ i => a_typ i
  | nf_nat => a_nat
  | nf_zero => a_zero
  | nf_succ M => a_succ (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_pi A B => a_pi (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_fn A M => a_fn (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_sigma A B => a_sigma (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => a_pair (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp N) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_eq A M N => a_eq (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | nf_refl A M => a_refl (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_neut M => ne_to_exp M
  end
with ne_to_exp (M : ne) : exp :=
  match M with
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M => a_natrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp MZ) (nf_to_exp MS) (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_app M N => a_app (ne_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | ne_fst M => a_fst (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_snd M => a_snd (ne_to_exp M)
  | ne_var x => a_var x
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      a_eqrec (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B) (nf_to_exp BR) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp M') (ne_to_exp N)
  end
.

Coercion nf_to_exp : nf >-> exp.

Coercion ne_to_exp : ne >-> exp.

Definition q σ := a_extend (a_compose σ a_weaken) (a_var 0).

Arguments q σ/.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry exp.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with exp.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with sub.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with nf.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with ne.

Open Scope mctt_scope.

Module Syntax_Notations.

Notation "e [ s ]" := (a_sub e s) (in custom exp at level 0, e custom exp, s custom exp at level 60, left associativity, format "e [ s ]") : mctt_scope.

Notation "{{{ x }}}" := x (at level 0, x custom exp at level 99, format "'{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom exp at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Type' @ n" := (a_typ n) (in custom exp at level 0, n constr at level 0, format "'Type' @ n") : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := a_nat (in custom exp) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := a_zero (in custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' e" := (a_succ e) (in custom exp at level 1, e custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' e 'return' A | 'zero' -> ez | 'succ' -> es 'end'" := (a_natrec A ez es e) (in custom exp at level 0, A custom exp at level 60, ez custom exp at level 60, es custom exp at level 60, e custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' A B" := (a_pi A B) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, B custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' A e" := (a_fn A e) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, e custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' A B" := (a_sigma A B) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 0, B custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩" := (a_pair M A N B) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at next level, A custom exp at next level, N custom exp at next level, B custom exp at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' M" := (a_fst M) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' M" := (a_snd M) (in custom exp at level 1, M custom exp at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (a_app .. (a_app f x) .. y) (in custom exp at level 40, f custom exp, x custom exp at next level, y custom exp at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' A M N" := (a_eq A M N) (in custom exp at level 1, A custom exp at level 30, M custom exp at level 35, N custom exp at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' N 'as' 'Eq' A M1 M2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (a_eqrec A B BR M1 M2 N) (in custom exp at level 0, A custom exp at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, M1 custom exp at level 35, M2 custom exp at level 40, N custom exp at level 60) : mctt_scope.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Reserved Notation "'env'".

Inductive domain : Set :=
| d_univ : nat -> domain
| d_nat : domain
| d_zero : domain
| d_succ : domain -> domain
| d_pi : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_fn : env -> exp -> domain
| d_sigma : domain -> env -> exp -> domain
| d_pair : domain -> domain -> domain
| d_eq : domain -> domain -> domain -> domain
| d_refl : domain -> domain
| d_neut : domain -> domain_ne -> domain
with domain_ne : Set :=




| d_var : forall (x : nat), domain_ne
| d_app : domain_ne -> domain_nf -> domain_ne
| d_fst : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_snd : domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_natrec : env -> typ -> domain -> exp -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
| d_eqrec : env -> domain -> typ -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain_ne -> domain_ne
with domain_nf : Set :=
| d_dom : domain -> domain -> domain_nf
where "'env'" := (nat -> domain).

Definition empty_env : env := fun x => d_zero.

Arguments empty_env _ /.

Definition extend_env (ρ : env) (d : domain) : env :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => d
    | S n' => ρ n'
    end.

Arguments extend_env _ _ _ /.

Definition drop_env (ρ : env) : env := fun n => ρ (S n).

Arguments drop_env _ _ /.

#[global] Declare Custom Entry domain.

#[global] Bind Scope mctt_scope with domain.

Module Domain_Notations.

Export Syntax_Notations.

Notation "'d{{{' x '}}}'" := x (at level 0, x custom domain at level 99, format "'d{{{'  x  '}}}'") : mctt_scope.

Notation "( x )" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'^' x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "x" := x (in custom domain at level 0, x ident) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'𝕌' @ n" := (d_univ n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'ℕ'" := d_nat (in custom domain) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'zero'" := d_zero (in custom domain at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'succ' m" := (d_succ m) (in custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'rec' m 'under' ρ 'return' P | 'zero' -> mz | 'succ' -> MS 'end'" := (d_natrec ρ P mz MS m) (in custom domain at level 0, P custom exp at level 60, mz custom domain at level 60, MS custom exp at level 60, ρ custom domain at level 60, m custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Π' a ρ B" := (d_pi a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'λ' ρ M" := (d_fn ρ M) (in custom domain at level 0, ρ custom domain at level 30, M custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "f x .. y" := (d_app .. (d_app f x) .. y) (in custom domain at level 40, f custom domain, x custom domain at next level, y custom domain at next level) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Σ' a ρ B" := (d_sigma a ρ B) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, ρ custom domain at level 0, B custom exp at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "⟨ a ; b ⟩ " := (d_pair a b) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, b custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'fst' e" := (d_fst e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'snd' e" := (d_snd e) (in custom domain at level 0, e custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'Eq' a m n" := (d_eq a m n) (in custom domain at level 1, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 35, n custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'refl' m" := (d_refl m) (in custom domain at level 1, m custom domain at level 40) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'eqrec' n 'under' ρ 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 'return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end'" := (d_eqrec ρ a B BR m1 m2 n) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, B custom exp at level 60, BR custom exp at level 60, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, n custom domain at level 60) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'!' n" := (d_var n) (in custom domain at level 0, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑' a m" := (d_neut a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇓' a m" := (d_dom a m) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, m custom domain at level 30) : mctt_scope.

Notation "'⇑!' a n" := (d_neut a (d_var n)) (in custom domain at level 0, a custom domain at level 30, n constr at level 0) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ ↦ m" := (extend_env ρ m) (in custom domain at level 20, left associativity) : mctt_scope.

Notation "ρ '↯'" := (drop_env ρ) (in custom domain at level 10, ρ custom domain) : mctt_scope.

End Domain_Notations.

Import Domain_Notations.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'⟦' M '⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, M custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, A custom exp at level 99, MZ custom exp at level 99, MS custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain at level 99, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₁' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'π₂' n ↘ r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" (in custom judg at level 80, n custom domain at level 99, a custom domain at level 30, m1 custom domain at level 35, m2 custom domain at level 40, B custom exp at level 99, BR custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, r custom domain at level 99).

Reserved Notation "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" (in custom judg at level 80, σ custom exp at level 99, ρ custom domain at level 99, ρσ custom domain at level 99).

Generalizable All Variables.

Variant eval_fst : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_fst_pair :
  `( {{ π₁ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ a }} )
| eval_fst_neut :
  `( {{ π₁ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ a (fst m) }} )
where "'π₁' n '↘' r" := (eval_fst n r) (in custom judg).

Inductive eval_exp : exp -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_exp_typ :
  `( {{ ⟦ Type@i ⟧ ρ ↘ 𝕌@i }} )
| eval_exp_var :
  `( {{ ⟦ # x ⟧ ρ ↘ ^(ρ x) }} )
| eval_exp_nat :
  `( {{ ⟦ ℕ ⟧ ρ ↘ ℕ }} )
| eval_exp_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ zero ⟧ ρ ↘ zero }} )
| eval_exp_succ :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ succ M ⟧ ρ ↘ succ m }} )
| eval_exp_natrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ rec m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_pi :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Π A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Π a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ λ A M ⟧ ρ ↘ λ ρ M }} )
| eval_exp_app :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ $| m & n |↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M N ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sigma :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Σ A B ⟧ ρ ↘ Σ a ρ B }} )
| eval_exp_pair :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ b }} ->
     {{ ⟦ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ⟧ ρ ↘ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ }} )
| eval_exp_fst :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ fst M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_snd :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ r }}  ->
     {{ ⟦ snd M ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_eq :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ Eq A M1 M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ Eq a m1 m2 }} )
| eval_exp_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ refl A M ⟧ ρ ↘ refl m }} )
| eval_exp_eqrec :
  `( {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M1 ⟧ ρ ↘ m1 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M2 ⟧ ρ ↘ m2 }} ->
     {{ ⟦ N ⟧ ρ ↘ n }} ->
     {{ eqrec n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end ⟧ ρ ↘ r }} )
| eval_exp_sub :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ' ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} )
where "'⟦' e '⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_exp e ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_natrec : exp -> exp -> exp -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_natrec_zero :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ rec zero ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} )
| eval_natrec_succ :
  `( {{ rec b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ r }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ b ↦ r ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ rec succ b ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ms }} )
| eval_natrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ MZ ⟧ ρ ↘ mz }} ->
     {{ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ b m ↘ a }} ->
     {{ rec ⇑ b m ⟦return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ a (rec m under ρ return A | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end) }} )
where "'rec' m '⟦return' A | 'zero' -> MZ | 'succ' -> MS 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_natrec A MZ MS m ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_app : domain -> domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_app_fn :
  `( {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ m }} ->
     {{ $| λ ρ M & n |↘ m }} )
| eval_app_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ $| ⇑ (Π a ρ B) m & n |↘ ⇑ b (m (⇓ a n)) }} )
where "'$|' m '&' n '|↘' r" := (eval_app m n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_snd : domain -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_snd_pair :
  `( {{ π₂ ⟨ a ; b ⟩ ↘ b }} )
| eval_snd_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑ a (fst m) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ π₂ ⇑ (Σ a ρ B) m ↘ ⇑ b (snd m) }} )
where "'π₂' n '↘' r" := (eval_snd n r) (in custom judg)
with eval_eqrec : domain -> exp -> exp -> domain -> domain -> domain -> env -> domain -> Prop :=
| eval_eqrec_refl :
  `( {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ n ↘ br }} ->
     {{ eqrec refl n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ br }} )
| eval_eqrec_neut :
  `( {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m1 ↦ m2 ↦ ⇑ c n ↘ b }} ->
     {{ eqrec ⇑ c n as Eq a m1 m2 ⟦return B | refl -> BR end⟧ ρ ↘ ⇑ b (eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end) }} )
where "'eqrec' n 'as' 'Eq' a m1 m2 '⟦return' B | 'refl' -> BR 'end⟧' ρ '↘' r" := (eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 n ρ r) (in custom judg)
with eval_sub : sub -> env -> env -> Prop :=
| eval_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⟦ Id ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ }} )
| eval_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⟦ Wk ⟧s ρ ↘ ρ ↯ }} )
| eval_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ M ⟧ ρ ↘ m }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ,, M ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ↦ m }} )
| eval_sub_compose :
  `( {{ ⟦ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ⟧s ρτ ↘ ρτσ }} ->
     {{ ⟦ σ ∘ τ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρτσ }} )
where "'⟦' σ '⟧s' ρ '↘' ρσ" := (eval_sub σ ρ ρσ) (in custom judg)
.

Scheme eval_exp_mut_ind := Induction for eval_exp Sort Prop
with eval_natrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_natrec Sort Prop
with eval_app_mut_ind := Induction for eval_app Sort Prop
with eval_snd_mut_ind := Induction for eval_snd Sort Prop
with eval_eqrec_mut_ind := Induction for eval_eqrec Sort Prop
with eval_sub_mut_ind := Induction for eval_sub Sort Prop
.

Combined Scheme eval_mut_ind from
  eval_exp_mut_ind,
  eval_natrec_mut_ind,
  eval_app_mut_ind,
  eval_snd_mut_ind,
  eval_eqrec_mut_ind,
  eval_sub_mut_ind.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Coq Require Import List Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Syntactic Require Export Syntax.

Import Syntax_Notations.

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ≈ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, M' custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ M : A" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, M custom exp, A custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, σ custom exp, σ' custom exp, Δ custom exp).

Reserved Notation "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, Γ' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'" (in custom judg at level 80, Γ custom exp, A custom exp, A' custom exp).

Reserved Notation "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" (in custom judg at level 80, x constr at level 0, A custom exp, Γ custom exp at level 50).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive ctx_lookup : nat -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
  | here : `({{ #0 : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, A }})
  | there : `({{ #n : A ∈ Γ }} -> {{ #(S n) : A[Wk] ∈ Γ, B }})
where "'#' x : A ∈ Γ" := (ctx_lookup x A Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope.

Inductive wf_ctx : ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} )
where "⊢ Γ" := (wf_ctx Γ) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_ctx_sub : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| wf_ctx_sub_empty : {{ ⊢ ⋅ ⊆ ⋅ }}
| wf_ctx_sub_extend :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ ⊆ Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Γ, A ⊆ Δ, A' }} )
where "⊢ Γ ⊆ Γ'" := (wf_ctx_sub Γ Γ') (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_exp : ctx -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_typ :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_nat :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_zero :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_succ :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M : ℕ }} )
| wf_natrec :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end : A[Id,,M] }} )

| wf_pi :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_fn :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M : Π A B }} )
| wf_app :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N : B[Id,,N] }} )

| wf_sigma :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B : Type@i }} )
| wf_pair :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_fst :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst M : A }} )
| wf_snd :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M : B[Id,,fst M] }} )

| wf_vlookup :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #x : A }} )

| wf_eq :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M N : Type@i }})
| wf_refl :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ refl A M : Eq A M M }})
| wf_eqrec :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ BR : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end : B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }} )

| wf_exp_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_subtyp :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->









     {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }} )
where "Γ ⊢ M : A" := (wf_exp Γ A M) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_sub : ctx -> ctx -> sub -> Prop :=
| wf_sub_id :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }} )
| wf_sub_weaken :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ, A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }} )
| wf_sub_compose :
  `( {{ Γ1 ⊢s σ2 : Γ2 }} ->
     {{ Γ2 ⊢s σ1 : Γ3 }} ->
     {{ Γ1 ⊢s σ1∘σ2 : Γ3 }} )
| wf_sub_extend :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A[σ] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s σ,,M : Δ, A }} )
| wf_sub_subtyp :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->




     {{ ⊢ Δ' }} ->
     {{ ⊢ Δ ⊆ Δ' }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ' }} )
where "Γ ⊢s σ : Δ" := (wf_sub Γ Δ σ) (in custom judg) : type_scope

with wf_exp_eq : ctx -> typ -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=
| wf_exp_eq_typ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Type@i[σ] ≈ Type@i : Type@(S i) }} )

| wf_exp_eq_nat_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ[σ] ≈ ℕ : Type@0 }} )
| wf_exp_eq_zero_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ zero[σ] ≈ zero : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (succ M)[σ] ≈ succ (M[σ]) : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_succ_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ succ M ≈ succ M' : ℕ }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_cong :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ ≈ MZ' : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS ≈ MS' : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ rec M' return A' | zero -> MZ' | succ -> MS' end : A[Id,,M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_natrec_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Δ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end[σ] ≈ rec M[σ] return A[q σ] | zero -> MZ[σ] | succ -> MS[q (q σ)] end : A[σ,,M[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_zero :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec zero return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_nat_beta_succ :
  `( {{ Γ, ℕ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ MZ : A[Id,,zero] }} ->
     {{ Γ, ℕ, A ⊢ MS : A[Wk∘Wk,,succ #1] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : ℕ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ rec succ M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end ≈ MS[Id,,M,,rec M return A | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS end] : A[Id,,succ M] }} )

| wf_exp_eq_pi_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Π A B)[σ] ≈ Π A[σ] B[q σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Π A B ≈ Π A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M ≈ M' : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : Π A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fn_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (λ A M)[σ] ≈ λ A[σ] M[q σ] : (Π A B)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M N ≈ M' N' : B[Id,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_app_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (M N)[σ] ≈ M[σ] N[σ] : B[σ,,N[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ M : B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (λ A M) N ≈ M[Id,,N] : B[Id,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pi_eta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Π A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ λ A (M[Wk] #0) : Π A B }} )

| wf_exp_eq_sigma_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Σ A B)[σ] ≈ Σ A[σ] B[q σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_sigma_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Σ A B ≈ Σ A' B' : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ≈ ⟨ M' : A' ; N' : B' ⟩ : Σ A B }} )
| wf_exp_eq_pair_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩[σ] ≈ ⟨ M[σ] : A[σ] ; N[σ] : B[q σ] ⟩ : (Σ A B)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst M ≈ fst M' : A }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (fst M)[σ] ≈ fst (M[σ]) : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd M ≈ snd M' : B[Id,,fst M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (snd M)[σ] ≈ snd (M[σ]) : B[σ,,fst (M[σ])] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_fst_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ fst (⟨ M : A ; N : B⟩) ≈ M : A }} )
| wf_exp_eq_snd_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N : B[Id,,M] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ snd ⟨ M : A ; N : B ⟩ ≈ N : B[Id,,M] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_sigma_eta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : Σ A B }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ ⟨ fst M : A ; snd M : B ⟩ : Σ A B }} )

| wf_exp_eq_eq_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq A M N)[σ] ≈ Eq A[σ] M[σ] N[σ] : Type@i }} )
| wf_exp_eq_refl_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ (refl A M)[σ] ≈ refl A[σ] M[σ] : (Eq A M M)[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_eqrec_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M1 : A }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ M2 : A }} ->
     {{ Δ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Δ, A ⊢ BR : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ N : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end[σ]
          ≈ eqrec N[σ] as Eq A[σ] M1[σ] M2[σ] return B[q (q (q σ))] | refl -> BR[q σ] end
         : B[σ,,M1[σ],,M2[σ],,N[σ]] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_eq_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ Eq A M N ≈ Eq A' M' N' : Type@i }})
| wf_exp_eq_refl_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ refl A M ≈ refl A' M' : Eq A M M }})
| wf_exp_eq_eqrec_cong :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M1 ≈ M1' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M2 ≈ M2' : A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ BR ≈ BR' : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : Eq A M1 M2 }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B | refl -> BR end
          ≈ eqrec N' as Eq A' M1' M2' return B' | refl -> BR' end
         : B[Id,,M1,,M2,,N] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_eqrec_beta :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
     {{ Γ, A, A[Wk], Eq A[Wk∘Wk] #1 #0 ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
     {{ Γ, A ⊢ BR : B[Id,,#0,,refl A[Wk] #0] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ eqrec refl A M as Eq A M M return B | refl -> BR end
          ≈ BR[Id,,M]
         : B[Id,,M,,M,,refl A M] }} )

| wf_exp_eq_var :
  `( {{ ⊢ Γ }} ->
     {{ #x : A ∈ Γ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #x ≈ #x : A }} )
| wf_exp_eq_var_0_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A[σ] }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #0[σ,,M] ≈ M : A[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_var_S_sub :
  `( {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
     {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ M : A[σ] }} ->
     {{ #x : B ∈ Δ }} ->
     {{ Γ ⊢ #(S x)[σ,,M] ≈ #x[σ] : B[σ] }} )
| wf_exp_eq_var_weaken :

(r0 : {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }}),
        P s d{{{ ⇓ bz mz }}} MZ r0 ->
        forall (e1 : {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ (succ ⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }})
          (e2 : {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }})
          (r1 : {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }}),
        P (S (S s)) d{{{ ⇓ bs ms }}} MS' r1 ->
        forall r2 : {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }},
        P0 s m M r2 ->
        P0 s d{{{ rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end }}}
          n{{{ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }}}
          (read_ne_natrec B ρ s b B' bz mz MZ bs MS ms MS' m M e r e0 r0 e1
             e2 r1 r2)) ->
       (forall (s : nat) (m : domain_ne) (M : ne) 
          (n : domain_nf) (N : nf) (r : {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }}),
        P0 s m M r ->

    (fun m r _ => forall t m', BumpD t m m' ->

Lemma CtxConvTy_strong : forall Γ A C i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ C : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ C : Type@i }} ->
  forall B j, {{ Γ, A ⊢ B : Type@j }} -> {{ Γ, C ⊢ B : Type@j }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A C i HA HC Heq B j HB.
  assert (HwfΓ : {{ ⊢ Γ }}) by (eapply wf_exp_ctx; exact HA).
  assert (HctxEq : {{ ⊢ Γ, A ≈ Γ, C }}).
  { eapply wf_ctx_eq_extend; [ apply wf_ctx_eq_refl; exact HwfΓ | exact HA | exact HC | exact HA | exact HC | exact Heq | exact Heq ]. }
  exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 ctx_eq_transport_all)) (cons A Γ) (a_typ j) B HB (cons C Γ) HctxEq).
Qed.

Lemma read_nf_univ_nat_inv : forall s i W,

  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ ℕ ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_nat) by (eapply nbe_ty_nat; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma NTS_var_closed : forall Γ x W i,
  nbe_ty Γ (a_var x) W -> {{ Γ ⊢ #x : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ #x ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ x W i Hnbe HA.
  assert (HW : W = nf_neut (ne_var x)) by (eapply nbe_ty_var; exact Hnbe).
  subst W. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

(* General closed form: whenever the readback is syntactically the input
   expression, term adequacy is immediate.  This covers the universe, nat,
   zero, and variable instances, and any other term on which NbE does not
   change the syntax. *)
Lemma NTmS_of_readback_refl : forall Γ M A W,
  nbe Γ M A W -> nf_to_exp W = M -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : A }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ W : A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ M A W _ Heq HM. subst M. split.
  - exact HM.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HM.
Qed.

Lemma NTS_of_readback_refl : forall Γ A W i,
  nbe_ty Γ A W -> nf_to_exp W = A -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W : Type@i }} /\ {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ W : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A W i _ Heq HA. subst A. split.
  - exact HA.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
Qed.

(* A corrected variable shift for normal/neutral forms.  The supplied
   wk_ne maps [ne_var x] to [S s - x - 1], which does not shift free
   variables (it confuses the level with the shift).  The operation below
   is the standard "insert s dummy variables at the front of the ambient
   context": variables below the depth d of enclosing binders are left
   alone, and all free variables are shifted by s. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (s d : nat) (W : nf) {struct W} : nf :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
  | nf_nat => nf_nat
  | nf_zero => nf_zero
  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B =>
      nf_pair (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d N)
              (shift_nf s (S d) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s d M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (shift_ne s d N)
  end
with shift_ne (s d : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x =>
      if Nat.leb (S x) d then ne_var x else ne_var (x + s)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (shift_ne s d M) (shift_nf s d N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (shift_nf s (S d) A) (shift_nf s d MZ)
                (shift_nf s (S (S d)) MS) (shift_ne s d M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (shift_nf s d A) (shift_nf s (S (S (S d))) B)
               (shift_nf s (S d) BR) (shift_nf s d M)
               (shift_nf s d M') (shift_ne s d N)
  end.

Lemma shift_zero_mut :
  (forall W d, shift_nf 0 d W = W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne 0 d N = N).
Proof.

    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf 0 d W = W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne 0 d N = N)).

  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + simpl. rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb x d') eqn:E; simpl; rewrite E.
      * reflexivity.
      * rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_zero : forall s W, shift_nf 0 s W = W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 shift_zero_mut W s). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_zero : forall s N, shift_ne 0 s N = N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 shift_zero_mut N s). Qed.


Lemma shift_ne_var_true : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = true -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var x.
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_var_false : forall s d x,
  Nat.leb (S x) d = false -> shift_ne s d (ne_var x) = ne_var (x + s).
Proof. intros. unfold shift_ne. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Composition of the corrected shift. *)
Lemma shift_add_mut : forall s t,
  (forall W d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W) /\
  (forall N d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N).
Proof.
  intros s t.
  apply (nf_ne_mut_ind
    (fun W => forall d, shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W)
    (fun N => forall d, shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N)).
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 A IH2 N IH3 B IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d), (IH4 (S d)); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 N IH3 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d), (IH3 d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 M IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros N IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 MZ IH2 MS IH3 M IH4 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 (S d)), (IH2 d), (IH3 (S (S d))), (IH4 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH1 N IH2 d; simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros M IH d; simpl; rewrite (IH d); reflexivity.
  - intros x d. destruct d as [| d'].
    + rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t 0 x) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s 0 (x + t)) by reflexivity.
      rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) 0 x) by reflexivity.
      replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
    + remember (Nat.leb (S x) (S d')) as b eqn:E.
      destruct b.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true t (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true s (S d') x) by exact E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_true (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
        reflexivity.
      * symmetry in E.
        rewrite (shift_ne_var_false t (S d') x) by exact E.
        remember (Nat.leb (S (x + t)) (S d')) as b2 eqn:E2.
        destruct b2.
        -- symmetry in E2. exfalso.
           apply Nat.leb_le in E2. apply Nat.leb_gt in E. lia.
        -- symmetry in E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false s (S d') (x + t)) by exact E2.
           rewrite (shift_ne_var_false (s + t) (S d') x) by exact E.
           replace ((x + t) + s) with (x + (s + t)) by lia. reflexivity.
  - intros A IH1 B IH2 BR IH3 M IH4 M' IH5 N IH6 d;
      simpl; rewrite (IH1 d), (IH2 (S (S (S d)))), (IH3 (S d)),
                     (IH4 d), (IH5 d), (IH6 d); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma shift_nf_add : forall s t W d,
  shift_nf s d (shift_nf t d W) = shift_nf (s + t) d W.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (shift_add_mut s t) W d). Qed.

Lemma shift_ne_add : forall s t N d,
  shift_ne s d (shift_ne t d N) = shift_ne (s + t) d N.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (shift_add_mut s t) N d). Qed.

Lemma wf_subst_type : forall Γ Δ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ A i Hσ HA. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp.
  - eapply wf_exp_sub; [exact Hσ | exact HA].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_retype : forall Γ Δ σ i M M',
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : (Type@i)[σ] }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ i M M' Hσ Heq. apply wf_sub_ctx in Hσ as Hwf.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [exact Heq| |].
  - apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
  - apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := S i).
    + apply wf_typ. exact Hwf.
    + eapply wf_exp_eq_typ_sub. exact Hσ.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_cong_univ : forall Γ Δ σ σ' A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ : Δ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢s σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢s σ ≈ σ' : Δ }} ->
  {{ Δ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Δ σ σ' A i Hσ Hσ' Hseq HA.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype; [exact Hσ|].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_cong.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_refl. exact HA.
  - exact Hseq.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ : forall Γ Γ' Γ'' τ σ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢s τ : Γ' }} -> {{ Γ' ⊢s σ : Γ'' }} ->
  {{ Γ'' ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ (A[σ ∘ τ]) ≈ (A[σ])[τ] : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ Γ' Γ'' τ σ A i Hτ Hσ HA.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_retype with (Δ:=Γ'') (σ:=a_compose σ τ).
  - apply wf_sub_compose with (Γ2 := Γ'); eassumption.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose with (Γ:=Γ) (Γ':=Γ') (Γ'':=Γ'') (τ:=τ) (σ:=σ) (A:=a_typ i) (M:=A); [exact Hτ|exact Hσ|exact HA].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ A : Type@i }}.
Proof. intros. apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id. exact H. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_conv : forall Γ A A' M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M : A' }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A A' M i HM Heq HA'.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [exact HM|exact HA'|].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [exact HA'|exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_extend_id_self : forall Γ A M i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M) : Γ, A }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A M i HM HA. apply wf_exp_ctx in HM as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; [exact Hid|exact HA]).
  assert (Heq : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id; exact HA).
  assert (HM' : {{ Γ ⊢ M : (A[Id]) }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq | exact HAid]).
  eapply wf_sub_extend; [exact Hid|exact HA|exact HM'].
Qed.




Lemma wf_exp_eq_conv : forall Γ A A' M M' i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ A' : Type@i }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A' }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A A' M M' i Heq HAeq HA'.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [exact Heq|exact HA'|].
  apply wf_subtyp_refl with (i := i); [exact HA'|exact HAeq].
Qed.
