From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Import Evaluation.

From Mctt.Core.Semantic Require Export Domain.

Import Domain_Notations.

Reserved Notation "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Reserved Notation "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" (in custom judg at level 80, m custom domain, s constr, M custom nf).

Generalizable All Variables.

Inductive read_nf : nat -> domain_nf -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_nf_type :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ 𝕌@i a in s ↘ A }} )
| read_nf_zero :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ zero in s ↘ zero }} )
| read_nf_succ :
  `( {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (succ m) in s ↘ succ M }} )
| read_nf_nat_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ ℕ (⇑ a m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
| read_nf_fn :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ $| m & ⇑! a s |↘ m' }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ b m' in S s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Π a ρ B) m in s ↘ λ A M }} )
| read_nf_sigma :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ π₁ m ↘ m' }} ->
     {{ π₂ m ↘ n }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ m' ↘ b' }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ b' n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Σ a ρ B) m in s ↘ ⟨M : A ; N : B'⟩}} )
| read_nf_refl :
  `( {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m' in s ↘ M' }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (refl m') in s ↘ refl A M' }} )
| read_nf_eq_neut :
  `( {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (Eq a m1 m2) (⇑ b n) in s ↘ ⇑ N }} )
| read_nf_neut :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ (⇑ a b) (⇑ c m) in s ↘ ⇑ M }} )
where "'Rnf' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_nf s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_ne : nat -> domain_ne -> ne -> Prop :=
| read_ne_var :
  `( {{ Rne !x in s ↘ #(s - x - 1) }} )
| read_ne_natrec :
  `(
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ zero ↘ bz }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bz mz in s ↘ MZ }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ succ (⇑! ℕ s) ↘ bs }} ->
     {{ ⟦ MS ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! ℕ s ↦ ⇑! b (S s) ↘ ms }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bs ms in S (S s) ↘ MS' }} ->

     {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne rec m under ρ return B | zero -> mz | succ -> MS end in s ↘ rec M return B' | zero -> MZ | succ -> MS' end }} )
| read_ne_app :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rnf n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne m n in s ↘ M N }} )
| read_ne_fst :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (fst m) in s ↘ fst M }} )
| read_ne_snd :
  `( {{ Rne m in s ↘ M }} ->
     {{ Rne (snd m) in s ↘ snd M }} )
| read_ne_eqrec :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a (S s) ↦ ⇑! (Eq a (⇑! a s) (⇑! a (S s))) (S (S s)) ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S (S (S s)) ↘ B' }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ ⇑! a s ↦ refl (⇑! a s) ↘ bbr }} ->
     {{ ⟦ BR ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ br }} ->
     {{ Rnf ⇓ bbr br in S s ↘ BR' }} ->

     {{ Rne n in s ↘ N }} ->
     {{ Rne eqrec n under ρ as Eq a m1 m2 return B | refl -> BR end in s ↘ eqrec N as Eq A M1 M2 return B' | refl -> BR' end }} )
where "'Rne' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_ne s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
with read_typ : nat -> domain -> nf -> Prop :=
| read_typ_univ :
  `( {{ Rtyp 𝕌@i in s ↘ Type@i }} )
| read_typ_nat :
  `( {{ Rtyp ℕ in s ↘ ℕ }} )
| read_typ_pi :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Π a ρ B in s ↘ Π A B' }})
| read_typ_sigma :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->
     {{ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ↘ b }} ->
     {{ Rtyp b in S s ↘ B' }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Σ a ρ B in s ↘ Σ A B' }})
| read_typ_eq :
  `(
     {{ Rtyp a in s ↘ A }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m1 in s ↘ M1 }} ->

     {{ Rnf ⇓ a m2 in s ↘ M2 }} ->
     {{ Rtyp Eq a m1 m2 in s ↘ Eq A M1 M2 }})
| read_typ_neut :
  `( {{ Rne b in s ↘ B }} ->
     {{ Rtyp ⇑ a b in s ↘ ⇑ B }})
where "'Rtyp' m 'in' s ↘ M" := (read_typ s m M) (in custom judg) : type_scope
.

Scheme read_nf_mut_ind := Induction for read_nf Sort Prop
with read_ne_mut_ind := Induction for read_ne Sort Prop
with read_typ_mut_ind := Induction for read_typ Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme read_mut_ind from
  read_nf_mut_ind,
  read_ne_mut_ind,
  read_typ_mut_ind.

From Coq Require Import List String.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

Module Cst.

Inductive obj : Set :=
| typ : nat -> obj
| nat : obj
| zero : obj
| succ : obj -> obj
| natrec : obj -> string -> obj -> obj -> string -> string -> obj -> obj
| pi : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| fn : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| app : obj -> obj -> obj
| sigma : string -> obj -> obj -> obj
| pair : obj -> obj -> obj -> string -> obj -> obj
| fst : obj -> obj
| snd : obj -> obj
| prop_eq : obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| refl : obj -> obj -> obj
| eqrec : obj ->
          string -> string -> string -> obj ->
          string -> obj ->
          obj -> obj -> obj -> obj
| var : string -> obj.

End Cst.

Reserved Notation "'typ'".

Inductive exp : Set :=

| a_typ : nat -> typ

| a_nat : typ
| a_zero : exp
| a_succ : exp -> exp
| a_natrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> exp

| a_pi : typ -> typ -> exp
| a_fn : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_app : exp -> exp -> exp

| a_sigma : exp -> exp -> exp
| a_pair : exp -> typ -> exp -> typ -> exp
| a_fst : exp -> exp
| a_snd : exp -> exp

| a_eq : typ -> exp -> exp -> exp
| a_refl : typ -> exp -> exp
| a_eqrec : exp -> typ -> exp -> exp -> typ -> exp -> exp

| a_var : nat -> exp

| a_sub : exp -> sub -> exp
with sub : Set :=
| a_id : sub
| a_weaken : sub
| a_compose : sub -> sub -> sub
| a_extend : sub -> exp -> sub
where "'typ'" := exp.

Notation ctx := (list exp).

Fixpoint nat_to_exp n : exp :=
  match n with
  | 0 => a_zero
  | S m => a_succ (nat_to_exp m)
  end.

Definition num_to_exp n := nat_to_exp (Nat.of_num_uint n).

Fixpoint exp_to_nat e : option nat :=
  match e with
  | a_zero => Some 0
  | a_succ e' =>
      match exp_to_nat e' with
      | Some n => Some (S n)
      | None => None
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition exp_to_num e :=
  match exp_to_nat e with
  | Some n => Some (Nat.to_num_uint n)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive nf : Set :=
| nf_typ : nat -> nf
| nf_nat : nf
| nf_zero : nf
| nf_succ : nf -> nf
| nf_pi : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_fn : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_sigma : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_pair : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_eq : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_refl : nf -> nf -> nf
| nf_neut : ne -> nf
with ne : Set :=
| ne_natrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
| ne_app : ne -> nf -> ne
| ne_fst : ne -> ne
| ne_snd : ne -> ne
| ne_var : nat -> ne
| ne_eqrec : nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> nf -> ne -> ne
.

Fixpoint nf_to_exp (M : nf) : exp :=
  match M with
  | nf_typ i => a_typ i
  | nf_nat => a_nat
  | nf_zero => a_zero
  | nf_succ M => a_succ (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_pi A B => a_pi (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_fn A M => a_fn (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)
  | nf_sigma A B => a_sigma (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => a_pair (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp N) (nf_to_exp B)
  | nf_eq A M N => a_eq (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M) (nf_to_exp N)
  | nf_refl A M => a_refl (nf_to_exp A) (nf_to_exp M)

Lemma eqrec_ctx_typing : forall Γ A i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  ({{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }} /\
   {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\
   {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }} /\
   {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 : Type@i }}).
Proof.
  intros Γ A i HA. pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hctx1|exact HAwk]).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (HWW : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s (Wk ∘ Wk) : Γ }}).
  { eapply wf_sub_compose with (Γ1:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list)
      (Γ2:=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ3:=Γ)
      (σ2:=a_weaken) (σ1:=a_weaken); assumption. }
  assert (HAc : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HL : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Wk]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Happrox : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) ≈ (A[Wk])[Wk] : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_sub_compose_univ with
      (Γ:=(a_sub A a_weaken :: A :: Γ)%list) (Γ':=(A :: Γ)%list) (Γ'':=Γ)
      (τ:=a_weaken) (σ:=a_weaken) (A:=A) (i:=i); eassumption. }
  assert (Hlk0 : {{ #0 : (A[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by apply here.
  assert (Hlk1 : {{ #1 : (A[Wk])[Wk] ∈ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply there; apply here).
  assert (HM1 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : ((A[Wk])[Wk]) }})
    by (apply wf_vlookup; assumption).
  assert (HM0 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : ((A[Wk])[Wk]) }})
    by (apply wf_vlookup; assumption).
  assert (HM1' : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM1|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Happrox|exact HAc]).
  assert (HM0' : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ #0 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) }})
    by (eapply wf_exp_conv; [exact HM0|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Happrox|exact HAc]).
  assert (HC : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0 : Type@i }})
    by (apply wf_eq; assumption).
  repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma eqrec_ctx_sub_approx : forall Γ A M1 M2 i,
  {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M1 : (A[Id]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A M1 M2 i HA HM1 HM2.
  pose proof (wf_exp_ctx _ _ _ HA) as Hwf.
  assert (Hid : {{ Γ ⊢s Id : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_id; exact Hwf).
  assert (Hctx1 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hwf|exact HA]).
  assert (HWk1 : {{ Γ, A ⊢s Wk : Γ }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx1).
  assert (HAwk : {{ Γ, A ⊢ (A[Wk]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (Hctx2 : {{ ⊢ Γ, A, A[Wk] }}) by (apply wf_ctx_extend with (i:=i); [exact Hctx1|exact HAwk]).
  assert (HWk2 : {{ Γ, A, A[Wk] ⊢s Wk : Γ, A }}) by (apply wf_sub_weaken; exact Hctx2).
  assert (Hσ1 : {{ Γ ⊢s (Id ,, M1) : Γ, A }}) by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})
    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption).
  destruct (eqrec_ctx_typing Γ A i HA) as [HAc [HMc [HNc HC]]].
  assert (E1 : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ A : Type@i }})
    by (eapply sub_double_wk_extend_approx; eassumption).
  assert (HL1 : {{ Γ ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HAid : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) : Type@i }}) by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HAid_eq : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ A : Type@i }}) by (apply wf_exp_eq_sub_id_univ; exact HA).
  assert (HEawk : {{ Γ ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) ≈ (A[Id]) : Type@i }})
    by (eapply sub_wk_extend_approx; eassumption).
  assert (HAc_sub : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }})
    by (eapply wf_subst_type; eassumption).
  assert (HL1_Ac : {{ Γ ⊢ ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) ≈ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact E1].
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact HEawk|exact HAid_eq]. }
  assert (HAid_Ac : {{ Γ ⊢ (A[Id]) ≈ (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact HAid_eq|apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact E1]. }
  assert (HvarS : {{ Γ ⊢ #1[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ #0[Id ,, M1] : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_var_S_sub.
    - exact Hσ1.
    - exact HAwk.
    - exact HM2.
    - apply here. }
  assert (Hvar0M1 : {{ Γ ⊢ #0[Id ,, M1] ≈ M1 : (A[Id]) }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_var_0_sub; [exact Hid|exact HA|exact HM1]. }
  assert (Hvar0M2 : {{ Γ ⊢ #0[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ M2 : ((A[Wk])[Id ,, M1]) }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_var_0_sub; [exact Hσ1|exact HAwk|exact HM2]. }
  assert (E2 : {{ Γ ⊢ #1[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ M1 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_trans.
    - eapply wf_exp_eq_conv; [exact HvarS|exact HL1_Ac|exact HAc_sub].
    - eapply wf_exp_eq_conv; [exact Hvar0M1|exact HAid_Ac|exact HAc_sub]. }
  assert (E3 : {{ Γ ⊢ #0[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] ≈ M2 : (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_conv; [exact Hvar0M2|exact HL1_Ac|exact HAc_sub]. }
  assert (Heqsub : {{ Γ ⊢ (Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk]) #1 #0)[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2]
      ≈ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2] (#1[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2]) (#0[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2]) : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_eq_sub; [exact Hσ2|exact HAc|exact HMc|exact HNc]. }
  assert (Heqcong : {{ Γ ⊢ Eq (A[Wk ∘ Wk])[(Id ,, M1) ,, M2]

      ≈ Eq A M1 M2 : Type@i }}).
  { eapply wf_exp_eq_eq_cong; [exact E1|exact E2|exact E3]. }
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [exact Heqsub|exact Heqcong].

  assert (Hσ2 : {{ Γ ⊢s ((Id ,, M1) ,, M2) : Γ, A, A[Wk] }})

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Realizing environments                                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive Renv (n : nat) : ctx -> env -> Prop :=
| Renv_nil : Renv n nil empty_env
| Renv_cons : forall Γ ρ A a b,
    Renv n Γ ρ ->
    eval_exp A ρ b ->
    VT n b a ->
    Renv n (A :: Γ) (extend_env ρ a).

Lemma Renv_down : forall n Γ ρ, Renv (S n) Γ ρ -> Renv n Γ ρ.
Proof.
  intros n Γ ρ H. induction H as [| Γ ρ A a b HR IH He HVT].
  - apply Renv_nil.
  - eapply Renv_cons.
    + exact IH.
    + exact He.
    + apply VT_down1. exact HVT.
Qed.

Lemma Renv_lookup : forall Γ x A, ctx_lookup x A Γ -> forall n ρ,
  Renv n Γ ρ -> exists b, eval_exp A ρ b /\ VT n b (ρ x).
Proof.
  intros Γ x A Hlk. induction Hlk as [A0 Γ0 | n0 A0 Γ0 B Hn IH]; intros n ρ HR.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    exists b. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact H2.
    + exact H4.
  - inversion HR; subst.
    destruct (IH _ _ H1) as [b' [Hb HVT]].
    exists b'. split.
    + eapply eval_exp_sub.
      * apply eval_sub_weaken.
      * exact Hb.
    + exact HVT.
Qed.

  | nf_succ M => nf_succ (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_fn A M => nf_fn (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) M)
  | nf_sigma A B => nf_sigma (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => nf_pair (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s N) (wk_nf (S s) B)
  | nf_eq A M N => nf_eq (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | nf_refl A M => nf_refl (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf s M)
  | nf_neut N => nf_neut (wk_ne s N)
  end
with wk_ne (s : nat) (N : ne) {struct N} : ne :=
  match N with
  | ne_var x => ne_var (S s - x - 1)
  | ne_app M N => ne_app (wk_ne s M) (wk_nf s N)
  | ne_fst M => ne_fst (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_snd M => ne_snd (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
      ne_natrec (wk_nf (S s) A) (wk_nf s MZ) (wk_nf (S (S s)) MS) (wk_ne s M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      ne_eqrec (wk_nf s A) (wk_nf (S (S (S s))) B) (wk_nf (S s) BR)
               (wk_nf s M) (wk_nf s M') (wk_ne s N)
  end.

(* Decomposition of nbe_ty                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma nbe_ty_typ : forall Γ i W, nbe_ty Γ (a_typ i) W -> W = nf_typ i.
Proof.
  intros Γ i W H. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with Hm : eval_exp (a_typ i) ?ρ ?m |- _ =>
    let E := fresh in
    assert (E : m = d_univ i) by (inversion Hm; reflexivity); subst m
  end.
  match goal with Hr : read_typ (length Γ) (d_univ i) W |- _ => inversion Hr; reflexivity end.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_nat : forall Γ W, nbe_ty Γ a_nat W -> W = nf_nat.
Proof.
  intros Γ W H. inversion H; subst.
  match goal with Hm : eval_exp a_nat ?ρ ?m |- _ =>
    let E := fresh in
    assert (E : m = d_nat) by (inversion Hm; reflexivity); subst m
  end.
  match goal with Hr : read_typ (length Γ) d_nat W |- _ => inversion Hr; reflexivity end.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_pi : forall Γ A0 A1 W,
  nbe_ty Γ (a_pi A0 A1) W ->
  exists W0 W1, W = nf_pi W0 W1 /\ nbe_ty Γ A0 W0 /\ nbe_ty (A0::Γ) A1 W1.
Proof.
=====
Qed.

(* --- evaluation of a scoped neutral normal form -------------- *)

Lemma eval_natrec_neut_dom : forall A MZ MS (a : domain) w ρ r,
  eval_natrec A MZ MS (d_neut a w) ρ r -> exists a' w', r = d_neut a' w'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_app_neut_dom : forall (a : domain) w n r,
  eval_app (d_neut a w) n r -> exists b w', r = d_neut b w'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_fst_neut_dom : forall (a : domain) w r,
  eval_fst (d_neut a w) r -> exists b w', r = d_neut b w'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_snd_neut_dom : forall (a : domain) w r,
  eval_snd (d_neut a w) r -> exists b w', r = d_neut b w'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_eqrec_neut_dom : forall (a : domain) B BR m1 m2 (c : domain) n ρ r,
  eval_eqrec a B BR m1 m2 (d_neut c n) ρ r -> exists b w', r = d_neut b w'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Lemma eval_ne_initial : forall Γ (ne : ne) ρ mdom,
  scoped_exp (length Γ) (ne_to_exp ne) -> initial_env Γ ρ ->
  eval_exp (ne_to_exp ne) ρ mdom -> exists a w, mdom = d_neut a w.
Proof.
  intros Γ ne. induction ne as
    [ A MZ MS mne IH
    | mne IH Nnf
    | mne IH
    | mne IH
    | x
    | A B BR M1 M2 mne IH ]; intros ρ mdom Hsc Hie Hev.
  - (* ne_natrec *)
    simpl in Hsc.
    destruct Hsc as [HA [HMZ [HMS HM]]].
    inversion Hev; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp mne) _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH _ _ HM Hie He) as [a [w Hw]] end.
    subst.
    match goal with Hn : eval_natrec _ _ _ (d_neut _ _) _ _ |- _ =>
      eapply eval_natrec_neut_dom; exact Hn end.
  - (* ne_app *)
    simpl in Hsc. destruct Hsc as [HM _].
    inversion Hev; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp mne) _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH _ _ HM Hie He) as [a [w Hw]] end.
    subst.
    match goal with Ha : eval_app (d_neut _ _) _ _ |- _ =>
      eapply eval_app_neut_dom; exact Ha end.
  - (* ne_fst *)
    simpl in Hsc.
    inversion Hev; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp mne) _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH _ _ Hsc Hie He) as [a [w Hw]] end.
    subst.
    match goal with Hf : eval_fst (d_neut _ _) _ |- _ =>
      eapply eval_fst_neut_dom; exact Hf end.
  - (* ne_snd *)
    simpl in Hsc.
    inversion Hev; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp mne) _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH _ _ Hsc Hie He) as [a [w Hw]] end.
    subst.
    match goal with Hf : eval_snd (d_neut _ _) _ |- _ =>
      eapply eval_snd_neut_dom; exact Hf end.
  - (* ne_var *)
    simpl in Hsc.
    inversion Hev; subst.
    destruct (initial_env_lookup Γ ρ Hie x Hsc) as [b Hb].
    eexists; eexists; exact Hb.
  - (* ne_eqrec *)
    simpl in Hsc.
    destruct Hsc as [HA [HB [HBR [HM1 [HM2 HM]]]]].
    inversion Hev; subst.
    lazymatch goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp mne) _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH _ _ HM Hie He) as [da [dw Hw]] end.
    subst.
    match goal with Hn : eval_eqrec _ _ _ _ _ (d_neut _ _) _ _ |- _ =>
      eapply eval_eqrec_neut_dom; exact Hn end.
Qed.

(* --- head preservation for normal forms ---------------------- *)

Lemma nbe_ty_nf_head_scoped : forall Γ (B : nf) W,
  scoped_exp (length Γ) B -> nbe_ty Γ B W -> nf_head B = nf_head W.
Proof.
  intros Γ B W Hsc Hn.
  destruct B as [i| | |M0|A0 B0|A0 M0|A0 B0|M0 A0 N0 B0|A0 M0 N0|A0 M0|ne].
  - (* nf_typ *) simpl in *. apply nbe_ty_typ in Hn. subst. reflexivity.
  - (* nf_nat *) simpl in *. apply nbe_ty_nat in Hn. subst. reflexivity.
  - (* nf_zero *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp a_zero _ _ |- _ => inversion He; subst end.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ d_zero _ |- _ => inversion Hr end.
  - (* nf_succ *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (a_succ _) _ _ |- _ => inversion He; subst end.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ (d_succ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hr end.
  - (* nf_pi *) simpl in *. apply nbe_ty_pi in Hn.
    destruct Hn as [W0 [W1 [Heq _]]]. subst. reflexivity.
  - (* nf_fn *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (a_fn _ _) _ _ |- _ => inversion He; subst end.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ (d_fn _ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hr end.
  - (* nf_sigma *) simpl in *. apply nbe_ty_sigma in Hn.
    destruct Hn as [W0 [W1 [Heq _]]]. subst. reflexivity.
  - (* nf_pair *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (a_pair _ _ _ _) _ _ |- _ => inversion He; subst end.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ (d_pair _ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hr end.
  - (* nf_eq *) simpl in *. apply nbe_ty_eq in Hn.
    destruct Hn as [W0 [W1 [W2 [Heq _]]]]. subst. reflexivity.
  - (* nf_refl *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with He : eval_exp (a_refl _ _) _ _ |- _ => inversion He; subst end.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ (d_refl _) _ |- _ => inversion Hr end.
  - (* nf_neut *)
    simpl in *. inversion Hn; subst.
    match goal with Hie : initial_env Γ _ |- _ =>
      match goal with He : eval_exp (ne_to_exp ne) _ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (eval_ne_initial Γ ne _ _ Hsc Hie He) as [a [w Hw]] end end.
    subst.
    match goal with Hr : read_typ _ (d_neut _ _) _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hr; subst; reflexivity end.
Qed.

Lemma nf_head_zero : forall (B : nf), nf_head B = 0 -> exists i, B = nf_typ i.
Proof.
  intros B. destruct B; simpl; intros H; try discriminate; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_ty_nf_head : forall Γ (B : nf) W j,
  {{ ⊢ Γ }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ B : Type@j }} ->
  nbe_ty Γ B W -> nf_head B = nf_head W.
Proof.
  intros Γ B W j Hwf HBty Hn.
  eapply nbe_ty_nf_head_scoped.
  - exact (wf_exp_scoped Γ B (a_typ j) HBty).
  - exact Hn.
Qed.

Fixpoint nf_size W : nat :=
 match W with
 | nf_typ _ => 1 | nf_nat => 1 | nf_zero => 1
 | nf_succ M => S (nf_size M)
 | nf_pi A B => S (nf_size A + nf_size B)

 | nf_sigma A B => S (...)

 | nf_eq A M N => S (...)
 | nf_refl A M => S (...)
 | nf_neut N => S (ne_size N)
 end
with ne_size N :=

 | ne_fst M => S (ne_size M)
 | ne_snd M => S (ne_size M)

 | S fuel' =>
   match W with
   | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
   | nf_nat => nf_nat
   | nf_zero => nf_zero
   | nf_succ M => nf_succ (hs_nf fuel' d V M)
   | nf_pi A B => nf_pi (hs_nf fuel' d V A) (hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B)

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Hereditary substitution on normal / neutral forms            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* The substitution below is intended at a variable whose de Bruijn
   index is [d]; [d] is the number of traversed (inner) binders, so at
   the top level the substituted variable is #0.  [V] lives in the
   ambient context at that point; when going under a binder both the
   target index and the accumulated shift of [V] are increased. *)

Fixpoint nf_size (W : nf) {struct W} : nat :=
  match W with
  | nf_typ _ => 1
  | nf_nat => 1
  | nf_zero => 1
  | nf_succ M => S (nf_size M)
  | nf_pi A B => S (nf_size A + nf_size B)
  | nf_fn A M => S (nf_size A + nf_size M)
  | nf_sigma A B => S (nf_size A + nf_size B)
  | nf_pair M A N B => S (nf_size M + nf_size A + nf_size N + nf_size B)
  | nf_eq A M N => S (nf_size A + nf_size M + nf_size N)
  | nf_refl A M => S (nf_size A + nf_size M)
  | nf_neut N => S (ne_size N)
  end
with ne_size (N : ne) {struct N} : nat :=
  match N with
  | ne_var _ => 1
  | ne_app M N => S (ne_size M + nf_size N)
  | ne_fst M => S (ne_size M)
  | ne_snd M => S (ne_size M)
  | ne_natrec A MZ MS M => S (nf_size A + nf_size MZ + nf_size MS + ne_size M)
  | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
      S (nf_size A + nf_size B + nf_size BR + nf_size M + nf_size M' + ne_size N)
  end.

(* Fallback used only when the fuel is exhausted.  It is never
   encountered by the well-typed uses below. *)
Definition hs_default : nf := nf_neut (ne_var 0).

(* [hs_nf fuel d V W]: substitute [V] for variable #[d] in [W].
   [hs_ne fuel d V N]: the same operation on a neutral spine; the
   result is a normal form because a substitution may expose a lambda
   (beta) or a pair (fst/snd).  [nf_natrec fuel A MZ MS k]: normalize a
   natrec applied to the normal form [k].  All three consume one unit
   of fuel at each recursive call; fuel is necessary because
   hereditary substitution of untyped normal forms can diverge
   (e.g. the untyped self-application [λx. x x] substituted into
   [x x]). *)

Fixpoint hs_nf (fuel d : nat) (V W : nf) {struct fuel} : nf :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => hs_default
  | S fuel' =>
      match W with
      | nf_typ i => nf_typ i
      | nf_nat => nf_nat
      | nf_zero => nf_zero
      | nf_succ M => nf_succ (hs_nf fuel' d V M)
      | nf_pi A B =>
          nf_pi (hs_nf fuel' d V A)
                (hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B)
      | nf_fn A M =>
          nf_fn (hs_nf fuel' d V A)
                (hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) M)
      | nf_sigma A B =>
          nf_sigma (hs_nf fuel' d V A)
                   (hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B)
      | nf_pair M A N B =>
          nf_pair (hs_nf fuel' d V M) (hs_nf fuel' d V A)
                  (hs_nf fuel' d V N)
                  (hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B)
      | nf_eq A M N =>
          nf_eq (hs_nf fuel' d V A) (hs_nf fuel' d V M)
                (hs_nf fuel' d V N)
      | nf_refl A M =>
          nf_refl (hs_nf fuel' d V A) (hs_nf fuel' d V M)
      | nf_neut N => hs_ne fuel' d V N
      end
  end
with hs_ne (fuel d : nat) (V : nf) (N : ne) {struct fuel} : nf :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => hs_default
  | S fuel' =>
      match N with
      | ne_var x =>
          if Nat.eqb x d then V
          else if Nat.ltb x d then nf_neut (ne_var x)
               else nf_neut (ne_var (x - 1))
      | ne_app M N =>
          let M' := hs_ne fuel' d V M in
          let N' := hs_nf fuel' d V N in
          match M' with
          | nf_fn A body => hs_nf fuel' 0 N' body
          | nf_neut M'' => nf_neut (ne_app M'' N')
          | _ => nf_neut (ne_app (ne_var 0) N')
          end
      | ne_fst M =>
          match hs_ne fuel' d V M with
          | nf_pair M1 A N1 B => M1
          | nf_neut M'' => nf_neut (ne_fst M'')
          | _ => nf_neut (ne_fst (ne_var 0))
          end
      | ne_snd M =>
          match hs_ne fuel' d V M with
          | nf_pair M1 A N1 B => N1
          | nf_neut M'' => nf_neut (ne_snd M'')
          | _ => nf_neut (ne_snd (ne_var 0))
          end
      | ne_natrec A MZ MS M =>
          let A' := hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) A in
          let MZ' := hs_nf fuel' d V MZ in
          let MS' := hs_nf fuel' (S (S d))
                       (shift_nf 1 (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V)) MS in
          match hs_ne fuel' d V M with
          | nf_zero => MZ'
          | nf_succ k => nf_natrec fuel' A' MZ' MS' k
          | nf_neut M'' => nf_neut (ne_natrec A' MZ' MS' M'')
          | _ => hs_default
          end
      | ne_eqrec A B BR M M' N =>
          let A'' := hs_nf fuel' d V A in
          let B'' := hs_nf fuel' (S (S (S d)))
                       (shift_nf 1 (S (S d))
                          (shift_nf 1 (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V))) B in
          let BR'' := hs_nf fuel' (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) BR in
          let M'' := hs_nf fuel' d V M in
          let M2'' := hs_nf fuel' d V M' in
          match hs_ne fuel' d V N with
          | nf_refl _ q => hs_nf fuel' 0 q BR''
          | nf_neut N'' => nf_neut (ne_eqrec A'' B'' BR'' M'' M2'' N'')
          | _ => hs_default
          end
      end
  end
with nf_natrec (fuel : nat) (A MZ MS k : nf) {struct fuel} : nf :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => hs_default
  | S fuel' =>
      match k with
      | nf_zero => MZ
      | nf_succ k' =>
          let rec_k := nf_natrec fuel' A MZ MS k' in
          let step1 := hs_nf fuel' 0 (shift_nf 1 0 rec_k) MS in
          hs_nf fuel' 0 k' step1
      | nf_neut n => nf_neut (ne_natrec A MZ MS n)
      | _ => hs_default
      end
  end.

(* The public, single-variable substitution at the outermost variable. *)
Definition subst_nf (fuel : nat) (V W : nf) : nf := hs_nf fuel 0 V W.
Definition subst_ne (fuel : nat) (V : nf) (N : ne) : nf := hs_ne fuel 0 V N.
EOF

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic computation laws for hereditary substitution            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma hs_nf_typ : forall n d V i,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_typ i) = nf_typ i.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_nat : forall n d V,
  hs_nf (S n) d V nf_nat = nf_nat.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_zero : forall n d V,
  hs_nf (S n) d V nf_zero = nf_zero.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_succ : forall n d V M,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_succ M) = nf_succ (hs_nf n d V M).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_pi : forall n d V A B,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_pi A B) =
    nf_pi (hs_nf n d V A) (hs_nf n (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_fn : forall n d V A M,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_fn A M) =
    nf_fn (hs_nf n d V A) (hs_nf n (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) M).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_sigma : forall n d V A B,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_sigma A B) =
    nf_sigma (hs_nf n d V A) (hs_nf n (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_pair : forall n d V M A N B,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_pair M A N B) =
    nf_pair (hs_nf n d V M) (hs_nf n d V A)
            (hs_nf n d V N) (hs_nf n (S d) (shift_nf 1 d V) B).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_eq : forall n d V A M N,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_eq A M N) =
    nf_eq (hs_nf n d V A) (hs_nf n d V M) (hs_nf n d V N).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_refl : forall n d V A M,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_refl A M) =
    nf_refl (hs_nf n d V A) (hs_nf n d V M).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_nf_neut : forall n d V N,
  hs_nf (S n) d V (nf_neut N) = hs_ne n d V N.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_var_eq : forall n V d,
  hs_ne (S n) d V (ne_var d) = V.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_var_lt : forall n V d x,
  x < d -> hs_ne (S n) d V (ne_var x) = nf_neut (ne_var x).
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  rewrite Nat.eqb_neq by lia.
  rewrite Nat.ltb_lt by lia.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_var_gt : forall n V d x,
  d < x -> hs_ne (S n) d V (ne_var x) = nf_neut (ne_var (x - 1)).
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  rewrite Nat.eqb_neq by lia.
  rewrite Nat.ltb_ge by lia.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Beta: applying a substituted lambda reduces.  Two units of fuel are
   needed by the outer application case and one by the variable lookup. *)
Lemma hs_ne_app_beta : forall n d A body N,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_fn A body) (ne_app (ne_var d) N) =
    hs_nf (S n) 0 (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_fn A body) N) body.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Neutral function: the spine is rebuilt. *)
Lemma hs_ne_app_neut : forall n d N0 N,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_neut N0) (ne_app (ne_var d) N) =
    nf_neut (ne_app N0 (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_neut N0) N)).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

  x < d ->

    nf_neut (ne_app (ne_var x) (hs_nf (S n) d V N)).
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_app_neut_other_gt : forall n d V x N,
  d < x ->
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d V (ne_app (ne_var x) N) =
    nf_neut (ne_app (ne_var (x - 1)) (hs_nf (S n) d V N)).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (hs_ne_var_gt (S n) V d x H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_fst_pair : forall n d M1 A N1 B,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_pair M1 A N1 B) (ne_fst (ne_var d)) = M1.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_snd_pair : forall n d M1 A N1 B,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_pair M1 A N1 B) (ne_snd (ne_var d)) = N1.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_fst_neut : forall n d N0,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_neut N0) (ne_fst (ne_var d)) =

Lemma hs_ne_snd_neut : forall n d N0,

Proof.

Qed.

(* natrec on a substituted zero: the zero branch is selected. *)
Lemma hs_ne_natrec_zero : forall n d A MZ MS,

Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_natrec_succ : forall n d A MZ MS k,

    nf_natrec (S n)
      (hs_nf (S n) (S d) (shift_nf 1 d (nf_succ k)) A)
      (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_succ k) MZ)

  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_natrec_neut : forall n d N0 A MZ MS,

    nf_neut (ne_natrec

      (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_neut N0) MZ)
      (hs_nf (S n) (S (S d))
         (shift_nf 1 (S d) (shift_nf 1 d (nf_neut N0))) MS)

Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nf_natrec_zero : forall n A MZ MS,
  nf_natrec (S n) A MZ MS nf_zero = MZ.
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma nf_natrec_succ : forall n A MZ MS k,
  nf_natrec (S n) A MZ MS (nf_succ k) =
    hs_nf n 0 k
      (hs_nf n 0 (shift_nf 1 0 (nf_natrec n A MZ MS k)) MS).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma nf_natrec_neut : forall n A MZ MS N0,
  nf_natrec (S n) A MZ MS (nf_neut N0) =
    nf_neut (ne_natrec A MZ MS N0).
Proof. intros; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

(* eqrec on a substituted reflexivity proof reduces to the refl branch. *)
Lemma hs_ne_eqrec_refl : forall n d A B BR M M' P Qarg,
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_refl P Qarg)
    (ne_eqrec A B BR M M' (ne_var d)) =
    hs_nf (S n) 0 Qarg
      (hs_nf (S n) (S d) (shift_nf 1 d (nf_refl P Qarg)) BR).
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite hs_ne_var_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma hs_ne_eqrec_neut : forall n d N0 A B BR M M',
  hs_ne (S (S n)) d (nf_neut N0)
    (ne_eqrec A B BR M M' (ne_var d)) =
    nf_neut (ne_eqrec
      (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_neut N0) A)
      (hs_nf (S n) (S (S (S d)))

            (shift_nf 1 (S d) (shift_nf 1 d (nf_neut N0)))) B)
      (hs_nf (S n) (S d) (shift_nf 1 d (nf_neut N0)) BR)
      (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_neut N0) M)
      (hs_nf (S n) d (nf_neut N0) M')

Proof.

Qed.

  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type@i }} ->

  intros Γ A A' M i HM Heq HA'.
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [exact HM|exact HA'|].

  {{ Γ ⊢ M : A }} -> {{ Γ ⊢ A : Type@i }} ->

                     : a_sub Bsub (a_extend a_id Nsub) }}).

Lemma wf_app_beta_substitution : forall Γ A B Vbody Varg,
  {{ Γ ⊢ Varg : A }} ->
  {{ Γ, A ⊢ Vbody : B }} ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ a_sub Vbody (a_extend a_id Varg)
       : a_sub B (a_extend a_id Varg) }}.
Proof.

  apply wf_exp_ctx in Hbody as Hctx.
  inversion Hctx; subst.
  assert (Hσ : {{ Γ ⊢s a_extend a_id Varg : Γ, A }})

  eapply wf_exp_sub; [exact Hσ|exact Hbody].

Lemma wf_subst_nf_adequacy : forall Γ A B V W,
  {{ Γ ⊢ V : A }} ->
  {{ Γ, A ⊢ W : B }} ->
  exists n W',
    hs_nf n 0 V W = W' /\
    {{ Γ ⊢ W' : a_sub B (a_extend a_id V) }}.
Admitted.

Lemma hs_nf_adequacy_eq : forall Γ A B V W n W',
  {{ Γ ⊢ V : A }} ->
  {{ Γ, A ⊢ W : B }} ->
  hs_nf n 0 V W = W' ->
  {{ Γ ⊢ W' ≈ a_sub W (a_extend a_id V)
       : a_sub B (a_extend a_id V) }}.
Admitted.

(* Application/beta typing transport, derived from the adequacy
   principle.  The reducing substitution into the body is typed at the
   instantiated codomain. *)
Lemma wf_subst_ne_app_beta : forall Γ A B Vbody Varg,
  {{ Γ ⊢ Varg : A }} ->
  {{ Γ, A ⊢ Vbody : B }} ->
  exists n W,
    hs_nf n 0 Varg Vbody = W /\
    {{ Γ ⊢ W : a_sub B (a_extend a_id Varg) }}.
Proof.
  intros Γ A B Vbody Varg HVarg Hbody.
  destruct (wf_subst_nf_adequacy Γ A B Varg Vbody HVarg Hbody)
    as [n [W [Heq Hty]]].
  exists n, W. split; assumption.
Qed.

   hereditary substitution of the argument readback into the body
   readback.  This is the semantic counterpart of the two obstructions
   above and is not closed: it requires the readback/evaluation
   instantiation theorem together with fuel sufficiency. *)

    eval_app m (d_neut a (d_var s)) n' ->
    eval_exp B (extend_env rho (d_neut a (d_var s))) b ->
    read_nf (S s) (d_dom b n') Wbody ->
    read_nf s (d_dom a n) Warg ->
    eval_app m n r ->
    eval_exp B (extend_env rho n) b' ->
    exists fuel W,
      read_nf s (d_dom b' r) W /\
      W = subst_nf fuel Warg Wbody.
